title: Customer Success Manager Grands Comptes - Cabinets comptables H/F (en télétravail depuis Rennes)
descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Le rôle

En tant que Customer Success Manager Key Accounts (CSM KA), tu accompagnes un portefeuille de cabinets partenaires grands comptes (7 à 10 comptes, Top 150) qui déploient Pennylane auprès de leurs équipes et de leurs clients. Ton objectif : maximiser l’adoption, la satisfaction et la rétention, tout en structurant une gouvernance adaptée à des organisations multi-bureaux.

Tes responsabilités

  • Piloter la relation au quotidien avec les décisionnaires et équipes projet du cabinet.

  • Construire et animer la gouvernance : COPIL, comités d’adoption, instances de suivi, communauté de relais locaux.

  • Définir et exécuter des plans d’adoption (collaborateurs + clients) fondés sur la donnée.

  • Coordonner l’exécution avec les expert·e·s internes Pennylane (Produit, Support, Ops, Sales, etc.).

  • Anticiper les risques (satisfaction, déploiement, adoption) et mettre en place des plans de remédiation.

  • Contribuer à l’inscription et à l’usage de la PA Pennylane pour centraliser les flux.

Ce que tu vas faire concrètement

1) Stratégie d’embarquement clients (TPE/PME)

  • Conseiller les cabinets sur la communication, l’activation et la formation des clients.

  • Aider à intégrer les enjeux de facture électronique dans le plan d’embarquement.

  • Suivre l’exécution post-déploiement et proposer des actions correctives.

2) Adoption et usage côté collaborateurs

  • Mesurer l’usage et identifier les leviers d’amélioration.

  • Mettre en place des plans d’action et en piloter l’exécution.

3) Satisfaction & rétention

  • Maintenir une relation de confiance, cadrer les attentes et délivrer de la valeur.

  • Déployer des plans d’action stratégiques (annuels / semestriels) avec les partenaires.

Indicateurs de réussite

  • CSAT sur ton portefeuille.

  • Progression de l’adoption (collaborateurs et clients), suivie en COPIL.

  • Qualité de la gouvernance et autonomie des relais locaux.

  • Réduction des risques et amélioration de la rétention.

  

Profil recherché

 

  • Expérience de 5 ans minimum :

    • en Customer Success SaaS avec de bonnes bases comptables (ou motivé(e) à monter en compétences à ce sujet

    • ou en finance / audit avec gestion de relation clients (dimension commerciale)

  • Excellente relation client : capacité à rassurer, structurer, et prendre de la hauteur.

  • Assertivité : recommandations claires, diplomatie et capacité à convaincre.

  • Pilotage de portefeuille (santé client), plans d’action ad hoc.

  • Analyse de données : tirer des insights et prioriser.

  • Gestion de projet : coordination multi-interlocuteurs, rigueur et autonomie.

  

Process de recrutement

 

  • Premier entretien avec Florent Mirigay - Senior Business Recruiter (45 min)

  • Deuxième entretien avec Alexandra Ser, Team lead de l’équipe CSM Grands Comptes (45min)

  • Etude de cas (préparée en amont) avec Alexandra et une personne de l’équipe CSM Grands Comptes (1H)

  • Dernier entretien avec Arnaud Bernard (Head of Grands Comptes)

 

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

 

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

  • Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

  • Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

  • Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

  • Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

 

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

 

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

 

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. title: Customer Support (f/m/d) / 20h pro Woche
descriptionHtml:
Wir bei Future Demand entwickeln eine innovative SaaS-Plattform für datengetriebenes Marketing und Demand-Forecasting. Unsere Lösung unterstützt vor allem kleine und mittlere Unternehmen dabei, ihre Vertriebs- und Marketingprozesse intelligenter zu planen und ihr Wachstum zu beschleunigen.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Customer Success Teams suchen wir ab sofort Unterstützung im Customer Support in Teilzeit mit 20 Stunden pro Woche. Die Position ist offen für Bewerber:innen mit unterschiedlichen beruflichen und akademischen Hintergründen. Entscheidend sind für uns deine Serviceorientierung, deine klare Kommunikation und dein Interesse an digitalen Produkten.

Aufgaben

  • Erste Anlaufstelle für unsere Kund:innen: Du bearbeitest Anfragen per E-Mail und telefonisch.
  • Schnelle Lösungen liefern: Du triagierst eingehende Tickets, beantwortest Standardfragen selbstständig und leitest komplexere Fälle an die entsprechenden Expert:innen weiter.
  • Dokumentation und Wissensmanagement: Du pflegst unsere interne Wissensdatenbank in Confluence und schlägst Verbesserungen für unsere Support-Prozesse vor.
  • Technische Unterstützung: Du führst einfache Fehlerdiagnosen durch, unterstützt per Screensharing oder Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitung und setzt kleinere Konfigurationen in Kundensystemen um.
  • Feedback weitergeben: Du sammelst kontinuierlich Nutzerfeedback und arbeitest eng mit Product Management und Development zusammen, um unsere Plattform weiterzuentwickeln.

Qualifikation

Dein Profil

  • Verfügbarkeit: Du möchtest dauerhaft 20 Stunden pro Woche arbeiten.
  • Sprachgewandt: Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch.
  • Kundenorientiert: Du hast Freude daran, Nutzer:innen weiterzuhelfen, und reagierst empathisch sowie lösungsorientiert.
  • Tech-affin: Du bist neugierig auf digitale Produkte und Tools wie HubSpot, Jira oder Confluence und arbeitest dich schnell in neue Software ein.
  • Strukturiert: Du behältst auch in lebhaften Phasen den Überblick und dokumentierst deine Arbeitsschritte sorgfältig.
  • Eigenverantwortlich und teamorientiert: Du arbeitest gerne eng mit anderen zusammen, übernimmst aber auch selbstständig Verantwortung.
  • Ein bestimmter Ausbildungs-, Studien- oder Berufsabschluss ist nicht erforderlich.

Von Vorteil, aber kein Muss

  • Erste Erfahrung im Customer Support, Kundenservice oder Helpdesk
  • Erfahrung mit SaaS-Produkten oder B2B-Kund:innen

Auch Bewerbungen von Quereinsteiger:innen sind ausdrücklich willkommen.

Benefits

Warum wir?

  • Startup-Spirit mit echtem Impact: Arbeite in einem ambitionierten Team, das mit seiner Technologie Unternehmen erfolgreicher macht.
  • Learning on the Job: Übernimm von Anfang an Verantwortung – wir unterstützen dich und fördern deine fachliche Entwicklung.
  • Flexible Teilzeit: Wir stimmen die Aufteilung deiner 20 Wochenstunden gemeinsam ab. Du arbeitest hybrid – remote und in unserem Office in Kreuzberg.
  • Attraktive Vergütung: Je nach Erfahrung erhältst du 1.300 € bis 1.800 € brutto pro Monat sowie einen Zuschuss zum BVG-Ticket.
  • Moderne Infrastruktur: Dich erwarten ein großzügiges Office und eine kostenfreie Urban-Sports-Club-Mitgliedschaft.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

title: Customer Support (part-time)
descriptionHtml:
About us

At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Accel and Energize Capital.

Read more about what we’re building here.

About the role

We’re looking for a personable and proactive customer support champion to help our users get the most out of Axle Energy’s products.

*This is a 6 month part-time contract role - perfect for someone that is ready to jump in and make an immediate impact.

What you will be doing

  • Act as the owner for complex or high-priority customer cases.

  • Collaborate closely with tech team to analyse and solve painpoints

  • Maintain and expand internal technical playbooks and knowledge resources.

  • Identify recurring customer issues bring insights to improve the product

You might be a good fit if you’re

  • Organized: you can stay on top of a to do list and constantly re-prioritize to make sure the most important stuff gets done

  • Empathetic: you care about other people’s problems, and you feel the pain when things don’t work as they should

  • Curious: you’re willing to dig in when things don’t work as they should, and keep an open mind when trying to debug issues

Benefits

A competitive salary & the opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world. We aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

Hybrid working - We have a dog-friendly office in Farringdon. To maximize collaboration, we ask that you spend 1-2 days a week in the office.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse company, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

Interview process

  1. Initial interview

  2. Take-home exercise

  3. Final interview (in-person)

  4. Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

title: Customer Support Specialist (Danish Speaking)
descriptionHtml:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

What you’ll be doing

As a Customer Support Senior Associate you will:

  • Spend your time interacting directly with our customers over chat, email and phone, providing them with an effective, easy and enjoyable Pleo experience.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve customers issues related to the Pleo product, and escalate to the appropriate internal team where needed.

  • Provide feedback and support cross-functional teams on product development based on customer insights.

  • Share learnings and contribute to our knowledge base to ensure growth and knowledge sharing across the team, and beyond.

 

What you bring
You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Love providing fantastic, high-touch customer support on live chat, email and phone.

  • Have a persistent and analytical approach to problem-solving.

  • Are able to explain complicated problems in the simplest terms.

  • Have a genuine desire to work in a fast-paced, fast-changing and collaborative environment.

  • Are tech-savvy, resilient and curious.

  • Have experience with Support tools such as FreshWorks, Intercom or Zendesk.

  • Have experience with accounting, bookkeeping, financial technology or other relevant product within SaaS.

  • Fluency - Both written and spoken in Danish and English.

 

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Customer Support Lead and work closely with teams across all departments in Pleo. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to giving our customers the best experience possible. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across other departments such as Customer Success & Product to ensure success.


How you’ll develop in this role In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Learn and understand the Pleo product deeply.

  • Help 500+ users with their Pleo experience.

  • Act as the voice of the customer internally.

  • Take on new product challenges as the company continues to scale and evolve.

We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on more advanced support tasks, stepping into leadership, or becoming a subject matter expert within a certain product area.

 

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!).

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office.

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis.

  • We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays.

  • For our Team, we offer hybrid working options.

  • Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice.

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far.

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

title: Cyber Threat Intelligence Lead
descriptionHtml:
About CyberCube:

CyberCube delivers the world's leading analytics to quantify digital risk, helping the largest global carriers, reinsurers and brokers understand, price and manage cyber risk in financial terms.

  • AI at our foundation, cyber risk at our core. We don't just use AI, we shape it.

  • Built on AI from day one. Artificial intelligence has been part of our strategy since the beginning, blended with deep cybersecurity and insurance expertise and backed by rigorous testing.

  • Trusted by more than 100 clients, including 75% of the top 40 European and US cyber insurance carriers and 70% of the top ten reinsurance brokers.

  • Backed for global growth. In 2025 Spectrum Equity joined some of CyberCube’s financial partners as a new cornerstone investor, accelerating our global growth and fueling innovation across our end-to-end cyber risk analytics for the insurance industry.

  • A truly global team across San Francisco, New York, London, and Tallinn.

  • A culture of collaboration, openness, intellectual rigor, and ownership for excellence.

  • People at the forefront. We encourage CyberCubers to challenge themselves, push boundaries, and do the best work of their careers.

The Impact You Will Make

  • Work in a team of cyber threat analysts, economists, data scientists, actuaries and risk modelers to develop insights, scores, and features for a suite of products delivering cyber risk analytics to the (re)insurance industry

  • Own CyberCube's point of view on technology risk including factors such as:

    • Offensive capabilities and trends among threat actor classes, and validating CyberCube models against observed real-world events,

    • Security hygiene standards (e.g. NIST CSF, CIS) and mitigations for companies to lower their potential likelihood and/or impact of events, and

    • Technology adoption and trends including the adoption, reliance on and governance of artificial intelligence

… translating these factors into the assumptions and scenarios that drive risk models – especially where historical data is limited

  • Own the scenario and "event family" library for cyber catastrophe modeling, including emerging AI-driven scenarios

  • Own the assumptions register and expert-judgment governance: the documented, client-defensible rationale for modeling choices that are not purely data-driven

  • Present CyberCube methodology, threat landscape and emerging risk trends to clients and prospects and engage in strategic dialogue with key stakeholders as one of CyberCube's key voices and thought leaders on technology risk. Be able to differentiate when speaking with varying technical backgrounds and seniority (e.g. analyst to C-Suite)

  • Engage in cross functional collaboration with stakeholders from engineering, product management, analytics personnel, and client facing teams to deliver on projects and product goals

  • Deliver various cyber threat intelligence reports – e.g. threat landscape, scenario libraries, changes to mitigation and exploitation assumptions, etc. – on a quarterly cadence

The Skills and Experience You Will Bring

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in cyber security, computer science, statistics, economics, mathematics, or related field

  • 3-5 years experience in offensive and/or defensive cyber security (CISSP, CEH, CISM, CompTIA Security+, or other certification preferred)

  • Working fluency in Python / R, SQL, flat files and complex data types (JSON, XML), APIs, and Excel – enough to specify and interpret analysis with Data/Analytics teams

  • Ability to translate real-world cyber threat behavior into modeling assumptions and scenarios – e.g. scenario likelihoods, severity, and mitigation impacts

  • Intellectual curiosity, willingness to learn new skills, and push ideas forward

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills

  • Strong communication and consulting presence with key stakeholders

  • Experience working in and leading project teams

  • Ability to work in an agile, fast-paced startup environment

  • Ability to maintain relationships, collaborate effectively, and meet deadlines with a distributed, remote-first workforce

  • Ability to think creatively and respond to emerging threats (cyber, AI, other) and their modeling implications in a timely manner

The Extra Credit, or The Focus Areas You Will Develop

  • Experience with analytics and risk modeling

  • Experience in a SaaS product development environment

  • Familiarity with ML techniques and statistical data analysis

  • Familiarity with AI / LLM risk and its implications for cyber risk, social engineering, product safety, errors/omissions, and critical infrastructure

  • Familiarity with a wide variety of Internet technologies such as BGP, TCP/IP, DNS, etc.

Why You'll Love it Here

  • Play an instrumental role in reshaping one of the key industries in the world

  • Flexible working hours and the option to work remotely

  • Opportunity to participate in a secondment program

  • Company-supported mentorship program

  • Grow in a collaborative, respectful, and empathetic culture

US specific

  • Competitive salary and unlimited PTO

  • Generous healthcare benefits with medical, dental and vision coverage

  • Monthly catered lunches and happy hours

  • Company-paid learning and development assistance

  • Dependant care assistance plan

UK specific

  • Competitive salary, pension and benefits

  • Generous private medical healthcare insurance with dental and vision coverage

  • Extra vacation days during winter holidays

AI Fluency at CyberCube

AI is reshaping how work gets done across every function. We value people who are curious about AI, eager to learn, and thoughtful about applying AI tools to work more effectively. AI fluency is part of how we assess every role in our hiring process.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway.

Research shows the best candidates rarely match a job description point for point. If you're excited about this role and believe you could make an impact, we'd love to hear from you, even if your experience doesn't line up perfectly with everything listed above.

CyberCube Analytics, Inc. and CyberCube Analytics Europe Limited is an equal opportunity employer. We don’t tolerate discrimination against age, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, race, color, nationality, ethnicity, religion, disability, veteran status, protected genetic information or political affiliation.

Compensation: $115K – $140K • Multiple Ranges

  • New York • Estimated Base Salary $115K – $140K
  • London • Estimated Base Salary £80K – £95K

title: [DACH MAG] Senior Automatisierungstechniker Schicht (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Über die Position: Was steckt in der Box

Als Senior Automatisierungstechniker (all genders) übernimmst Du die Verantwortung für die Reparatur und Wartung unserer fördertechnischen Anlagen. Du arbeitest in einem dynamischen, innovativen Umfeld, das kontinuierlich an der Optimierung seiner Systeme arbeitet. Mit Deinem Fachwissen und Deinen kreativen Ideen trägst Du entscheidend zur Weiterentwicklung bei und findest gemeinsam im Team die besten Lösungen für das Unternehmen.

In dieser Schlüsselposition wirst Du maßgeblich dazu beitragen, die Verfügbarkeit und Effizienz unserer technischen Anlagen zu maximieren und unsere Prozesse kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

Hast Du Lust, an unserem modernen Standort in Barleben bei Magdeburg zu arbeiten und dabei Deine Expertise einzubringen?

Dann bewirb Dich bei uns! Wir bieten Dir ein attraktives Gehalt sowie Schichtzulagen!

Dein Aufgabenbereich: Das Rezept

  • Selbstständige Wartung und Reparatur: Eigenverantwortliche Durchführung komplexer Wartungs- und Reparaturaufgaben an automatisierten Systemen.
  • Troubleshooting und Fehleranalyse: Identifikation und Behebung von Störungen an kritischen Anlagenkomponenten.
  • Technische Unterstützung und Projektarbeit: Unterstützung bei der Planung und Durchführung technischer Projekte sowie bei Audits und Sicherheitsprüfungen.
  • Wissensweitergabe und Mentoring: Fachliche Anleitung und Unterstützung von Junior-Technikern im Tagesgeschäft.
  • Erstellung technischer Dokumentationen: Pflege und Aktualisierung der Dokumentation im CMMS-System.
  • Verbesserungsmaßnahmen: Aktive Teilnahme an Verbesserungsinitiativen und Sicherheitsprojekten zur Steigerung der Anlagenverfügbarkeit und Effizienz.
  • Inbetriebnahme neuer Komponenten: Übernahme der Inbetriebnahme und Abnahme neuer technischer Anlagen und Komponenten. 

Was du mitbringst: Die Zutaten

  • Du hast eine abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung in einem relevanten Bereich, wie z. B. als Industriemechaniker, Mechatroniker, Elektroniker o. ä.
  • Du bringst mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Automatisierung, Intralogistik, Lebensmitteltechnik oder Verpackungstechnik mit.
  • Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in Mechanik, Elektrik, Pneumatik sowie in der Fehlersuche an automatisierten Systemen (SPS, Sensorik, Antriebstechnik).
  • Du hast Erfahrung im Umgang mit CMMS-Systemen zur Dokumentation von Wartungsmaßnahmen.
  • Du kennst dich gut mit Sicherheitsvorgaben und LOTO-Prozessen (Lockout/Tagout) aus.
  • Du bist in der Lage zur Ursachenanalyse (z. B. RCA, 5-Why) und beteiligst Dich aktiv an technischen Verbesserungsprojekten.
  • Du zeigst Bereitschaft zur fachlichen Anleitung und Schulung von Junior-Technikern.
  • Du bist schichtbereit, auch an Wochenenden und Feiertagen.

Das bieten wir: Das gewisse Extra

  • Einen Wohlfühlarbeitsplatz mit einem tollen Team in Barleben bei Magdeburg
  • Rabatt eauf unsere HelloFresh Kochboxen
  • Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch interne Trainings 
  • Ein umfassendes Onboarding
  • Ein kompetitives Gehalt
  • 30 Tage Urlaub
  • Spaß bei Teamevents
  • Vergünstigte Fitnessangebote bei Urban Sports Club bzw. John Reed
  • Initiativen für das Wohlbefinden durch Kooperationen mit der Headspace-App und Spill
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • Selgros Karte
  • Persönliche Sicherheitsausrüstung

Je denkt actief mee over verbeterkansen, daagt aannames uit en vertaalt analyses naar concrete acties met aantoonbare business impact.

In deze rol werk je intensief samen met collega's van E-commerce, CRO, Product, IT, Finance en Marketing & Customer Analytics. Samen bouwen jullie aan een data gedreven organisatie waarin analyses niet alleen inzicht geven, maar vooral leiden tot betere commerciële keuzes.

My Jewellery is een van de snelst groeiende merken en e-commerce bedrijven van Nederland met internationale bekendheid. Persoonlijk, betrokken en sprankelend. Jij mag hier helemaal jezelf zijn en krijgt de ruimte om te groeien, te leren en impact te maken. Ondanks onze sterke, internationale groei blijven de lijnen kort, de structuur plat en het saamhorigheidsgevoel op hoog niveau. Als team proberen we iedere dag het verschil te maken!

title: Delivery Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we’re building the AI-powered platform that enables the world’s most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurers have been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We’re changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we’re scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world’s largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world’s first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn’t tied to title or tenure; it’s defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you’ll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the Delivery Engineering team

The hyperexponential Delivery Engineering team is a unique blend of engineers, actuaries, mathematicians and data scientists. We don’t take on traditional “transformations” (we have brilliant partners for that) – we specialise in handling only the most difficult and interesting problems our customers face, where only a combination of technical depth, market expertise and hx knowledge will do.

The Delivery Engineering team are the experts' experts of the hx platform, knowing it top-to-bottom, inside-out – both breadth and depth. You’ll learn its limits and which can be pushed. You’ll uncover every trick in the book, the secret combinations, and the shortcuts. You’ll combine all of this with a growing knowledge of insurance technology to present 'the art of the possible' to our customers and help shape cutting-edge tech, while working alongside some of the brightest, most ambitious people in the tech and insurance industries.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own end-to-end model delivery on hx, from scoping and build through to testing, iteration, and customer delivery.

  • Build and maintain production-grade Python models, applying modern engineering and modelling practices.

  • Work directly with customer actuarial teams and internal stakeholders to solve complex, ambiguous modelling and coding problems.

  • Raise quality across the team through code review, testing, and contributions to best-practice model development guidance.

  • Support and mentor junior model developers through pairing, feedback, and day-to-day delivery support.

  • Continuously look for ways to improve our model development standards, tooling, and ways of working.

What you’ll need to have done

  • Shipped and maintained production-grade Python code in complex or data-heavy environments.

  • Applied predictive modelling or advanced analytics in real-world settings (insurance or reinsurance exposure is a bonus, not a requirement).

  • Taken ownership of ambiguous problems, creating structure and driving them through to high-quality outcomes.

  • Worked directly with non-technical stakeholders or customers, translating requirements into robust technical solutions.

  • Operated effectively in a high-trust, high-accountability environment, proactively driving your own development and learning.

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

  • You prefer following detailed instructions rather than experimenting and finding your own approach.

  • You are uncomfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand their challenges.

  • You avoid tackling ambiguous or open-ended problems where the solution isn’t obvious.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Benefits

  • £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

  • 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

  • Company pension scheme via Penfold.

  • Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

  • Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

  • Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

  • Income protection and Life Insurance.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme

Additional perks

  • Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

  • Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

  • Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

  • Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

  • Initial call with our Talent team - 30 minutes

  • Take-home Python challenge followed by Skills Interview - 1 hour

  • Manager Interview - 1 hour

  • Values Interview - 1 hour

  • Meet the CEO

Our commitment to Diversity

hxer's are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure. If you’re energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

Please note that background checks will be conducted as part of the hiring process to ensure compliance with our governance policies. We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. All applicant data will be processed in accordance with data protection regulations and our privacy policy.

descriptionHtml:
🚀 About WRITER

WRITER is the AI platform built for the world’s most ambitious marketing and revenue teams, bringing the frontier of AI to the people who drive enterprise growth. With WRITER, autonomous agents work across the buyer journey, continuously executing on market signals and enterprise intelligence to grow revenue faster. Every agent action and asset is grounded in trust, built on an Enterprise Brain that unites brand, product, and company knowledge with fiduciary-grade governance and compliance.

Fortune 500 companies are transforming how they go to market with WRITER, including 3 of the top 5 US banks, 2 of the 5 largest global CPG conglomerates, and 4 of the top 5 US healthcare insurers. Founded in 2020, WRITER is backed by investors including Insight Partners, ICONIQ, Radical Ventures, Premji Invest, Balderton, B Capital, Salesforce Ventures, Adobe Ventures, Accenture, Citi Ventures, IBM Ventures, WndrCo, and others. Learn more at WRITER.com.

📐 About the role

Design engineers sit at the intersection of design and engineering. As a design engineer at WRITER, you'll own the Writer Design System (WDS) — how it's built, how it's maintained, and how both humans and AI agents use it to ship product.

This role matters more now than ever. AI coding agents write more of our production code, and they ship whatever they find. A design system that's incomplete or inconsistent doesn't just slow designers down; it gets compounded at scale by every agent that builds against it. You'll make sure WRITER's core UI library is complete and trustworthy enough to build on, working closely with the designers, PMs, and engineers who rely on it every day. You'll help shape the surfaces that define how our product feels to use, and help set the standard and process for how the EPD org ships product.

This is a hybrid role based out of our San Francisco, Chicago, Austin, New York City, Seattle, or London hubs. This role will be reporting to the Director of product design.

We are open to hiring for this role at multiple levels, with compensation ranges scaled to match your experience, expertise, and the scope of the role.

🦸🏻‍♀️ What you'll do

  • Own the Writer Design System (WDS) as your primary domain — agentify and maintain it, ensuring it's optimized for both humans and AI agents building with it

  • Design and build production-quality UI components and features, owning surfaces from sketch to ship

  • Ship design-led work that wouldn't survive an engineering backlog — polish passes, micro-interactions, and brand moments that make the product feel alive

  • Architect new primitives and extend the system's core components, shaping its technical direction while keeping documentation, examples, and libraries in sync across Figma, .md skills, and Storybook

  • Uphold the bar for front-end craft across accessibility, motion feel, consistency, and quality, ensuring accessibility is baked into every design system component

  • Help shape the design-to-code workflow, researching the latest tools and practices to unlock org-wide productivity and democratize workflows across the EPD organization

  • Partner with designers, PMs, and engineering leads to measure WDS adoption, close gaps, and make sure shipped features meet design system standards

⭐️ What you need

  • 4–8+ years building production frontends with TypeScript and React, with a track record of owning a system, platform, or surface end-to-end rather than individual features

  • Solid instincts for animation principles including easing curves, choreography, anticipation, follow-through, interruptibility, and perceived performance

  • Fluency in Figma at expert level — auto-layout, variants, variables, and code connect — and proficiency with design engineering technologies like framer-motion, gsap, and lottie for web-based animation

  • A demonstrable obsession with craft, backed by a portfolio, side projects, GitHub, or production work that includes systems-level work and not just feature work

  • Experience driving adoption of a design system or shared platform across an engineering org, with a track record of influencing technical or design direction beyond your immediate team

  • Experience with AI product surfaces — tool-call UIs, streaming responses, agent state, and dynamic UI rendering — and comfort navigating ambiguous, cross-team problems with good judgment about when to loop others in

  • A genuine commitment to WRITER's values of Connect, Challenge, and Own

title: Director, Engineering - Partnerships
descriptionHtml:
With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion. 

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

About the Job

We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead the Global Partnerships engineering organization across Solutions Engineering, Integrations, and API Platform. This leader will combine product engineering judgment, technical depth, customer empathy, and operating discipline to make our partnership ecosystem easier to build on and easier to scale.

You will lead the Solutions Engineering and the engineering teams responsible for partner integrations and API platform capabilities. You will work closely with Product, Partnerships, RSS, Support, Security, Legal, and other engineering leaders to turn partner and business needs into durable platform capabilities.

This role is ideal for a leader who can move comfortably between strategy and execution: setting direction, simplifying an operating model, making hard prioritization calls, guiding architecture, handling high-severity escalations, and developing managers and senior technical leaders.

Responsibilities

  • Set the strategy and portfolio for partner integrations, APIs, developer experience and Solutions Engineering making clear trade-offs across business value, partner commitments, reliability, and capacity.
  • Build a scalable Solutions Engineering model with disciplined intake, prioritization, escalation, SLAs, and communication. Identify opportunities to build a better operating model by collaborating with support, RSS and other cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Lead the technical direction for API Platform and Integrations, and how agentic development can transform the developer experience both internally as well as for external developers using our platform.
  • Turn recurring partner’s identified problems and gaps into durable improvements in product, process and documentation.
  • Build trusted relationships across Partnerships, RSS, Product, Support, Security, Legal and Engineering. Make timely decisions when priorities conflict and communicate outcomes, risks, and trade-offs clearly.
  • Lead and develop managers and senior technical leaders, strengthen delegation and succession, and earn the opportunity to expand the organization’s scope through demonstrated results.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Significant experience leading engineering organizations that include multiple teams and managers.
  • Experience with APIs, distributed systems, platform engineering, developer experience, integrations, or another technically complex B2B ecosystem.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to communicate clearly with executives, engineers, partners, and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A track record of hiring, coaching, and developing managers and senior engineers.
  • Enough technical depth to review architecture, ask incisive questions, assess risk, and make sound trade-offs without needing to be the primary implementer.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a marketplace, B2B SaaS, platform, developer products, payments, hospitality, commerce, or integration-heavy business.
  • Experience leading or partnering closely with Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Engineering, Technical Account Management, or a similar function.
  • Experience moving a high-touch onboarding or support model toward self-service, automation, AI-assisted support, or risk-based engagement.
  • Experience driving productivity, innovation, and operational improvements using AI development tooling.
  • Experience working with external partners, enterprise customers, sales, business development, security, legal, or revenue operations.
  • Strong background in data-driven decision making, metrics definition, and performance optimization for high-scale enterprise platforms.
  • Experience with API lifecycle management, OAuth/SSO, developer portals, certification, SDKs, event-driven systems, observability, or partner data access.
  • Experience operating across globally distributed teams and time zones.

  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year

title: Director of Internal Audit
descriptionHtml:
Help make the world more hospitable

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

You’ll design and build Mews’ SOX and internal controls programme from the ground up, deciding how controls are scoped, owned, tested and evidenced across financial reporting, operations and technology. This role exists because the company needs a control framework that holds up as it grows across entities and regulated financial services. You’ll work hands-on with process owners across the business, with the mandate to make the controls work in practice.

Part 1: You’ll set up the framework and roadmap, assign control owners, and lead testing and remediation. You’ll work directly with process owners, Technology, Legal, Compliance and Risk, and report progress and significant risks to senior leadership and governance bodies.

Part 2: Business and functional owners run their own controls, so the job is to set clear standards and provide independent verification that those controls operate as designed. The problem to solve is a control environment that is sustainable, evidenced and audit-ready, rather than one assembled for each audit.

What you would do (change to Heading 4)

  • Build and implement Mews’ SOX and internal controls programme end to end, from risk-based scoping and control design through rollout, testing, remediation and management certification, on an achievable roadmap.
  • Establish a COSO-aligned, company-wide control framework with named control owners, clear evidence requirements and periodic owner certifications.
  • Turn local, EU and financial-services regulatory control expectations into one coordinated implementation plan with Legal, Compliance and Risk.
  • Drive testing of IT general controls, and set validation standards for critical reports, spreadsheets and AI-supported evidence, working with process owners to close gaps and verify fixes.
  • Set the risk-based monitoring plan, establish AI governance and controls over AI-enabled finance processes, and report progress and significant risks to leadership.

AI Fluency Level 4: This is an AI Fluency Level 4 role, which means you’d build AI-powered systems rather than only using AI in your own work. Here that could mean building the monitoring and evidence tools that test controls over AI-enabled finance processes, using automation and continuous monitoring to check that controls operate, with the human oversight and audit trails that keep them credible. For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to “AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates” on Confluence.

What you would bring (change to Heading 4)

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in internal audit, SOX, internal controls or risk assurance, including 3+ years leading teams or significant cross-functional programmes.
  • Proven experience building and rolling out a SOX or COSO-based controls programme, not only testing an established one, including control design, owner accountability, certification and sustainable remediation.
  • Experience in an international, multi-entity environment, with working knowledge of IT general controls, system interfaces, access and change management, and data reliability.
  • Ability to influence senior stakeholders and present clear, risk-based findings, with experience engaging external auditors, regulators where applicable, and consultants.
  • AI Fluency Level 4: you have built AI-powered tools or systems that others use, with a working understanding of AI governance, evidence validation and human oversight.

Nice to have (change to Heading 4)

  • A relevant professional qualification such as CIA, CPA, ACA, ACCA or CISA.
  • Hands-on experience with GRC or SOX management platforms such as AuditBoard or Workiva, plus familiarity with Jira or similar tools.
  • Experience in technology, SaaS or fintech.
UK£105,500—£133,000 GBP

Pay Transparency at Mews

Salary ranges are provided in good faith and reflect current market conditions and internal pay structures. Final compensation may be adjusted based on funding, budget constraints, or exceptional candidate qualifications, but will remain within reasonable proximity to the stated range.

This salary disclosure is provided in compliance with applicable pay transparency legislation. We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.

If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process - your recruiter will be able to help.

What’s in it for you?

Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.

Global benefits

No matter where you’re based, you’ll enjoy:

  • Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)
  • Participation in our company share program
  • Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)
  • An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development
  • Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself
  • A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year
  • Relocation options, available after one year
  • Flexible, hybrid working options
  • A home office setup budget to make your workspace your own and a monthly work-from-home allowance
  • Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working

Local benefits

You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.

Life at Mews

We’re an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger products and a more welcoming company.

We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.

A few things that define how we work:

  • High autonomy means high responsibility. People are expected to take ownership and drive outcomes. There isn’t a detailed playbook for everything, and that’s part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.
  • Change is constant. We’re growing quickly and adapting as we scale. Teams, processes and priorities continue to evolve, and only people who stay curious and agile will thrive.
  • We’re remote-first, not relationship-free. Flexibility is core to how we work, but strong relationships still matter. Our teams are global, so we need expert collaborators and communicators to help us move forward together.
  • AI is an integral part of our processes. It’s not here to steal people’s jobs, but to amplify efficiency and productivity. We’re motivated to proactively use the technology to seek out better ways of working and share our findings with the rest of the company.

If there's anything we can do to support you during the application process, let us know.

We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other protected characteristic.

One final thing: don't hold back. If you don't meet 100% of the criteria in this job description but you're certain you could make a big impact, apply. Everyone should have equal access to opportunities, and we're committed to providing an inclusive experience.

If Mews sounds like the kind of environment where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Director, Operational Readiness
descriptionHtml:
About Nscale

Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.

We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you'll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.

About the Role

We're hiring a Director, Operational Readiness to build and lead Nscale's portfolio-level readiness capability, ensuring every new site, capacity expansion, and major infrastructure deployment is truly ready for production.

Reporting to the Sr. Director, Technical Program Management, you'll set up the readiness framework, gates, scorecards, and transition model that bring our infrastructure into steady-state operations. You'll work across Development, Construction, Commissioning, Technical Program Management, Network, Compute, Security, Procurement, Legal, vendors, and Operations to surface dependencies early, manage exceptions, and align readiness with customer and operational milestones.

Operational Readiness doesn't replace program delivery, technical acceptance, or on-site Operations. It connects them. You'll provide the common model and portfolio-level assurance that leadership relies on to make confident go-live decisions, and you'll lead a growing team of Sr. Project Managers and Technical Writers who carry out readiness across our sites and regions.

What You'll be Doing

Readiness Operating Model & Portfolio Integration
• Build and lead Nscale's Operational Readiness capability and team, establishing and continuously improving the readiness lifecycle, gates, standards, governance, and escalation framework
• Define minimum readiness requirements across people, process, technology, tooling, documentation, training, vendor support, monitoring, ownership, and risk
• Establish clear readiness interfaces with Development, Construction, Commissioning, Technical Program Management, Network, Compute, Security, Procurement, Legal, vendors, and Operations
• Build integrated readiness plans that connect milestones, gates, dependencies, evidence, ownership, and decisions, and drive cross-functional gaps to clear ownership and resolution
• Maintain forward visibility into upcoming sites, expansions, and infrastructure programs so readiness work starts early

Readiness Assurance & Transition
• Own the portfolio readiness scorecard as the single source for readiness reporting to executive leadership, covering status, material risks, dependencies, exceptions, and required decisions
• Govern the readiness gate process into steady-state Operations and issue formal gate recommendations for site go-live approval
• Make sure material readiness exceptions are resolved, deferred, or explicitly accepted by the appropriate functional or executive authority
• Keep a clear line between readiness assurance and the technical acceptance authority held by Commissioning, Engineering, and Operations
• Run early-life reviews on newly transitioned infrastructure and turn findings into stronger readiness standards and deployment practices

Standards & Documentation
• Make sure readiness documentation, evidence, standards, and transition artifacts are complete, consistent, and reusable

Deine Aufgaben

Als Embedded Software Entwickler übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle bei der Weiterentwicklung der Flugsteuerungs- und Bedienersoftware unserer Drohnensysteme.

  • Flight Control: Technische Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung der Flugsteuerungssoftware und deren zuverlässigen Betrieb auf der Zielhardware.

  • Bereitschaft zur regelmäßigen Arbeit vor Ort sowie zur Teilnahme an Flugtests und gelegentlichen Kundeneinsätzen.

  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse

Nice to have

descriptionHtml:
Joining Mines Saint-Étienne means committing to an institution where science and innovation build a more sustainable future. It is a school of excellence where everyone has the opportunity to unlock their full potential and contribute to tackling the challenges of tomorrow.

Ranked among the top engineering schools in France and recognized worldwide, our school, a member of the Institut Mines-Télécom, educates the talents of tomorrow while actively addressing major industrial, digital, and environmental challenges. By joining us, you become part of a community of 500 members of staff, 2,500 students and take part in an ambitious project: combining academic excellence, cutting-edge research, and positive societal impact.

The Institut Mines-Télécom brings together France’s leading Grandes Ecoles to tackle major industrial, digital, energy, and environmental challenges. With its eight public Grandes Écoles and two affiliated Graduate Schools, it is the leading public institute dedicated to engineers and managers. Together, we imagine and build a sustainable future by educating the leaders who will shape tomorrow’s transitions.

🎯 What we expect from you

As a Postdoctoral Researcher or Research Engineer, you will perform research and innovation activities in the field of soft electronics and optical sensing for artificial skin applications. Within the Centre of Microelectronics and the Flexible Electronics Department (FEL), you will contribute to the development of stretchable optical waveguides and their integration into artificial skin demonstrators.

The flexible electronics department develops technological and scientific knowledge in the field of soft electronics. The department has a strong knowledge in the field of material and interface electrical and mechanical characterization. The activities of the department are regrouped in the 660m2-area platform. This technological platform regroups facilities and technological equipment for R&D activities in Micropackaging, micro and nano-electronics, in a clean room of 220m² 1000-class and 400m² 10000-class.

Stretchable electronics can also be combined with optical systems such as waveguides. These devices will be developed to create artificial skin with pressure and temperature sensing capabilities.

Within this project, the work will focus on the fabrication and characterization of stretchable optical waveguides, as well as on fabrication and integration techniques for optical components (LEDs / photodiodes). A related publication is “Transparent, Optical, Pressure-Sensitive Artificial Skin for Large-Area Stretchable Electronics” (https://doi.org/10.1002/adma.201200523).

The main activities will include:

· Fabrication and characterization of elastomer waveguides for pressure and temperature sensing applications.

· Integration of optically pressure- or temperature-sensitive materials into the elastomer waveguides.

· Characterization and validation of complete sensing devices.

The fabrication processes and experimental setups are already available. However, good knowledge of Python is important for operating and further developing the test benches. Hands-on laboratory work is essential and will be partly performed in our clean room facility.

The expected outcome is the demonstration of radically new soft optical sensing devices with features and functions that cannot be achieved with conventional electronic approaches. This work is part of a European project involving multiple partners across Europe, including ETH Zurich (ETHZ), the University of Oxford, Johannes Kepler University Linz, EMPA…

We support each of our employees on the path to excellence, with the conviction that together, we can have a lasting and significant impact on our world.

Joining Mines Saint-Etienne is the opportunity to find:

title: Engineering Internship - Deep Learning for Infrared Thermography Antenna Measurements
descriptionHtml:
THE POSITION

ANYFIELDS measures antennas by infrared thermography: a thermosensitive film heated by the radiated field is imaged by an infrared camera, giving a 2D map of the electric field, nonintrusive and very close to the antenna. Two limits remain: the maps are noisy (dynamic range of 25 to 30 dB at best, 35 to 40 dB needed to retrieve side lobes and cross-polarization), and they are blurred by the response of the detector (film and optics), whose resolution is not explained by the theory.

This internship develops physics-driven neural networks, trained without any clean reference, to restore the maps, and compares them rigorously with the conventional methods already implemented.

Missions :

  • Benchmark synthetic and measured datasets, reproduction of the conventional methods (wavelet denoising, drift removal, deconvolution, slanted edge).

  • Estimate PSF of the detector: neural network constrained by the film heat diffusion and the optics, estimated from a few measurements; explain the gap between the theoretical (about 1 mm) and measured (4 to 8 mm) resolution. Compare with conventional methods.

  • Implement Denoising by self-supervised deep denoising of the maps, quantified gain in dB towards 35 to 40 dB, ranking of the limiting factors of the setup.

  • Validate by test whether the imaging resolves the individual elements of array antennas in the Ku and Ka bands, before and after improvement. Report on the retained methods.

You will work at the crossroads of electromagnetics, imaging and deep learning, with the engineers of the Innovation team.

Location: Toulouse (city centre)

Start: As soon as possible

Duration: 6 months

Profile

  • Bac+5 - Engineering school / Master in applied mathematics, signal and image processing, machine learning and/or electromagnetics

  • Programming skills (preferably Python), experience with a deep learning framework

  • Knowledge of inverse problems or infrared cameras is a plus

  • Team spirit, proactive attitude and good communication skills in an interdisciplinary team

En tant qu’Engineering Manager, ton rôle est de manager jusqu’à 4 tech leads, soit de chapeauter la réussite de 4 projets, en binôme avec un(e) Group Project Manager. title: Engineering Manager - Stock Trading App
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Enterprise Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
Studytube is een Nederlands SaaS-bedrijf. We bouwen een alles-in-één leerplatform (LMS en LXP) voor Learning & Development en HR. Als Enterprise Account Executive begeleid je organisaties met 1.000+ medewerkers naar een aankoopbeslissing. In het proces van oriëntatie, tot strategievorming, tot het daadwerkelijk ingaan van een inkooptraject ben jij de trusted partner. Je schakelt daarmee op meerdere niveaus inclusief C-niveau en met verschillende stakeholders intern en extern.

Je weet hoe een complex salestraject werkt. Er zijn meerdere beslissers, een inkoopafdeling die kritisch onderhandelt en een directie die wil weten wat de business case is. Juist dat trekt je aan. Bij Studytube krijg je de ruimte om grote organisaties te helpen impact te laten maken door hun mensen te ontwikkelen.

Waarom dit werk ertoe doet

Er worden miljarden uitgegeven aan opleidingen en organisaties investeren significant in opleiden. Toch mist meer dan de helft van de medewerkers nog steeds de skills die ze nodig hebben. Skills veranderen sneller dan functies kunnen bijhouden en voor organisaties zijn juist die nieuwe skills cruciaal. Studytube brengt dat samen in één leerplatform. Het platform maakt skill gaps zichtbaar en stemt leren af op de strategie van de organisatie. Jij voert dat gesprek met de mensen die erover beslissen en Studytube ontwikkelt door vanuit een heldere missie: "maak leren voor iedereen persoonlijk”. Je zult begrijpen dat AI op vele manieren verweven is met onze leerinfrastructuur en vanuit onze Innovatie Hub investeren we hier fors in.


Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de acquisitie van enterprise-accounts in de Benelux en sectoren als bouw & installatie, retail, staffing en facilities. Je doel is nieuwe logo’s binnenhalen met een gemiddelde dealgrootte van €6k MRR. Je regisseert het hele traject, van het eerste gesprek met de CHRO tot het getekende contract. Je wordt beoordeeld op één ding: nieuwe business die blijft en groeit.

  • Je opent deuren op directieniveau en bouwt een businesscase die overeind blijft bij de CFO en bij Inkoop.

  • Je stuurt de deal teams aan: Solution Engineering, Legal, Security en Delivery. Zij leveren, jij houdt de regie.

  • Je forecast scherp, en een commit is bij jou ook echt een commit.

Wat jij meebrengt

  • 7 jaar of meer ervaring in B2B-sales, waarvan minimaal 4 jaar als Enterprise AE in SaaS.

  • Je hebt je target meerdere jaren achter elkaar behaald of overtroffen, en je laat de cijfers graag zien.

  • Je sluit deals van tussen de €50k - €200k ARR, met cycli van 6 tot 12 maanden en een brede groep beslissers.

  • Je beheerst MEDDICC of Challenger zo goed dat je er anderen in kunt coachen.

  • Ervaring in HR-tech of L&D is een pré, maar geen vereiste.

Wat je van ons krijgt

  • Een goed salaris. OTE van €140k - €160k, variabel zonder plafond en met accelerators boven 100%.

  • Een warm portfolio met bestaande relaties en ook een open gebied ondersteund door DemandGen, een SDR team, een Bid Team en Solution Engineer.

  • Een product dat de vraagstukken van grote organisaties oplost: skills, AI en persoonlijk leren.

  • Directe lijnen naar het MT en ruimte om mee te bouwen aan hoe enterprise-sales bij Studytube werkt.

  • Een echt groeipad. We werken in PODs, en voor de juiste persoon is POD Lead een logische volgende stap.

  • Flexibiliteit. Jij bepaalt waar en wanneer je het beste werk levert. Je combineert thuiswerken met 3 dagen op kantoor en deelt je agenda in zoals het bij jouw leven past. Wil je ’s ochtends een klant bezoeken en ’s middags de kinderen uit school halen? Dat kan gewoon. We sturen op resultaat, niet op aanwezigheid.

  • Een kantoor waar je graag bent. Er is een eigen gym en we verzorgen de lunches. Daarnaast zijn er teamuitjes en bijeenkomsten om successen samen te vieren.

Over Studytube

Studytube begon in 2011 bij twee rechtenstudenten. Ze bouwden een studietool voor zichzelf en ontdekten hoeveel beter mensen leren als het leren op hén is afgestemd. Dat inzicht is nog steeds de kern van wat we doen. Onze missie is het volledige potentieel van mensen ontsluiten met persoonlijk leren, op grote schaal.

Ons leerplatform combineert een LMS, een leeromgeving met AI-aanbevelingen, een Skill Navigator en een marketplace met meer dan 1.000 opleiders. Meer dan 700+ organisaties werken met Studytube, van 50 tot 30.000 medewerkers. Daaronder zijn bol, a.s.r., CZ, ManpowerGroup en VolkerWessels. Met 200+ collega’s werken we aan één doel: het platform voor professionele ontwikkeling worden waar Europa op vertrouwt.
