title: QA Engineer - Payments
descriptionHtml:
SumUp is already live in 38 markets and still growing. Our Global Expansion Team takes SumUp's payment products into new countries, with Mexico and Canada among our most recent launches and more markets like New Zealand and Argentina on the way. As a QA Engineer in our Berlin payments team, you'll build the automated and manual tests that decide when a new card reader can go live in a market, across frontend, backend and mobile flows, and you'll also help complete L3 certification (the final round of testing that acquiring banks and card networks require). It's hands-on engineering work with real launch impact, because your tests help new markets go live and recently launched ones stay stable, so small businesses there can take card payments with confidence.

What you'll do

  • Build and maintain frontend and backend test automation, with mobile where relevant, and add targeted regression tests to continuous integration (CI) workflows so market specific checks run consistently after code changes
  • Test SumUp products across markets, with a mix of automated and manual testing, functional, integration and regression checks, plus edge cases and recovery scenarios.
  • Spot ways to improve how we test, explain why they matter and make a convincing case for the changes with the biggest payoff
  • Trace failures through complex payment flows using logs and transaction traces, then raise clear, prioritised defects and work with engineers and external partners until they're fixed
  • Own the testing of end-to-end communication between a payment terminal, software applications, and an acquiring network. with acquiring banks and card networks, and keep the team informed on certification status, quality risks and release readiness so launch decisions rest on evidence
  • Work closely in collaboration with engineers, product and market-launch teams, as well as acquirers, card schemes and certification labs.

What you'll bring

  • Programming or scripting skill to build and maintain automated tests for frontend web and backend APIs, and comfort reading code in languages such as Golang, Kotlin, Java or others on our Tech Radar.
  • Experience testing software both manually and with automation, including turning requirements into test scenarios and deciding what to automate first based on customer, launch and technical risk.
  • Ability to analyse logs, transaction traces and test results, and to write defect reports that include reproduction steps, expected versus actual behaviour, impact and evidence.
  • Comfort working with Git and Jira (or similar tools)
  • Experience with SQL and test-data setup, contract testing, mocking or service virtualisation.
  • An engineering mindset: the ability to spot what can be improved, explain the reasoning and persuade others with clear evidence
  • A curious, ownership minded approach: seeking out context when things are unclear and using AI tools where they help.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Card payments, payment terminals, acquirers, card schemes or certification labs.
  • Market launches, device integrations, external technical partners or business-to-business communication.

Payments experience is helpful but not required. We'll support you in learning card payments, devices and the certification process.

Why you should join SumUp

  • 🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first set up
  • 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced
  • 🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success
  • 📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education
  • 💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions
  • 🏖️ Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days
  • 🚵🏾‍♂️ Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, subsidised office lunches
  • 🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service
  • 🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don’t tick every box, it’s ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

title: Relationship Manager - Thames Valley
descriptionHtml:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Our vision is to reimagine Relationship Banking for established SMEs, through the very best people, products and digital tools. We don’t pretend to have all the answers yet, and you will play a role in continuing to shape our offering.

Our Relationship Manager team was formed in 2022 and continues to grow with the Bank at pace. Providing every customer who opens an account with us with a Relationship Manager, to work alongside them and provide outstanding service, is core to our strategy.

In addition to providing outstanding service, our Relationship Managers build deep levels of understanding and trust with their customers, and get to understand their ambitions, goals and motivations. Allica Relationship Managers support their customers through the provision of appropriate Allica Bank products including Business Current Accounts, Savings Accounts, Commercial Loans, Asset Finance and Working Capital Facilities.

All Relationship Manager roles at Allica Bank carry a requirement for new business acquisition as we continue to build the bank. Where portfolios are held, they are built to allow capacity to do this. Relationship Managers will bring, and continue to build, a strong network of trusted SME advisors such as accountants, solicitors, business organisations and others (but not commercial finance brokers – these are looked after by our dedicated broker team).

Principal Accountabilities

  • Relationship Manage a portfolio of SME customers, understanding customer’s needs and business aspirations, and looking for opportunities to support them via Allica Bank services and through their own external networks

  • Originating SME lending opportunities for both existing and new customers from initial enquiry through to completion, including writing credit papers in line with Allica’s credit policy and appetite.

  • Delivering the business plan for your local area, and actively managing your objectives and personal development plan.

  • Making your colleagues proud that you represent Allica in your local area, by ensuring excellent service for local SME customers, prospects and advisors.

  • Working closely and collaboratively with all areas of Allica to ensure a seamless and professional service is always provided.

  • Being a positive contributor to Allica’s culture, and always demonstrating the bank’s values

  • Complying with all mandatory policies, and adherence to operational procedures to maintain internal controls.

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • A strong understanding of SME banking, which must include a background in commercial lending.

  • Able to demonstrate a history of exemplary level of service, and of maximising the value with prospects and customers.

  • Be able to demonstrate a passion for SMEs, be a self-starter and bring an entrepreneurial mindset to your work.

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills together with evidence of strong career progression and/or outperformance.

  • Be able to evidence an ability to work expertly with customers, colleagues and advisors to structure new lending proposals and write credit applications.

  • A proven track record in providing excellent customer service, and in generating new income opportunities whilst effectively managing credit risk.

  • An ability to analyse and review financial accounts and associated information.

Über die Position als Accounting Product Specialist

Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen Buchhaltungsexpertise und Produktentwicklung. Dabei stellst du die technische Qualität und die Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorgaben unserer Software für die Buchhaltung sicher.

Was bedeutet Erfolg in dieser Rolle?

Die drei wichtigsten Verantwortungsbereiche

  1. Du berätst das Product-Team, beantwortest Fragen und teilst dein Fachwissen, damit buchhalterische Funktionen korrekt entwickelt werden.

  2. Du testest das Produkt und meldest Fehler sowie Feedback an das Product-Team.

  3. Du schulst andere Personen im Umgang mit dem Produkt, insbesondere zu buchhalterischen Themen. Dazu gehören externe Zielgruppen, wie die Steuerkanzleien, mit denen wir zusammenarbeiten werden, sowie interne Zielgruppen, zum Beispiel neue Mitarbeitende in den Bereichen Product, Sales und Support. Du erstellst dafür geeignete Schulungsunterlagen und organisierst entsprechende Sessions.

Dein erwarteter Beitrag in den ersten sechs Monaten

  • Du dokumentierst zentrales Wissen zur französischen und deutschen Buchhaltung sowie zur Funktionsweise des deutschen Produkts.

  • Du schulst die ersten Steuerkanzleien, die Pennylane Deutschland nutzen.

  • Du unterstützt bei der Einstellung und Schulung wichtiger Teammitglieder, insbesondere in den Bereichen Partner Success und Customer Success.

Deine Verantwortlichkeiten

Fachliche Expertise

  • Du unterstützt die Product-Teams bei der Entwicklung und Validierung buchhalterischer und steuerlicher Funktionen, zum Beispiel durch Workshops und die Prüfung von Prototypen.

  • Du hilfst dabei, buchhalterische und steuerliche Anforderungen in klare und verständliche Produktspezifikationen zu übersetzen.

  • Du dokumentierst Produktentscheidungen unter Berücksichtigung buchhalterischer und steuerlicher Vorschriften.

  • Du hinterfragst vorgeschlagene Lösungen aus buchhalterischer und steuerlicher Sicht. Bei Bedarf priorisierst du unterschiedliches Feedback von Nutzer:innen und triffst entsprechende Entscheidungen.

Qualitätssicherung

  • Du wirkst bei der Definition buchhaltungsbezogener Testszenarien mit.

  • Du überprüfst die Korrektheit und Konformität von Berechnungen, Buchungssätzen, Abschlüssen, Finanzberichten und Steuererklärungen.

  • Du stellst sicher, dass das erwartete buchhalterische Ergebnis einer Funktion erreicht wird.

Wissensmanagement und Schulungen

  • Du erstellst und pflegst technische Dokumentationen zu buchhalterischen und steuerlichen Themen.

  • Du schulst interne Teams zu wichtigen Buchhaltungskonzepten.

  • Du moderierst Sessions zum Wissensaustausch.

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung: Du hast mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer Steuerkanzlei oder im Rechnungswesen. Du bist es gewohnt, mit Mandant:innen und Steuerberater:innen zusammenzuarbeiten, und verfügst über Erfahrung in der Erstellung von Jahresabschlüssen.

  • Fachkenntnisse: Du verfügst über ein fundiertes Verständnis des gesamten Buchhaltungsprozesses und hast Erfahrung mit Abschlussarbeiten, insbesondere mit Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen.

  • Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung aus einer Steuerkanzlei oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld mit.

  • Wünschenswert: Du hast ein gutes übergeordnetes Verständnis von Buchhaltung und kennst die Unterschiede zwischen verschiedenen Steuerkanzleien, Tools wie DATEV sowie regionale Besonderheiten.

  • Sprachen: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch.

  • Du bist neugierig und verfügst über die Fähigkeit, komplexe buchhalterische Themen für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen klar, verständlich und praxisnah zu erklären.

title: B2B Marketing - India
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're looking for a senior B2B Growth Marketer to build and scale demand generation for ElevenLabs in India. This is a hands-on, in-country role focused on generating enterprise pipeline, growing our brand with technical buyers, and creating programs that become benchmarks for B2B marketing in AI.

Your work will shape how Indian businesses discover, evaluate, and adopt ElevenLabs. The goal is to build repeatable marketing engines that make ElevenLabs the top choice for every enterprise.

 

What you'll do

  • Build integrated B2B marketing campaigns end to end across India's priority industries from strategy and messaging through execution and measurement.

  • Localize and execute programs across ABM, content, events, webinars, partner/customer marketing, executive branding, product launches, and outbound - choosing the right channel for the problem rather than owning a single function.

  • Adapt global campaigns and messaging for the Indian market, and feed local insights (buyer behavior, competitive dynamics, regulatory context) back to the global team.

  • Partner closely with local sales and the global product marketing, growth, and design teams to keep messaging consistent and execute high-impact campaigns.

  • Own pipeline generation and campaign performance for the market, using data to measure results, run experiments, and continuously improve what works.

 

Requirements

  • 5 to 7 years of experience at a high-growth technology company - you've built and scaled B2B demand generation programs that created measurable enterprise pipeline, and you know what moved the needle.

  • Ownership Pedigree: You have implemented growth and marketing projects from start to finish and held yourself accountable for the ROI.

  • Deep knowledge of the Indian market: its enterprise buyers, media landscape, and business culture, ideally with an existing network.

  • Work well without much process. This role spans multiple marketing functions and needs someone who sets priorities, spots opportunities, and moves quickly as our first marketer in the market.

  • Relentless commitment to excellence — a high bar for quality, clarity, and impact.

  • Curious about AI, follows the technology ecosystem closely, and has exceptional judgment on what makes marketing stand out.

title: Compliance & Security Lead
descriptionHtml:
About Trigger.dev

Trigger.dev is an open source platform used by developers to build production-grade AI agents. It's an SDK and the infrastructure to run agents reliably at scale, so teams can focus on the product instead of the plumbing.

Our Cloud product is a managed service where we deploy our users' code and auto-scale from zero to millions of executions. With the rise of AI, being able to offload async tasks reliably is a key part of any developer's toolkit: We're building the infrastructure to make that a reality.

About the position

We're looking for our first Compliance & Security Lead to own security compliance and data protection at Trigger.dev. You'll report to the founders, and work closely with engineering.

We already hold SOC 2 Type II, run our program through Oneleet, and publish a trust portal covering SOC 2, GDPR and HIPAA. Until now the founders and engineers have handled compliance alongside their day jobs. As we grow, customers send more security questionnaires, ask for more reports and negotiate more DPAs. Now we need somebody to own this, keep it running all year, and free our engineers to build.

You don’t need to be an engineer, but technical experience is a bonus. This role suits someone process-minded who likes making compliance practical, rather than just ticking boxes.

What you'll be doing

You'll do a variety of things including:

  • Running our SOC 2 and HIPAA programs: owning our SOC 2 audit, managing evidence collection in Oneleet and keeping us audit-ready all year

  • Using AI and automation to speed up compliance work, from drafting questionnaire answers to collecting evidence and reviewing policies

  • Completing security questionnaires and vendor assessments, sharing our reports and bridge letters, and keeping our trust portal current

  • Reviewing and negotiating DPAs with customers and suppliers, working with our lawyers, keeping our records of processing up to date and handling data subject requests under UK and EU GDPR

  • Writing and maintaining our security, privacy and data retention policies, and making sure retention periods are enforced

  • Reviewing new tools and sub-processors before we adopt them, and keeping our sub-processor list current

  • Deciding when we need new frameworks, such as ISO 27001 or ISO 42001 (the AI management standard), and leading the work to get there

  • Making compliance seamless for the team: onboarding training, simple processes and automated evidence collection wherever possible

  • Keeping our incident response and breach notification process ready, and testing it each year

Requirements

You really need to have:

  • 5+ years in security compliance, GRC or data protection, ideally at a SaaS or developer tools company

  • Experience at an early-stage startup as the first or only compliance hire, with full ownership

  • Hands-on experience running a SOC 2 audit, from evidence collection through to the final report

  • An up to date working knowledge of UK and EU GDPR, and experience reviewing or negotiating DPAs

  • Experience completing security questionnaires accurately and quickly

  • Clear, plain writing - you can turn a policy into something engineers will read

  • Enough technical understanding to talk to engineers about cloud infrastructure, access control and logging (you don't need to write code)

  • If you are remote you must be within CET to ET timezones (GMT+1:00 to GMT-5:00). We will arrange 3 in-person events throughout the year

You'll be an amazing fit if you:

  • Have experience with ISO 27001 or HIPAA

  • Have used a compliance automation platform such as Oneleet, Vanta or Drata

  • Hold a privacy or security certification, such as CIPP/E, CISA or CISSP

  • Use AI tools to speed up questionnaires, evidence review and policy work

  • Are based in the UK and able to join the team in London

About the team

  • We are a small team with a flat hierarchy

  • We encourage continuous learning and personal development

  • Everyone operates autonomously; we trust you to get the job done, but to also quickly raise your hand if you need help

  • We care about our customers and the open-source community

  • Being a start-up, the work is challenging and fast-paced, but we also understand the importance of taking time off to recharge

Working at a Commercial Open Source Software company is more than just your day job

  • Our code is public, so anyone can see how we build and run our platform. We want our security and compliance to be just as open.

  • We publish our security reports and trust portal, so customers can check our work instead of taking our word for it.

  • Customers trust us with their code and data. We’re open about how we protect it.

Benefits

  • Generous compensation and equity - We hire the best talent and pay to reflect that. We also offer equity as a way to ensure everyone is invested in the success of the company.

  • Async working - Need a heads-down day or meeting-free days to stay productive? No problem!

  • Home office - We will help provide equipment for a comfortable setup so you're as productive at home as you are in the office.

  • Health insurance - Private health insurance, with Vitality for our UK team.

  • Dog and cat friendly office - Our London office welcomes four-legged colleagues.

  • Generous vacation - We believe it's important to take time off. We encourage you to take your 25 days vacation excluding national holidays, plus sick leave and generous parental leave.

  • Training budget - An annual budget to contribute towards learning such as purchasing books, an Audible subscription or online courses.

  • Pension contributions - Enroll in our company pension scheme or we'll contribute directly to your private pension.

descriptionHtml:
Steuerberatung radikal anders – jetzt mitgestalten

Du bist Steuerberater:in und willst nicht einfach nur eine weitere Kanzlei – sondern eine, die neue Wege geht?

Dann werde Teil von b’steuern, einer digitalen Steuerberatung mit Sitz in Berlin – und einem radikal anderen Selbstverständnis. Wir kombinieren steuerliche Exzellenz mit Automatisierung, unternehmerischer Klarheit und selbstorganisierten Teams.

Über uns

Wir denken Steuerberatung neu.

b’steuern steht für eine agile, digitale und selbstorganisierte Kanzlei.

Unser Anspruch: Steuerberatung, die nicht verwaltet – sondern gestaltet.

Wir entwickeln maßgeschneiderte Lösungen für FinTech- und TaxTech-Anbieter sowie deren Kunden – und bieten gleichzeitig direkte Steuerberatungsleistungen für Unternehmen und Selbständige.

Dabei verfolgen wir einen klaren Grundsatz:

Wir vermeiden unnötige Medienbrüche, manuelle Buchungsübernahmen und ineffiziente Imports aus Vorsystemen. Unser Ziel ist es, mit den Systemen unserer Mandanten zu arbeiten – nicht gegen sie.

So reduzieren wir Komplexität und schaffen echte Effizienz – möglichst ohne klassische Kanzleisoftware-Logik.

Nach vielen Jahren in der traditionellen Steuerberatung war für uns klar:

Es braucht einen strukturellen Neustart.

Deshalb sind wir eine der ersten Kanzleien in Deutschland, die als selbstgeführte Organisation aufgebaut ist – mit klaren Verantwortlichkeiten, hoher Transparenz und echter Mitgestaltung

Was du mitbringst

  • Qualifikation: Bestandenes Steuerberaterexamen und Zulassung als Steuerberater/in (oder du bist gerade in der Prüfungsvorbereitung)

  • Erfahrung: Berufserfahrung in der Steuerberatung, idealerweise in dynamischen oder technologieorientierten Umfeldern.

Ein unterstützendes Team aus Steuerprofis, Tech-Experten und Unternehmer:innen

Wir setzen auf Innovation, Flexibilität und Teamgeist, um die Steuerberatung neu zu definieren. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Teil eines zukunftsweisenden Unternehmens zu werden und echte Veränderungen zu bewirken.

title: Lead Solutions Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About the team

Veriff's Solutions Engineering team works at the intersection of technology, customer experience, and commercial strategy. We partner with customers to understand their business and technical needs, navigate complex challenges, and demonstrate the value of Veriff's solutions. Working closely with Sales and Account Management, we help build strong customer relationships and support Veriff's growth.

The opportunity

We're looking for a Lead Solutions Engineer to lead our Solutions Engineering team in EMEA. You'll combine technical expertise, people leadership, and commercial thinking to support enterprise customers, strengthen collaboration across teams, and drive business results in the region.

You'll provide structure and direction to the team, improve how we work with customers and internal stakeholders, and help translate our go-to-market strategy into commercial success. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a fast-paced, growing technology company.

What you'll achieve in your first 3 months

  • Build a strong understanding of the Solutions Engineering team, its priorities, and Veriff's go-to-market strategy.
  • Establish relationships with key customers and internal stakeholders across the Americas.
  • Identify and implement initial improvements to team management, collaboration, and operational processes.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen customer engagement and improve commercial traction.

What you'll achieve by 6 months

  • Deliver against key team KPIs and contribute to the commercial objectives for the Americas.
  • Establish clear ways of working across Solutions Engineering, Sales, and Account Management.
  • Become a trusted leader within the Americas organisation, supporting team development and building strong stakeholder relationships.
  • Improve the team's ability to support complex enterprise customers and drive successful commercial outcomes.

What you'll bring — essential

  • Leadership experience: Experience leading, coaching, or developing a technical, customer-facing team. You're comfortable setting direction, creating structure, and helping people perform at their best.
  • Technical acumen: The ability to understand complex technical concepts, engage credibly with technical stakeholders, and translate customer requirements into practical solutions.
  • Customer communication: Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to adapt your approach to different audiences and explain complex concepts clearly.
  • Commercial mindset: An understanding of how technical solutions support business outcomes, with experience partnering with commercial teams to support customer and revenue goals.
  • Stakeholder management: Experience building relationships across teams, influencing decisions, navigating pushback, and handling challenging situations constructively.
  • Operational excellence: A proactive, structured approach to managing priorities, improving processes, and working effectively in a fast-moving environment.
  • AI mindset: Curiosity about AI and its practical applications, ideally with examples of tools or solutions you've built or experimented with.
Nice to have
  • Experience in enterprise B2B SaaS, ideally within a startup or scale-up environment.
  • Experience working with large, complex enterprise customers and managing technical and commercial relationships.
  • Experience building or scaling a Solutions Engineering team or improving its processes.
  • Familiarity with identity verification, fraud prevention, fintech, or related technology domains.
Why Veriff?   Identity is the core of the digital economy. In this role, you aren’t just selling software; you are building the infrastructure that prevents fraud and enables global trust. You will have a direct, measurable impact on our expansion into the world’s fastest-growing markets.   We are the preferred identity verification platform partner for the world’s most innovative growth-driven organizations helping conveniently verify and safeguard users anywhere in the world. We support the broadest number of identity documents from nearly every country and territory in the world - and this is continually increasing! With a diverse team in the United States, United Kingdom, Spain, and Estonia, as well as robust backing and funding from investors including Accel, Alkeon, IVP, Tiger Capital, and Y Combinator, we’re dedicated to helping businesses and individuals build a safer and more secure world. We strive to be the benchmark for trust online, and we take pride in being a positive force.    When you join Team Veriff, we offer you the opportunity to have a real impact and advance your career, while looking after you along the way with a range of benefits designed with you in mind. Some of our favorites include...
  • Flexibility to work from home
  • Stock options that ensure your share in our success
  • Extra recharge days on top of your annual vacation
  • Extensive medical, dental, and vision insurance to ensure you’re feeling great physically and mentally
  • Learning and Development & Health and Sports budget that you are free to tailor to your own needs
  • Four weeks of fully paid sabbatical leave after reaching your 5th work anniversary 
We are an Equal Opportunities employer committed to a diverse and representative team. Different opinions, perspectives and personalities push us forward. We want to hear from people who are passionate about their work and align with our values. Regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability. We also know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates - so rest assured, whoever you are, we want to hear from you!  Please be informed that in the final stage of the recruitment process we may request you to go through identity verification. For more information, please see Recruitment Privacy Policy.   #SPBTAL #LI-Remote #TLBT

title: Marketing Manager (gn) - More Nutrition Schweiz
descriptionHtml:
Start: ab sofort | Level: Intermediate | Location: Schweiz, remote | Arbeitszeit: Vollzeit (40h/Woche) 

In der Rolle als Marketing Manager (gn), übernimmst du die Entwicklung und Umsetzung unserer Markenstrategie für More Nutrition in der Schweiz.

More Nutrition macht bereits 8-stellige Umsätze in der Schweiz, die wir gemeinsam mit dir auf 9-stellige Umsätze ausweiten wollen. 

In dieser Rolle gestaltest du wirkungsvolle Kampagnen, treibst lokale Marketinginitiativen voran und stellst ein konsistentes Markenerlebnis über alle Touchpoints hinweg sicher. Du arbeitest eng mit crossfunktionalen Teams, Agenturen und lokalen Akteuren zusammen, um unsere Präsenz auf dem Schweizer Markt massiv auszubauen. 

Deine Mission bei uns 

  • Als Brand Guardian entwickelst und setzt du die Markenstrategie für die Schweiz um, indem du globale Leitlinien mit lokalen Consumer Insights verknüpfst
  • Du definierst den Marketing-Aktivierungskalender und leitest die Planung sowie Umsetzung von Omnichannel-Kampagnen (inkl. Massenmedien, Influencer Marketing, TikTok und Point of Sale)
  • Du gestaltest das lokale Produktportfolio basierend auf den Bedürfnissen und Potenzialen des Schweizer Marktes mit
  • Du briefst und steuerst Agenturen zur Erstellung markenkonformer, lokal relevanter Assets (in Deutsch und Französisch) und stellst eine termingerechte Kampagnenumsetzung sicher
  • Du trackst Markenmetriken (Awareness, Equity, Engagement) sowie Kampagnen-KPIs und nutzt diese Daten für eine kontinuierliche Optimierung
  • Du arbeitest eng mit crossfunktionalen Teams zusammen, um ein konsistentes Markenerlebnis im D2C-Bereich, Pureplay und am Point of Sale zu garantieren
  • Du stimmst dich eng mit den lokalen Commercial-Teams ab, um die Marketingaktivitäten perfekt auf die Markt- und Vertriebsziele auszurichten

Deine Erfahrung & Skills 

  • Du bringst 4–6 Jahre fundierte Berufserfahrung als Brand- oder Marketing Manager im FMCG- / Konsumgüterbereich mit. Gerne aus dem Bereich Food & Beverage 
  • Du hast nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Führung oder Betreuung einer oder mehrerer Marken in der Schweiz mit Umsätzen von mindestens 50 Mio. CHF
  • Du besitzt fundierte Erfahrung in der Steuerung eines D2C-Business sowie in der Steuerung von Omnichannel-Kampagnen (inkl. Mass Media, Influencer Marketing, Social Media wie TikTok und Meta, sowie Point of Sale + Pureplay)
  • Du zeichnest dich durch eine starke Hands-on-Mentalität, ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten im Projektmanagement und echte Lust auf crossfunktionale Zusammenarbeit aus
  • Du hast ein strategisches, kreatives und datengetriebenes Mindset und gehst sicher mit digitalen Marketing-Tools um
  • Du hast verhandlungssichere Deutsch- (Schweizerdeutsch) sowie fließende Französischkenntnisse und nutzt Englisch sicher für unsere interne Kommunikation

Warum wir? 

Bei The Quality Group arbeiten über 1.200 Menschen mit einer gemeinsamen Mission: Ernährung neu zu denken - gesünder, smarter und mit echtem Mehrwert für die Community.
Wir glauben an Teamgeist, Eigenverantwortung und den Mut, Grenzen zu verschieben. Dabei zählt jeder Beitrag, unabhängig vom Standort oder Bereich.
Je nachdem, wo du bei uns einsteigst, erwarten dich unterschiedliche Benefits, unter anderem:

  • Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte auf Produkte von ESN & More
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten & Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten
  • Zuschüsse zu Mobilität & Fitness (z. B. Wellpass, Deutschlandticket)
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • Workation-Optionen und mehr

Im Bewerbungsprozess erfährst du, welche Vorteile dich an deinem Standort konkret erwarten und was es heißt, Teil von TQG zu sein: Ein Unternehmen, das mit Leidenschaft, Qualität und Mut die Zukunft von Ernährung gestaltet.

Über uns 

The Quality Group (TQG) ist ein innovativer Anbieter von Sporternährungsprodukten und vereint seit 2021 die erfolgreichen Marken ESN und More Nutrition.

ESN ist seit 2004 deutscher Marktführer für Sporternährung und bietet Produkte wie Proteinpulver, Riegel und Supplements, die auf ambitionierte Fitnessziele ausgerichtet sind. More Nutrition, gegründet 2017, steht für gesunde, zuckerreduzierte Ernährungsprodukte und bietet Lösungen für bewusste Ernährung und Gewichtsmanagement – ohne Verzicht.

Die Vision von TQG ist es, Menschen dabei zu unterstützen, die beste Version ihrer selbst zu werden. Mit Leidenschaft und Innovationskraft entwickelt das Unternehmen hochwertige Produkte, die Gesundheit, Leistung und Lebensfreude fördern. Mit einer agilen Unternehmenskultur und spannenden Karrieremöglichkeiten ist TQG nicht nur für Kunden, sondern auch für Mitarbeitende ein starker Partner.  

Das sind wir – The Quality Group – nice to meet you! Now it’s your turn!

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft oder Identität – bei uns zählt, wer du bist und was du einbringst. Werde Teil unseres Teams und wachse mit uns.

title: Partner Manager - Public Sector Partnerships
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're looking for an experienced partnerships leader to build and scale ElevenLabs' Public Sector Partner Programme in North America — bringing together resellers, VARs, and systems integrators who help deploy our technology across federal agencies, state and local governments, and education institutions.

You'll own the public sector partner strategy end-to-end — from building relationships with leading SIs and VARs with established public sector practices, to onboarding, enabling, and activating them to sell and deliver ElevenLabs products into government and education accounts.

This is a 0→1 build: you'll design partner incentive and enablement models tailored to the procurement and compliance realities of the public sector, generate qualified pipeline through partner-led opportunities, and scale the programme against North America growth targets — while owning day-to-day execution and partner performance.

 

What success looks like (first 6–9 months)

  • Partner-Sourced & Influenced Revenue: closed-won ARR through VARs, SIs, and channel partners reaching at least 20% of North America public sector revenue

  • Partner-Sourced Pipeline: qualified pipeline created through partners, with a focus on enterprise and agency-level opportunities in federal, SLED, and education

  • Revenue-Producing Partners: number of partners actively generating pipeline, opportunities, or revenue each quarter

  • Time-to-First Revenue: speed from partner onboarding to first sourced opportunity and first closed-won deal

  • Strategic Account Penetration: new agency and institution relationships unlocked through partners that ElevenLabs would've struggled to access directly

Requirements

  • 10+ years building and scaling SaaS or Cloud solutions into public sector markets, with a deep network across federal, SLED, and education that you can leverage from day one

  • 4+ years owning VAR and SI partnerships in the public sector, with proven experience driving joint account planning, co-sell motions, and revenue — not just relationship management

  • Deep familiarity with government procurement cycles, contract vehicles (e.g. GSA schedules, BPAs), and compliance frameworks (FedRAMP, FISMA, StateRAMP)

  • A builder mindset — experience creating partner motions from 0→1, rather than inheriting a mature programme

  • Comfortable working with technical, API-driven products, and able to explain complex concepts to partners and agency stakeholders

Bonus: Mix of 3–4 years in direct public sector sales + 3–4 years in partnerships or channel; prior experience at a company scaling into gov-tech from a commercial base

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation:

For this principal development role, with 12+ years of experience, the compensation range is  $12,500 - $20,800 USD based on location and experience level per month and in gross amount. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience

About the Role: 

We are seeking an exceptional Principal Infrastructure Engineer to design, build, operate, and scale the platform that powers Sezzle. Your focus will be the hardest infrastructure problems: increasing throughput, reducing latency, removing capacity bottlenecks, strengthening resilience, and making production operations more automated and predictable as the business grows.

You will own complex technical initiatives from architecture and prototyping through implementation, production rollout, and ongoing operation. Your impact will come from the systems you build, the problems you solve, and measurable improvements in reliability, performance, and cost efficiency.

Our stack runs on AWS, with workloads orchestrated on Kubernetes and data anchored in Aurora RDS (MySQL and Postgres). You should know these technologies deeply and be comfortable moving between cloud architecture, networking, cluster internals, database performance, and application behavior to understand how the entire system scales. You will write code and infrastructure-as-code, debug production systems, and deliver changes that hold up under real traffic and failure conditions.

Operational ownership is part of the job. You will participate in the on-call rotation and take a hands-on role in recovering from major incidents, including full outages. We need someone who can form and test hypotheses using logs, metrics, and traces, make sound mitigation decisions with incomplete information, and turn incident findings into lasting engineering fixes.

You will also build and apply AI-assisted infrastructure and SRE tooling for incident investigation, capacity analysis, runbook automation, and toil reduction. You will evaluate these tools through practical results and apply appropriate access controls, validation, and auditability to their use in production.

This role reports to engineering leadership and works closely with application engineers, Security, and Compliance. You will develop a deep understanding of how Sezzle's business operates and how customer journeys, transaction patterns, and product decisions shape infrastructure demand and behavior. You will use that understanding to identify and deliver improvements across teams and technical domains, connecting infrastructure decisions to better customer outcomes and business performance.

What you’ll do: 

  • Own the technical architecture and evolution of core infrastructure: identify system limits, prioritize technical improvements, and implement changes that support increasing traffic, data volume, and workload complexity.
  • Connect business understanding to improvements across the system: learn how key business workflows behave in production, trace their impact across applications, data, and infrastructure, and partner across teams to improve performance, reliability, and cost efficiency beyond any single service or team's scope.
  • Engineer for scale and performance: build capacity models, run load and stress tests, diagnose bottlenecks across compute, networking, Kubernetes, and databases, and validate improvements against throughput, latency, saturation, and cost per workload.
  • Design and build AWS infrastructure: implement resilient account, IAM, network, and service architectures; address service quotas, fault isolation, and multi-AZ or multi-region requirements as workloads grow.
  • Build and operate the Kubernetes platform: improve cluster architecture, lifecycle automation, workload isolation, resource allocation, autoscaling, safe upgrades, and deployment reliability.
  • Scale and optimize Aurora RDS for MySQL and Postgres: tune queries and indexes, address connection and replication bottlenecks, plan capacity, improve failover behavior, and implement safe schema changes and database migrations with application engineers.
  • Improve reliability through engineering: define and instrument service-level objectives and error budgets with service owners; implement failure isolation, backpressure, load shedding, and safe retry behavior where needed to prevent cascading failures.
  • Participate in on-call and drive technical recovery during serious incidents: use evidence-based triage, execute mitigations, communicate findings, and implement corrective actions from postmortems.
  • Implement and test disaster recovery: design backup, restore, and failover mechanisms against agreed recovery time and recovery point objectives; run recovery exercises and document measured results.
  • Build infrastructure-as-code and operational automation: make provisioning, configuration, deployments, upgrades, and recovery reproducible, reviewed, testable, and recoverable. Eliminate recurring manual work through code.
  • Build observability that makes production diagnosable: improve metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and actionable alerts, with visibility into service health, scaling limits, and customer impact.
  • Deliver safe infrastructure migrations: design phased rollouts, compatibility checks, validation, and rollback paths for changes to shared production systems.
  • Improve cloud cost efficiency through technical changes: right-size resources, improve utilization, tune autoscaling and storage, and quantify savings while maintaining reliability and performance targets.
  • Build and evaluate AI-assisted operational tooling: apply AI to investigation, runbooks, anomaly analysis, and repetitive operations, with bounded permissions, reviewable actions, and measurable improvements in accuracy or toil.
  • Make technical decisions clear and executable: write architecture proposals, evaluate technology tradeoffs through prototypes and benchmarks, review changes affecting shared infrastructure, and document how systems operate and fail.

What We look for: 

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a similar technical field (required)
  • 12+ years of experience across infrastructure, platform, site reliability, software development, or related engineering disciplines, with substantial hands-on depth designing and operating production infrastructure at scale.
  • Deep expertise with AWS: production experience across compute, IAM, multi-account architectures, and networking, including VPC design and private connectivity.
  • Deep expertise with Kubernetes in production: cluster lifecycle, scheduling, resource management, autoscaling, networking, and troubleshooting business-critical workloads. EKS experience is strongly preferred.
  • Deep expertise with relational databases at scale, specifically RDS/Aurora (MySQL and/or Postgres): query performance, indexing, connection management, replication, high availability, failover, and verified backup and recovery.
  • A track record of personally delivering infrastructure scaling improvements: identifying constraints, measuring baseline behavior, implementing changes, and demonstrating gains in capacity, latency, reliability, or cost efficiency.
  • Strong coding and automation skills, using Golang, Python, or similar languages to build production tooling and eliminate operational toil, alongside infrastructure-as-code experience with Terraform or equivalent.
  • Strong systems fundamentals: Linux, networking, DNS, TLS, storage, concurrency, and distributed system failure modes, with the ability to debug problems across infrastructure and application boundaries.
  • Experience operating a 24/7, high-availability platform where downtime has direct customer or revenue impact, including hands-on incident response and postmortem remediation.
  • Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation and demonstrated ability to recover production systems under pressure using evidence-based triage, safe mitigation, and clear technical communication.
  • Experience implementing and testing disaster recovery against defined recovery objectives, including restoring data and validating service recovery.
  • Practical experience with observability, load testing, capacity planning, and safe CI/CD practices for shared production infrastructure.
  • Active use of AI tooling in engineering or operations, with practical judgment about its limitations and how to verify generated code, recommendations, and operational actions.
  • Ability to carry ambiguous technical problems from investigation through production delivery and collaborate across engineering disciplines to resolve system-wide constraints.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Experience in fintech, payments, or banking, operating infrastructure with demanding reliability, security, and audit requirements.
  • Experience with multi-region architectures, chaos engineering, and failure testing, including the consistency and recovery tradeoffs of distributed data systems.
  • Proficiency with Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, or comparable observability systems.
  • Experience building internal platform capabilities and self-service tooling, including deployment automation, progressive delivery, and reusable infrastructure components.
  • Experience building AI-assisted incident investigation or operational automation with restricted access, auditable execution, and clear human review points

About You: 

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.
  • You go deep: you investigate how systems behave under load and failure, follow the evidence, and fix underlying causes.
  • You build and ship: you turn architecture into working code, tested infrastructure, and safe production changes.
  • You measure results: you can explain the impact of your work in availability, latency, capacity, recovery time, cost, or hours of toil removed.
  • You value simplicity: you choose systems that are understandable, operable, and appropriate to the problem, and reduce unnecessary complexity.
  • You earn trust: you listen carefully, communicate clearly, challenge technical decisions respectfully, and follow through on commitments.
  • You stay accountable for the outcome: you verify that changes work in production and that fixes remain effective as the platform scales.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Python
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres
  • DevOps and Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Open Source: Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome? 

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

title: QA & Authorisation Handler
descriptionHtml:
Turning risk into opportunity

Human progress runs on a single trade: risk for opportunity. Every venture worth doing - a new business, a new home, an exciting trip - means accepting the chance it goes wrong. Insurance is what lets us take those chances anyway, and the claim is the moment it either delivers on that promise or fails to.

We're rebuilding that moment. ClaimSorted is an AI-native claims solution for insurers and large corporates that resolves claims faster, fairer, and more reliably than the industry ever has. Handle risk that well, and people are free to take on more of it - that's how you push society toward opportunity: not by eliminating risk, but by making recovery so fast and certain it stops being a reason to hold back.

We're one of the fastest-growing InsurTechs - scaling 10x YoY, processing hundreds of millions in claims payouts, and backed by the world's leading investors: Y Combinator, Atomico, and Eurazeo.


What we are looking for

We are looking for a confident, analytical and detail-focused QA & Authorisation Handler to join our Technical Claims Support Team.

You will provide a key technical control across our claims operation, completing Quality Assurance reviews and reviewing claim settlements at the authorisation stage.

As the final line of defence before a claim settlement is approved, you will be responsible for independently reviewing the claim, evidence, policy coverage and settlement calculation before making the decision to authorise, pass back or escalate.

This requires confidence and strong technical judgement. You must be comfortable making decisions, challenging claim assessments where something does not look right and clearly explaining the reasoning behind your decision.

The role goes beyond identifying individual errors. You will use findings from QA and authorisations to identify potential financial leakage, recurring handling issues, process and control gaps and emerging trends across the claims operation.

You will be comfortable using data to understand where issues are occurring, identify root causes and turn findings into practical improvements to processes, controls, guidance and training.

As ClaimSorted works across a range of insurance products and partners, you will need to be adaptable and confident moving between different products, policy wordings, processes and priorities while maintaining consistently high standards.

As part of the wider Technical Claims Support Team, you will also support other technical claims activities where required.

Responsibilities

  • Review claim settlements at authorisation stage across all ClaimSorted products, acting as the final line of defence before payment is approved.

  • Independently review policy coverage, supporting evidence and settlement calculations, making confident decisions to authorise, pass back or escalate.

  • Complete Quality Assurance reviews across all products, ensuring claims are handled accurately, fairly and in line with policy, partner and internal requirements.

  • Identify and prevent financial leakage, incorrect settlements and other customer or financial risks.

  • Provide clear, constructive and evidence-based feedback to Claims Handlers, confidently challenging decisions where required.

  • Use QA, authorisation and leakage data across products to identify trends, recurring errors, training needs and process or control gaps.

  • Support improvements to claims processes, guidance and controls based on findings and root-cause analysis.

  • Maintain accurate records of decisions and findings while effectively managing and prioritising QA and authorisation workloads.

  • Build and maintain the technical knowledge required to work confidently across all ClaimSorted product lines, partners and processes.

  • Work collaboratively across Claims Operations and the wider Technical Claims Support Team.

Skills and Experience Required

  • +2 years experience completing claim authorisations within an insurance claims team is essential, with responsibility for reviewing and making decisions on claim settlements.

  • +3 years experience working across two or more of the following product lines within a claims role: Pet, Travel, Property, Auto, Gadget or similar insurance products.

  • Strong technical claims knowledge, with the confidence to independently review, challenge and make evidence-based decisions.

  • Excellent attention to detail, particularly when reviewing policy coverage, supporting evidence and settlement calculations.

  • Strong analytical skills, with experience identifying financial leakage, trends, recurring errors and process or control gaps.

  • Able to confidently provide clear, constructive feedback and explain the rationale behind decisions.

  • Highly organised and able to prioritise a varied workload based on risk, value and urgency.

  • Adaptable and comfortable learning new products, policy wordings and processes in a fast-paced environment.

Mission

To act as a final line of defence within the claims settlement process, ensuring claim outcomes are accurate, fair and supported by policy and evidence before settlement is authorised.

The QA & Authorisation Handler will use strong technical judgement and independent decision-making to protect customer outcomes and financial performance, identifying errors, potential leakage and operational risks before they result in incorrect settlements.

Through Quality Assurance, data analysis and trend identification, the role will also identify wider knowledge, process and control gaps and help turn individual findings into sustainable improvements across Claims Operations

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary beyond the industry standard

  • Quarterly performance bonus: up to 15% of quarterly salary

  • Equity participation: stock options as an early-stage team member

  • Health insurance

  • Pension contributions

  • 28 days annual leave

  • Accelerated promotion track in a high-growth environment

Compensation: £25K – £35K • Offers Equity • 15% Quaterly Bonus

title: Senior Data Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 100 employees, we continue to grow – and we are looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system and solve administrative complexity across care journeys in Europe.

Our data flows from our applications, product events and business systems, in a highly regulated healthcare context. This role exists to build the platform that makes sure that data arrives complete, on time and safe to use, so Product, leadership, RevOps and Finance work from the same numbers.

You will be the first data engineer in a new data team that sits in Product, works across the company and reports to the Head of Data. You will own the platform that moves our data into Snowflake and shape the architecture decisions around it: which tools we build on, how pipelines are orchestrated and monitored, and how data infrastructure is managed as code.

What to expect

This is what you can expect from us as a Senior Data Engineer:

  • Purposeful work – your work gives the teams serving hospitals and aftercare providers data they can trust.

  • Real ownership – as the first data engineer in a new team, you shape the data platform and its tooling.

  • Company culture – we believe in flat hierarchies that promote high performance and strong team dynamics. We foster an environment characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare? Like to exercise during lunch? We'll support you. We are a remote-friendly company offering flexible working hours. Workations are also possible by arrangement.

  • Edenred card – which you can use according to your needs.

Extra vacation day – so you can celebrate your birthday with your loved ones, you'll have the day off.

This is how you will make an impact as a Senior Data Engineer:

  • Data from our application databases, product events and SaaS tools needs to reach Snowflake reliably. You build and run that ingestion and decide where to buy a managed connector and where to build.

  • Our pipelines need clear dependencies, retries, alerting and SLAs. You set up orchestration so a failed or partial load stops downstream work instead of silently producing wrong numbers.

  • New products need event pipelines. You design them together with engineers, keeping patient data out of analytics events by design.

  • Product and Finance need to work from the same definitions. You maintain the dbt models that connect product usage with customer, billing and revenue data.

  • Our CRM (HubSpot) and our internal systems need to talk to each other. You build the data flows between them, including two-way synchronisation where it is needed.

  • Data quality problems need to be caught before a dashboard or a board report does. You establish validation, monitoring and alerting.

  • Our data needs strong privacy and access controls. You enforce role-based access and masking in Snowflake, pseudonymisation, and deletion that propagates across raw and modelled data.

  • Data code needs the same engineering standards as our product code. You bring code review, testing, documentation and CI/CD to it.

How we build

We run a modern cloud-native stack to move, model and protect data reliably in a regulated healthcare environment.

  • Cloud: AWS (The European Sovereign Cloud partition)

  • Runtime: Kubernetes (EKS) and Postgres (RDS)

  • Warehouse and modelling: Snowflake (EU), dbt

  • Orchestration: Airflow or Dagster (being introduced)

  • BI: Looker

  • Observability: Datadog

  • CI/CD: GitHub Enterprise Cloud with Actions

  • Infrastructure: CloudFormation

  • Business systems: HubSpot, Chargebee


  • Several years (typically 5 or more) building production data pipelines, as a data engineer or as a backend engineer on data-intensive systems.

  • Strong Python: you write tested, maintainable production code, not only scripts.

  • Advanced SQL, including window functions, CTEs and query optimisation.

  • Production experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud warehouse: compute sizing and cost control, role-based access, masking, and performance tuning.

  • Experience with dbt, or a similar tool for tested and documented transformations.

  • Solid ingestion fundamentals: initial versus incremental loads, change data capture from Postgres, idempotency, schema evolution, late and out-of-order data, and backfills.

  • Production experience with an orchestrator such as Airflow or Dagster.

  • Experience with AWS and with deploying your own work in containers.

  • A data quality mindset: you profile data, test assumptions and build checks.

  • Practical knowledge of GDPR: you can identify personal data and implement pseudonymisation, access control and deletion.

  • You use AI coding tools in your daily work and know where they help and where they need checking.

  • Ability to own decisions as the only data engineer and to explain technical trade-offs to non-engineers.

  • Preference for writing over talking, resulting in clear, concise, yet complete documentation and asynchronous communications.

  • Fluent English, written and spoken. Other languages are a plus.

Bonus points

  • Healthcare or regulated-domain experience (e.g. ISO 27001, C5).

  • Integrating CRM and SaaS systems such as HubSpot or Salesforce, including reverse ETL or two-way sync.

  • Designing product event tracking (e.g. Snowplow or Segment).

  • Kubernetes in production.

  • Reading and changing Go code.

  • Managing Snowflake as code.

  • German language skills.

Our values

This will help you decide if you want to join us – our values are:

  • Strong opinions, weakly held. We adapt, negotiate trade-offs, and reconsider decisions when necessary. We don't stick to one implementation – we re-evaluate and adjust as needed (including throwing away the old one).

  • Pragmatic choice of tools and avoidance of one-size-fits-all thinking.

  • Bringing professionalism and empathy to how you work with others.

  • Strong belief in solid technical fundamentals and preference for understanding and first principles over memorization.

About Exeon

Exeon is a Swiss cyber security company based in Zurich. Since 2016, we have been protecting critical infrastructures, financial institutions and enterprises whose operations fully rely on IT through AI-powered analysis of network communication. This makes the most sophisticated cyberattacks visible – attacks conventional tools fail to detect. We combine Swiss excellence with a flexible, remote-first, and collaborative culture, supporting passionate, ambitious professionals devoted to solving cybersecurity challenges and driving continuous innovation.

What your impact will be like:

As a Senior Frontend Developer at Exeon, you will be responsible for our UEBA (User and Entity Behaviour Analytics) product. You will work in a small cross-functional team of backend engineers, frontend engineers and quality assurance engineers on a data-heavy single-page application that enterprise customers use to analyze network traffic and identify potential security risks. This data is rendered as tables, graphs and dashboards. You will build out the frontend alongside our frontend engineers, while also helping to shape the overall UI and UX of the product and take its appearance and functionality to the next level.

In particular, you will:

  • Develop and maintain front-end components for Exeon's UEBA product, an enterprise data analysis SPA built with React with emphasis on responsive design, performance optimization and code quality (unit and integration tests).

  • Translate complex user and entity behavior data and network security insights into intuitive visual representations (tables, graphs, dashboards), applying strong information architecture and UX principles.

  • Handle large datasets and optimize frontend rendering to ensure responsive, performant user interfaces, even when working with complex data visualizations.

  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity while maintaining high standards of code quality, testing, security, and architectural consistency.

  • Integrate with the UEBA backend APIs, ensuring efficient data fetching, transformation, and state management.

  • Shape the UEBA product's UI/UX by contributing to design decisions and driving improvements in collaboration with engineers and other stakeholders, bringing independent thinking to the team.

  • Drive technical excellence through code reviews and knowledge-sharing, and contribute to UEBA roadmap priorities from a frontend perspective.

What you can expect from us:

Exeon offers an open company culture that values and encourages diversity, teamwork and a growth mindset. Our goal is to provide our employees with an exciting, supportive and motivating environment for personal growth and career development while ensuring that our team maintains a healthy work-life balance. We strive to achieve this by offering:

  • An exciting and impactful job in a fast-growing Swiss cyber tech company expanding across Europe with manifold opportunities to shape your professional profile.

  • Working in close collaboration with our interdisciplinary team and learning from our Security Experts, Data Scientists, and Business Professionals.

  • Taking over responsibilities quickly and help shape and promote a cutting-edge security software.

  • A high degree of trust, independence and flexibility, also in terms of working hours and place of work (remote or in the office).

  • A competitive salary and appealing benefits package.


What makes a good person job fit

We are looking for a proactive, self motivated and enthusiastic individual who's comfortable in a high-paced scale up environment and who shares our values. We value critical thinking, pragmatic problem solving, and engineers who take ownership of their work, using AI as a powerful tool while remaining accountable for technical decisions and code quality. In addition, we are looking for certain requirements and skills to establish a good person-job fit:

Must-haves

  • A frontend enthusiast who likes bringing the frontend to the next level, finding pragmatic solutions, working in a cross-functional team and staying up to date with frontend technologies.

  • A professional who has at least 7 years of experience as a frontend engineer and at least a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science/Software Engineering (or similar).

  • A frontend engineer who contributes to and improves the architecture and design of the product, ensuring a well-thought-through technical foundation.

  • A technical expert who optimizes the code/application for the best performance and advocates for state of the art technologies and engineering practices.

  • End to end ownership throughout the software lifecycle with a strong focus on solutions, code quality, and efficiency.

  • Openness to AI-assisted development, with the ability to critically evaluate AI-generated solutions, challenge assumptions, and ensure code quality, maintainability, and security.

  • Strong expertise in frontend development technologies (JavaScript, CSS3 and HTML5), React, and modern frontend build tooling (e.g., Webpack, Vite).

  • Prior experience writing React functional components using React hooks, including lifecycle, state and side effects.

  • Experience writing automated frontend tests, ideally using React Testing Library and Jest.

  • A good understanding of Linux and Docker, with the ability to independently manage development environments and VMs.

  • A good understanding of UI and UX principles such as clear information hierarchy (this isn't a designer role, but these skills will be useful).

  • A fluent English speaker.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience in structured mentoring or coaching of other engineers, supporting their long-term professional growth.

  • Experience working with large datasets, complex data visualizations, dashboards, or performance-intensive applications.

  • Familiarity with cybersecurity concepts, security analytics, SOC workflows, or related tooling.

  • Experience with TypeScript.

  • Experience with end-to-end testing frameworks such as Playwright or Cypress.

About the Role:

Camunda Hub is where enterprises run Camunda at scale. From Hub they manage their clusters and tenants, decide who can do what, and roll changes out across the whole organization. We’re looking for a Senior Product Builder to own the backend and architecture that let Hub manage a whole fleet of clusters. Your first focus will be the mechanism that sends access, secret, tenant and licence changes out to every connected cluster and brings deployments, health and audit records back. From there, you’ll shape Hub’s foundations: its event model, the service boundaries and data model other teams build on, and how Hub behaves when things fail or get upgraded. The platform is your product. Your users are platform administrators, Centres of Excellence and the builders across Camunda who depend on what you create. You’ll join a new two-person pod in our remote-first team. You’ll have real ownership as the person who makes the call, and you’ll build AI-first, from written specs through to production. Our customers run mission-critical processes on Camunda, so your work will matter to them every day.

What You Will Do:

  • Take over Hub's fleet propagation mechanism from the team building its first version, and make it work for access, secrets, tenants, licences and custom roles

  • Write short design documents for foundational changes, get them reviewed by the teams that depend on them, and turn them into tested, shipped code

  • Design how Hub behaves when things go wrong: offline clusters, partial failures, Hub outages, and clusters being adopted or detached

  • Build the path from clusters back to Hub, starting with deployment inventory, health, audit records and licence status

  • Design Hub's first event and webhook mechanism, so admins and agents can react to changes instead of polling for them

  • Join the pod's rotations and Hub on-call, and help other builders take on backend work through reviews, guidelines and contract tests

What You Will Bring to the Role:

  • Experience building and running backend systems in production that other teams or customers depend on

  • Comfort taking a problem nobody owns yet and turning it into a design, a plan and shipped code

  • Product judgment for technical users: you talk to the people who use your APIs and make trade-offs on their behalf

  • Care for how a system behaves when parts of it fail, not only for the happy path

Must Haves:

  • Senior backend engineering in Java (API design, relational data models, multi-tenant SaaS services) and hands-on Helm and Kubernetes for self-managed installations

  • Software architecture and failure analysis: partial failure, blast radius, consistency trade-offs. Has debugged production incidents in a distributed system and is ready for on-call

  • Has shaped an API or platform as a product, and writes design docs other teams can build on. Gets agreement across teams without formal authority

  • Builds AI-first from written specifications and checks AI output as carefully as any other code

Nice to Haves:

  • Kubernetes operators or GitOps tools, for example Argo CD

  • OIDC, SCIM and permission models, or secret managers and licence systems

  • Camunda 8 or another workflow or orchestration engine
