title: Senior Product Designer - Growth
descriptionHtml:
Fully Remote (UK based) | Competitive Salary + Bonus + Generous Equity | B Corp Certified TrustedHousesitters is a fast growing, direct-to-consumer marketplace that is redefining pet care and travel. Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re on a mission to make travel work better for pets, for their people, and for the global community of animal lovers who look after them. We’ve got big plans on becoming the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people. We’ve built something pretty special: a trusted place where pet owners and sitters connect to keep pets happy at home while their humans explore the world. We’ve already grown into a global community with members in over 140 countries, a product people genuinely love, and a team of more than 100 brilliant humans powering it all. But we’re only just getting started. Our goal? To grow to 1 million members and make TrustedHousesitters the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people. At the moment, a sit starts every two minutes somewhere on the planet. We want that to be every single minute and we know the only way we’ll get there is with the right people in the right roles. The right people in the right roles will shape our future. So, here’s the big question: Could that be you?

This is the role that owns the first impression. From the moment someone lands on our homepage to the point they hand over their payment details, you’ll shape every critical step. We’re redesigning how millions of pet lovers discover and join TrustedHousesitters - and this hire will lead that work. If you’ve spent your career moving conversion needles, experimenting relentlessly, and building beautiful product at speed, this is your next chapter.

The Role: Experimental, Visual, and Commercial

You’ll own the full acquisition and onboarding experience at TrustedHousesitters - web and mobile - sitting within the New Member Revenue squad. That means everything from the homepage and landing pages through to registration flows, onboarding nudges, and first payment. You’ll work directly with product, engineering, data, CRM, and our CRO Manager, and you’ll have real ownership of the experimentation roadmap for your area.

The challenge is genuinely interesting. Our product is loved - but our acquisition experience needs to match that. We’re running a push to make TrustedHousesitters feel as aspirational as Airbnb, peppering real trust signals and community moments into journeys that currently skew too utilitarian. You’ll need to balance a high visual bar with a rigorous test-and-learn mindset. Neither alone is enough.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Own the acquisition journey end-to-end: From homepage to first payment - web-first, with mobile increasingly in scope - including landing pages, onboarding flows, and lifecycle nudges.

  • Drive conversion through experimentation: Co-own the experimentation roadmap with our CRO Manager: frame hypotheses, define success metrics, and ship rapid tests. You should be able to name the number your last test moved.

  • Raise the visual bar: Strong UI craft is a non-negotiable - every surface you touch should feel considered, current, and well-executed.

  • Translate insight into shipped product: Self-serve with Amplitude, turn quantitative and qualitative signals into testable ideas, and move quickly from insight to design.

  • Shape strategy, not just output: Partner with product, engineering, data, and commercial teams - your voice should be in the room before decisions are made, not after.


    Who you are:

    • The Growth Designer: You’ve owned acquisition or conversion work in-house, at pace - and you can tell the story of an experiment you ran, the hypothesis behind it, and the number it moved.

    • The Visual Craftsperson: Your portfolio stops people. You’ve worked where the visual bar is genuinely high and you hold yourself to that standard regardless of where you are.

    • The Hypothesis Writer: You think in problems before solutions - you can frame a clear problem statement, propose a test, and explain why that test design makes sense.

    • The Collaborator: You treat design as a shared effort, not a hand-off - you partner closely with PMs, engineers, data, and CRM and you’re a stronger designer for it.

    • The B2C Product Thinker: You’ve worked on consumer products - ideally marketplaces or subscriptions - and you understand how trust is built digitally and what actually makes someone convert.

    The Process:

    We value your time and aim for a transparent, efficient process:

    1. Talent Screen: A 20-minute conversation with our Talent team to cover your background, motivations, and the role in detail.

    2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 30-minute call with our Director of Design - a two-way conversation about your craft, your approach to growth design, and whether TrustedHousesitters is the right fit for you.

    3. Portfolio & Technical Review: A deeper session with the team focused on your case studies, your experimentation thinking, and your approach to strategic and UX challenges.

    4. Final Stage: You’ll share a high-level view of what you’d focus on in your first 90 days - not a polished strategy, just your honest read of the opportunity and what you’d want to dig into.

  • Each year, you’ll get a Premium TrustedHousesitters Combined membership which includes benefits like free airport lounge passes, Sit Cancellation Plan and Home and Contents Plan, plus five Premium memberships to gift to friends and family
  • Our team can work remotely from as many house sits as they like, and we contribute up to £500 per
    year towards travel costs to and from sits
  • Find a rescue pet to join your family and we’ll cover the adoption fees, as well as “pawternity” to help your pet settle into their new home

💜 Health & wellbeing

  • Optional enrollment onto our Trusted Giving scheme, which includes employee giving via Charities Trust and 2 days paid annual volunteering allowance

  • Get £200 to spend on home office equipment each year + Macbook and Apple accessories when you start
  • Access to Spaces co-working locations across the globe
  • We host an all-expenses-paid meetup each quarter and fund team events (remote or in-person) throughout the year
  • We cover the costs of personal development resources and have regular time set aside for learning and growth
  • Depending on your role within the business, you’ll have the option to customise your work hours to better align with your personal schedule

💰 Compensation & time off

You'll be part of a greenfield team rebuilding how process data is consumed and served at scale, built on top of a durable, continuously-written streaming layer that decouples data consumption from the live engine. You'll be part of a small team from day one, with real room to shape both the architecture and the team's scope as it matures.

At Camunda, we approach engineering in a holistic manner. As such, you will form strong partnerships with product management, the Data Layer and Distributed Systems teams, QA, and support, and work closely with your peers to not only deliver but directly influence how our data streaming architecture evolves to meet our customers' needs.

What You Will Do:

  • Help rebuild how Camunda's analytics product consumes and serves process data at scale, moving it off the engine's critical path entirely.

  • Design and build the core streaming infrastructure that decouples process data access from the live execution engine, backed by durable, object storage.

  • Build customer-facing data streaming capabilities, including a supported way to integrate with systems like Kafka, so customers can reliably get their process data into their own tools.

  • Make foundational architecture decisions as part of a small, high-ownership team, including how the system guarantees consistency and durability across a distributed streaming pipeline.

  • Participate in L3 support and on-call rotations, partnering with Support and SRE to investigate data layer production issues, and feeding what you learn back into the product.

Must Haves:

  • 7+ years of experience as a backend engineer, in Java, with a strong focus on distributed or data-intensive systems.

  • A track record of working with object storage systems (S3/GCS/Azure or similar) and building reliable, idempotent upload/commit protocols against them.

  • Solid grounding in the reasoning behind correctness and consistency in data-intensive systems (e.g. concurrent writes, atomicity, idempotency).

  • A demonstrated track record of driving a technical initiative through genuine ambiguity in a still-being-designed system, not just extending an established one.

  • Proven experience leading medium-to-large engineering initiatives (3+ months) end-to-end, from solution design, project planning, and coordinating across teams, right through to driving predictable delivery.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills in a remote-first environment: you translate requirements into actionable technical work with Product, and give and receive clear, direct feedback in code review.

  • Experience with embedded state stores (RocksDB or similar) for projection/checkpointing workloads.

  • Experience with stream processing frameworks (e.g. Apache Flink), particularly stateful processing with local state backends and checkpointing.

title: Software Engineer – Desktop Automation / RPA (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Software Engineer – Desktop Automation / RPA (m/w/d)

Remote in Germany, Austria, Spain, Portugal, Italy, the Netherlands or the UK · Full-time · Engineering, Interoperability team

About Recare

As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 100 employees, we continue to grow – and we are looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system and solve administrative complexity across care journeys in Europe.

What to expect as our Software Engineer – Desktop Automation / RPA (m/w/d):

  • Purposeful work – your role will have a positive impact on patients, their families, and healthcare professionals.

  • Company culture – we believe in flat hierarchies that promote high performance and strong team dynamics. We foster an environment characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare? Like to exercise during lunch? We'll support you. We are a remote-friendly company offering flexible working hours. Workations are also possible by arrangement.

  • Edenred card – which you can use according to your needs.

  • Extra vacation day – so you can celebrate your birthday with your loved ones, you'll have the day off.

In this role, you can make an impact and grow with us as Software Engineer – Desktop Automation / RPA (m/w/d):

Hospital staff still spend hours typing the same patient data into different systems. Our in-house RPA tool ends that: it automates hospital information systems (HIS) on Windows desktops so our data lands in patient forms automatically. We don't use UiPath or Blue Prism. We build our own engine in TypeScript, on Electron and Node with native Windows bindings.

You'll join the Interoperability team as a hands-on engineer. Your main focus is the engine itself; everything else builds on it.

  • You build, extend and stabilize the core of our RPA engine.

  • You make automations reliable in hospital environments we don't fully control, with remote updates and failure monitoring.

  • You automate HIS applications on Windows, including the hard legacy cases: UI Automation, Java Access Bridge, SAP GUI Scripting or the browser where the app runs locally.

  • You solve the Citrix problem. Most hospitals serve their HIS through Citrix, where all we see is pixels, so you work with OCR, image anchors, mouse and keyboard input, and the redraw, scrolling and display-scaling issues that come with them.

  • You help extend the engine with new capabilities such as document extraction and voice input.

  • You set up the rollout process with our implementation team: installers, code signing and autostart in locked-down hospital IT, and fixing problems on machines you can't log into.

  • You protect health data by applying security best practices and complying with privacy regulations.


Here's how we picture you as our Software Engineer – Desktop Automation / RPA (m/w/d):

  • You have 5+ years of relevant industry experience and have built automation software that runs in production, not only configured bots in an RPA product.

  • You write strong TypeScript or similar

  • You have automated Windows desktop applications with UI Automation, plus at least one of Java Access Bridge, SAP GUI Scripting or browser automation over CDP, and native interop (Node native addons, C# or C++).

  • You have experience with image-based automation over Citrix or RDP (OCR, screen anchors), or a strong wish to learn it. UiPath or Blue Prism developers with Citrix or computer-vision experience who now want to build the engine are very welcome.

  • You know how to keep automations reliable in production: monitoring, failure handling, updates, and testing against apps you can't run in CI.

  • You communicate clearly in English with technical and non-technical people, and you're comfortable working with German-language software.

  • You analyze problems thoroughly and drive them to resolution.

  • Nice to have: experience with OCR, document extraction or speech-to-text; healthcare or HIS integration experience; knowledge of GDPR and sensitive data; spoken German, which helps during rollout with hospital IT.

Not a perfect match on every point? We care more about shared drive and a real sense of mission than about ticking every box.

If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Research Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence.


Position description

At Sonar, we are seeking an innovative Research Engineer to join our Data & Agentic team and pioneer the next generation of our code analysis and verification engines. You will be at the forefront of applying cutting-edge AI, advanced agentic workflow and static analysis techniques to complex source code. Your work will directly shape our core products—ensuring both AI-generated and developer-written code meets rigorous enterprise quality and security standards. If you are driven to turn state-of-the-art research into practical, high-impact solutions, this is the role for you.


What you will do
  • Create & Innovate: Actively participate in the conceptualization phase. Brainstorm novel ways to improve our products and provide immediate, practical feedback to steer exploratory research toward paths that are both impactful and engineering-feasible.
  • Develop Agentic Workflows: Design, prototype, and validate intelligent agentic systems and automated workflows that facilitate writing clean code, identifying root causes of system issues, and remediating complex bugs and vulnerabilities.
  • Develop Pragmatic Prototypes: Build hands-on prototypes that prove the viability and scalability of research concepts. Proactively identify engineering bottlenecks or scalability limits and propose effective mitigations early in the research phase.
  • Evaluate & Benchmark: Drive the rigorous evaluation of new product features. Construct high-quality datasets, define relevant success metrics, and implement comprehensive benchmarks leveraging Sonar’s existing IP alongside third-party and open-source AI tools.
  • Engineer Data Pipelines: Build and manage robust data pipelines to gather, process, and version massive code-centric datasets required for training and evaluating specialized models at scale.
  • Translate Prototypes to Products: Collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to integrate successful prototypes into Sonar's cutting-edge products, ensuring they meet the needs of our global user base.
  • Communicate and Evangelize: Clearly articulate and document complex technical concepts and research findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

    • Experience and qualifications

  • Strong software engineering experience (minimum 2+ years in industry) with proficiency in Python and major modern programming languages.

  • Experience of driving research projects from initial ideation to a demonstrable prototype with a high degree of autonomy.

  • Hands-on experience integrating third-party tools, program analysis frameworks, or open-source libraries into functional prototypes.

  • Proven experience in data handling: constructing high-quality datasets, defining objective success metrics, and building robust benchmarks for new solutions.

  • The ability to fast context-switch and maintain momentum across multiple concurrent, fast-moving research topics.

  • Excellent communication skills in English, with a talent for translating complex research findings into clear, actionable artifacts for product engineering squads.

title: Research Manager, AI Safety
descriptionHtml:
You support a group of fellows through the AI Safety Fellowship, so that each one does strong work and leaves with a clear next step.

  • Salary: £86,750–£121,500 per year. We may be able to pay more for exceptional candidates.

  • Location: London, at our office at LISA

  • Hours: 0.5 to 1 full-time equivalent

  • Focus: From technical AI safety to AI governance possible

  • Visa: We can sponsor a Skilled Worker visa, but approval isn't guaranteed.

Why work at Pivotal

Pivotal finds people who can work on the biggest risks from advanced AI and gets them working on them. Since 2024, 135 fellows have taken part in our fellowships, and alumni now work at METR, Apollo Research, UK AISI and GovAI. We have grown from 2 staff in 2024 to 10 today, and we plan to reach at least 16 in 2027. Read more about us at pivotal-research.org, and about what it is like to work here.

What you will own

You'll be the Research Manager for about 6 research fellows, supporting each project from scoping through to publication. You'll collaborate closely with our whole research management team.

You'll engage deeply with your fellows' work: reading drafts, questioning experimental designs, suggesting framings, and helping projects stay ambitious but tractable. You’ll also hold the thread that keeps projects moving and fellows well supported.

The research support includes:

  • Run weekly 1:1 check-ins with each fellow; resolve bottlenecks quickly and adjust plans based on results.

  • Give clear, actionable feedback on drafts, figures, methodology, and experimental design.

  • Work with fellows and their mentors to scope projects that are both tractable and high-impact.

  • Coordinate mentors effectively: identify gaps in mentorship coverage and fill them yourself or through targeted introductions.

  • Help fellows with career planning, grant applications, and post-fellowship transitions.

  • Collaborate with the rest of the Pivotal team on infrastructure, and the overall fellowship experience.

Research management at Pivotal

As an individual researcher, you might advance one or two projects. In this role, you'll have a hand in about 6 projects simultaneously (and about 18 projects every year). Your leverage comes from making each fellow meaningfully more effective than they would be on their own.

The AI safety field still has a limited talent pipeline, and many of the people who will shape it over the next few years are early in their careers, still developing their research taste, and often short on high-quality guidance. This role sits at that bottleneck. You’ll help the next generation of researchers produce stronger work, find the right collaborators, and move into positions where they can have outsized impact.

If you get energy from seeing other people's work click into place, this role may let you shape the field more than you could as a single researcher.

Who does well in this role

We don’t expect candidates to arrive as fully formed research managers. We do expect strong potential, good judgment, and real motivation to grow quickly in the role. The traits & backgrounds below are signals we think may matter.

  • Research experience in AI safety, machine learning or AI governance, enough to judge whether a project is on track and to give useful feedback.

  • Good research taste: you can tell which projects matter and which are likely to stall.

  • Strong project management across many projects at once.

  • Ability to keep momentum across multiple projects simultaneously — balancing attention to detail with the ability to context-switch.

  • Care for people: fellows trust you and tell you early when things go wrong.

  • Clear, direct communication, in writing and in person.

  • A network in the AI safety field is a plus, because it helps with mentors and with fellows' careers.

We don’t expect anyone to be strong in all of this. If the role excites you, please apply, even if you match only part of what we describe here.

How we hire

We review applications as they come in, so applying early helps. The process has these stages:

  • Written application. A short form and your CV. It takes about 30 minutes.

  • Automated video interview. About 10 minutes. You record short answers to a few questions, at a time that suits you.

  • Work task. About 2 hours, based on real work in this role. We pay you for this time. You may use AI tools, as you would in the job. Tell us which ones you used and how.

  • Personal interview. About 45 minutes. We discuss your work task and how you would approach the role. With your consent, we record it so that more of the team can review it.

  • Work trial and references. Up to three paid days working with us at our office in London. We also speak to two referees, after asking you.

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
descriptionHtml:
Tracksuit exists to help marketers prove their brand building is working. We give teams the data they need to make smarter decisions, convince stakeholders, defend budgets, and track their progress. The brand tracking industry is dominated by 100-page reports, static data and big price-tags. We're doing things differently by being built for the modern marketer: always-on, accessible, and approachable.

We're now tracking more than 16,000 brands across 25 countries globally. With offices in Auckland, Sydney, London and New York City, we're scaling fast with a brilliant team of collaborative and ambitious humans. Our culture is defined by "high care, high performance". We strive to be the best and look after each other while we do it.

Are you our next Sales Development Representative in London?

Brand matters. Most marketers know that already. As a Sales Development Representative (SDR), you'll be the first person at Tracksuit a lot of them hear from. That's a big deal, and we treat it that way.

You'll start the conversations that grow our pipeline. You'll research who matters, reach out in a way that earns a reply, and book meetings for our Account Executives. We use AI tools and signals to work out who to contact and when, so the busywork shrinks and the thinking is yours. You'll start in the new year alongside a bigger London team, just as we reveal the next chapter of brand tracking in January 2027.

We're hiring SDRs at two levels through this ad, so whether you're building your outbound skills or already have a strong track record, we'd like to hear from you.

What you'll do

  • Build and refine lead lists using AI tools and signals

  • Write sequences and messages that people want to reply to

  • Reach out by email, phone and LinkedIn

  • Book qualified meetings and create deals for our Account Executives

  • Work with Account Executives to plan how we approach their key accounts

  • Share what you learn about buyers and the market, and help us get better at outbound

  • Keep our records clean, so everyone can see what's working

At the experienced level, you'll also help shape the sequences and playbooks the team uses, and help newer SDRs get up to speed.

What you'll bring

  • You start conversations with people you don't know. Some experience in sales development, business development or a similar role, ideally in SaaS, marketing technology, advertising or media. That's a guide, not a hard line. We care most about what you've done.

  • Drive that holds up after a "no". Outbound means hearing no a lot. You keep going, and you work out what to try next.

  • You're organised. You can take a long list and know where to start, and you keep your CRM tidy.

  • You want to be coached. You ask for feedback and use it quickly. (Fair warning: you'll get to show us this in the interview.)

  • Clear, kind communication. In writing and out loud.

Bonus points if you love brands, or know marketing or marketing technology.

Why you'll like it here

  • You'll start with a cohort. You'll join alongside other new starters, so you'll learn and ramp up together, not on your own.

  • Time together in the office. With the team in 3 to 4 days a week, you'll pick things up faster: sitting alongside people who've done it before, getting feedback in the moment, and celebrating the wins together.

  • A front-row seat. You'll talk with marketing teams at growing brands who are doing interesting things.

  • A real path to grow. Learn from great salespeople, with room to grow into an Account Executive, or into our agency and customer teams.

  • A team that wins together. High care, high performance. We're competitive, but we're not jerks about it.

Salary

We have two pay bands for this role. The band you're offered depends on the skills and experience you show us through the process, not just your years in the job.

  • Sales Development Representative: £36,000 to £44,000 base salary, with on-target earnings (OTE) of £45,000 to £55,000. For people building their outbound skills who want great coaching and a clear path to grow.

  • Sales Development Representative, experienced level: £41,000 to £50,000 base salary, with OTE of £51,000 to £63,000. For people who already book meetings consistently, write outreach that others learn from, and can help bring newer SDRs along.

The bands overlap on purpose, so we can place you fairly. We'll confirm your band, and where you sit in it, before we make an offer.

OTE is your base salary plus commission when you hit 100% of your target. Commission depends on performance and isn't guaranteed.

The details

  • Location. London, our Clerkenwell office. We're office-first, so you'll be in with the team 3 to 4 days each week.

  • Start date. Offers by the first week of January, with hires starting from mid-January into February.

How our process works

We want to get to know more of the people who apply, not just the ones whose CV tells the whole story. So instead of shortlisting on CVs alone, we'll invite more applicants into the first stage of our process.

That first stage happens in your own time. You'll record a short video interview and complete any other quick online steps, whenever suits you over a few days. It's your chance to show us how you think and what drives you. AI tools help us review these, and a real person makes every decision.

Once we've reviewed the video interviews, shortlisted candidates get a chance to speak with our Talent team about the role and their application in more detail. Then you'll come into our office to interview with the team. We'll let you know exactly what to expect, and anything to prepare, when we invite you.

Key dates

  • From Monday 23 November: invitations to record your video interview, sent as applications come in

  • Sunday 29 November: applications close

  • Once we've reviewed the video interviews: if you're shortlisted, a chance to talk with our Talent team about the role and your application in more detail

  • Monday 14 to Wednesday 16 December: interviews in our office. That's our goal, though some interviews may take place the following week

  • By the first week of January: outcomes and offers, once we're back from the Christmas break

  • From mid-January into February: new hires start

You'll hear from us either way.

Sound like you? Hit apply before Sunday 29 November. We'd love to hear from you.

title: SDR – Sales Development Representative (m/w/d) – SME / KMU | Berlin (Hybrid)
descriptionHtml:
SDR – Sales Development Representative (m/w/d) – SME / KMU | Berlin (Hybrid)

Unbefristet · Vollzeit · Start zum 1. Januar 2027 oder früher · Berlin, 2 Tage pro Woche im Office (Montag und Donnerstag)

Du hast bereits mindestens zwei Jahre B2B-Sales-Erfahrung und willst im Inbound-Vertrieb für den deutschen Mittelstand richtig Verantwortung übernehmen? Bei Pennylane in Berlin qualifizierst du Unternehmen, die bereits Interesse an unserer Software gezeigt haben, verstehst ihr Buchhaltungs-Setup und ihre Herausforderungen und vereinbarst passende Demo-Termine für unsere Account Executives – ohne Kaltakquise.

Du willst Arbeit, die etwas bewirkt – an einem Produkt, das bald Millionen von Unternehmer:innen in Europa helfen könnte?

Du arbeitest am besten in einer Kultur, die auf Vertrauen und Eigenverantwortung setzt?

Dann könnte Pennylane genau der richtige Ort für dich sein.

Unsere Vision

Unser Ziel ist es, die beliebteste Finanzmanagement-Software für KMU in Europa zu werden.

Wir befreien Unternehmer:innen von zeitraubenden Aufgaben in Buchhaltung und Finanzen und geben ihnen die Finanzkennzahlen an die Hand, die sie für die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen brauchen.

Gleichzeitig helfen wir Steuerkanzleien, weniger Zeit mit repetitiven Aufgaben und mehr Zeit mit der Beratung ihrer Mandant:innen zu verbringen.

Kontext

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich – und wir sind im zweiten Jahr unserer Expansion nach Deutschland, mit unserem deutschen Team in Berlin.

In 6 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

  • 💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Steuerberater:innen bekannt gemacht.

  • 💰 Wir haben insgesamt 400 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, PayPal und viele mehr investiert hat.

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf mehr als 1.100 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

  • 🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeitenden bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

  • 🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen tausender Kund:innen und Steuerkanzleien gewonnen – mit herausragenden Bewertungen.

  • 🚀 Bereits mehr als 1.300.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 6.500 Steuerkanzleien nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

Warum ist diese Rolle so wichtig für uns?

Das SDR-Team ist entscheidend dafür, wie wir neue Kund:innen gewinnen.

Als erstes Glied in unserer Sales-Kette prüfen SDRs, welche Anfragen gut zu Pennylane passen, und machen daraus Gesprächstermine – und legen damit die Basis für den Erfolg des gesamten Teams.

Das deutsche SDR-Team besteht aktuell aus 2 Personen, und du gestaltest es mit, während es wächst. Du berichtest direkt an Jacob, unseren Global Head of Sales SME, und bringst deine Erfahrung aktiv in den Aufbau unseres deutschen SME-Vertriebs ein – mit Sales Academy, Buddy und Shadowing bringen wir dich schnell auf Pennylane-Niveau.

Wie trägst du zum Projekt bei?

Wir erhalten täglich viele Inbound-Anfragen von Unternehmen, die Pennylane kennenlernen möchten. Genau mit diesen arbeitest du – 100 % Inbound-Vertrieb, Kaltakquise (Outbound) gibt es in dieser Rolle nicht.

Die größte Herausforderung: Tempo, Volumen und Qualifizierungstiefe in Balance halten. Du reagierst schnell auf deutsche Interessent:innen und gehst gleichzeitig tief genug, um ihr Buchhaltungs-Setup, ihre geschäftlichen Herausforderungen und die Komplexität ihres Falls wirklich zu verstehen.

Konkret heißt das:

  • Du qualifizierst deutsche KMU-Leads: Unternehmensprofil, aktuelle Buchhaltungs- und Finanz-Tools, Pain Points, Bedarf und Kaufkontext

  • Du machst aus qualifizierten Leads hochwertige Termine mit dem passenden Account Executive – relevant, sauber terminiert und mit hoher Wahrscheinlichkeit, dass sie stattfinden

  • Du sorgst für eine saubere Übergabe und dokumentierst Qualifizierung, Use Cases, Stakeholder, Dringlichkeit, aktuelles Setup und nächste Schritte in Salesforce

  • Du fasst per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn nach und reaktivierst Leads, die abgetaucht sind oder einen Termin verpasst haben

  • Du entwickelst unseren deutschen SME-Vertrieb mit: Du teilst Marktfeedback, verbesserst unser Messaging und arbeitest eng mit AEs, Marketing und dem gesamten Sales-Team zusammen

  • Optional, je nach Erfahrung: Du verantwortest den kompletten Sales-Zyklus für Self-Sign-up-Abbrecher – du reaktivierst Interessent:innen, die ihre Registrierung nicht abgeschlossen haben, zeigst ihnen die passende Lösung und schließt die Opportunity selbst ab

Dein Erfolg misst sich vor allem an stattgefundenen qualifizierten Terminen, Show-Rate, Akzeptanz durch die AEs, der Conversion von Termin zu validierter Opportunity und der beeinflussten Pipeline. Die Ziele kalibrieren wir gemeinsam am Volumen und der Reife des deutschen Marktes.

Wie sehen deine Aufgaben im Alltag aus?

So sieht dein Einstieg bei uns aus:

Die ersten 30 Tage

  • Du lernst Pennylanes Produkt, unseren Ideal Customer, den deutschen Marktkontext, unsere Qualifizierungsmethodik, Salesforce und unsere internen Sales-Prozesse kennen und begleitest SDR- und AE-Calls (Shadowing)

Bis Tag 60

  • Du qualifizierst deutsche Leads eigenständig, erkennst ihre zentralen Pain Points und übergibst sie mit vollständigen, verwertbaren Notizen an den richtigen AE

Bis Tag 90

  • Du verantwortest den gesamten Qualifizierungsprozess für deutsche SME-Leads, erfüllst die vereinbarten Aktivitäts- und Qualitätsstandards, lieferst einen verlässlichen Fluss hochwertiger Termine und identifizierst erste Hebel für bessere Conversion und besseres Messaging

Nach 12 Monaten

  • Du bist ein verlässlicher, autonomer SDR für den deutschen SME-Markt, erreichst oder übertriffst deine KPIs, kennst deutsche Kundenprofile, Buchhaltungs-Workflows und typische Einwände aus dem Effeff und wirst von den AEs als Quelle hochwertiger Opportunities geschätzt

  • Du prägst unser deutsches Sales-Playbook mit und beschleunigst den Aufbau unseres SME-Go-to-Market in Deutschland

  • Abhängig von deiner Leistung und offenen Positionen kannst du dich perspektivisch in Richtung Account Executive entwickeln

Wen wir suchen

  • Du bringst mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb mit – als SDR/BDR, im Inside Sales oder in einer vergleichbaren kundenorientierten Rolle, idealerweise in SaaS, Fintech, Buchhaltungssoftware oder einem anderen beratungsintensiven Vertriebsumfeld

  • Du führst starke Discovery- und Qualifizierungsgespräche: Du verstehst das Buchhaltungs- und Finanz-Setup eines Unternehmens, erkennst Pain Points, Dringlichkeit und Entscheider:innen und beurteilst, ob eine Anfrage zu Pennylane passt

  • Du arbeitest mit hoher Eigenverantwortung, Follow-up-Disziplin und CRM-Sorgfalt: hohes Lead-Volumen, saubere Salesforce-Daten, hochwertige Übergaben an die AEs

  • Du bist neugierig, kundenorientiert und ein:e starke:r aktive:r Zuhörer:in – du stellst die richtigen Fragen und gibst dich nicht mit Oberflächenantworten zufrieden

  • Du bist resilient, diszipliniert und proaktiv: Du gehst souverän mit Absagen um, bleibst beim Nachfassen dran und hältst in einem schnellen Sales-Umfeld ein hohes Tempo

  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem oder nahezu muttersprachlichem Niveau und verhandlungssicheres Englisch (unsere Unternehmenssprache)

  • Ein Plus: Erfahrung mit Inbound-Qualifizierung und Salesforce, Verständnis für Buchhaltungs-, Finanz- oder ERP-Prozesse, Erfahrung im Verkauf an Steuerberater:innen, Finanzteams oder Geschäftsinhaber:innen – und Französischkenntnisse

Was wir bieten

  • 📄 Unbefristeter Vollzeitvertrag, Start zum 1. Januar 2027 oder früher

  • 🏢 Hybrides Arbeiten: 2 Tage pro Woche (Montag und Donnerstag) in unserem Berliner Office, die übrigen Tage flexibel; gelegentliche Reisen

  • 🎓 Strukturiertes Onboarding: Sales Academy, Buddy-Programm und Shadowing

  • 🚀 Entwicklungsperspektive in Richtung Account Executive – abhängig von Leistung und offenen Positionen

  • 🌴 Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage.

  • 💵 Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.

  • 📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

  • 🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.

  • 🇬🇧 Du erhältst Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu perfektionieren.

  • 💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

  • 🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen.

  • 🌍 Ein internationales Team mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten und ein starkes, gut finanziertes Mutterunternehmen in Frankreich

🤝 Bewerbungsprozess

  1. Kennenlerngespräch mit Mirko, Recruiter (30 Min.)

  2. Zweites Gespräch mit Jacob, Global Head of Sales SME (30 Min.)

  3. Praktische Case Study und Debrief mit Jacob, Global Head of Sales SME, und einem Mitglied des Sales-SME-Teams (45 Min.) – wir schauen auf Discovery-Qualität, Gesprächsführung und Struktur

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. title: (Senior) Account Executive | Fund Administration | VC & PE
descriptionHtml:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

Your Role

  • This role is key to supporting bunch's growth going forward. You will establish and execute our commercial strategy with Enterprise customers, including larger VC funds, leading to bunch becoming the industry standard for private market investments.

  • A successful hire will contribute to setting our Commercial strategy at pace. You will play a key role in building further market knowledge and relations with potential VC customers, supporting bunch during a pivotal time.

Top responsibilities

  • Acquire new Enterprise customers across our markets (inbound and outbound).

  • Co-build a commercial acquisition strategy for new customer segments, mostly large Venture Capital funds.

  • Build and maintain relationships between bunch and i) General Partners (GPs) / CFOs / COOs of prospect and client funds, and ii) Angel investors.

  • Understand the pain points faced by prospects and customers to develop account plans for specific lists of target accounts, including demand generation and closing plans.

  • Stay informed about the competitive landscape to create winning proposals and pricing strategies.

  • Collaborate with the Strategy, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to develop best practices for generating demand and increasing customer engagement within the target accounts.

  • Create business cases that demonstrate the business value and return on investment clients can expect by using bunch.

  • Nurture client relationships, strive for process excellence that allows us to maximise customer satisfaction and ensure long-term retention.

About You

  • At least 5 years of experience as an Account Executive or in a commercial role, ideally within the private investment market. A local network of VC Fund Managers in London is a strong differentiator.

  • Excellent relationship-building and communication skills that enable you to gain trust through authenticity, expertise, and rapport-building.

  • A results-oriented, impact-driven mindset: you're curious to understand the broader context and expected outcomes, and you approach tasks with an entrepreneurial spirit to get things done.

  • Customer-centricity: you proactively understand and champion our customers' goals, always striving to provide value and align with their objectives.

  • Operational excellence in SaaS sales: you're skilled in optimising the sales process, analysing conversion rates, managing end-to-end sales funnels, and ensuring pipeline efficiency.

  • Business-level fluency in English.

Workplace and Benefits

  • Customisable benefits package covering wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more

  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

  • Up to 6 remote calendar weeks a year

  • A great tech and work setup

  • Work with a diverse team of 130+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

What your interview journey will look like

  • Initial call with the People team (30 min) to get to know more about the role

  • Deep Dive with a Team member (30 min) for us to learn more about your ways of working

  • Case Study Interview with the team (60 min) for us to get a sense of how you approach Sales

  • Optional Meet & Greet: Meeting our Stakeholders at bunch Offices (2 x 30min)

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.

title: Senior Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
Our Purpose

Scheduling isn’t simply filling shifts. It’s finding the sweet spot that enables businesses to grow and team members to enjoy the perfect work/life balance.

At Planday from Xero, we aim to use Agentic AI to build a future where managers seamlessly can free up invaluable time for their business and teams. We’re not just building software; we’re on a mission to make shift work more human, to change work/life balance from a luxury to a reality for all shift workers. We’re using advanced technology to help humans reach their full potential. At work and in life.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark and helps create perfect schedules for hundreds of thousands of users across the world. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

How you’ll make an impact

As a Senior Account Executive, you will drive new business growth by owning and developing your territory. You will lead complex sales cycles end to end by deeply understanding mid market and Enterprise customer challenges and translating Planday’s capabilities into clear operational value for their business.

You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, taking ownership of pipeline creation, deal progression, and forecast accuracy, and bringing a strong point of view on how Planday creates value for customers.

What you’ll do

  • Own and grow your territory with accountability for new ARR

  • Build and progress pipeline through proactive prospecting and account planning

  • Take end-to-end ownership of the sales funnel, from outbound cold prospecting, multi-channel outreach, and self-sourcing pipeline to running demos and closing.

  • Map key accounts across UK shift-intensive sectors (hospitality, care, retail, events) and build targeted outbound campaigns.

  • Lead full sales cycles with multiple stakeholders and longer decision processes

  • Run high-quality discovery to understand customer challenges and position value clearly

  • Lead customer discovery, deliver tailored product demos and lead commercial negotiation to provide solutions aligned to customer needs

  • Maintain strong pipeline hygiene and forecasting discipline

  • Collaborative, low-ego approach and ability to work across teams to win priority opportunities and improve execution

What you’ll bring with you

  • 2+ years of experience as a full-cycle / 360 B2B SaaS Account Executive, with a strong track record of self-sourcing pipeline.

  • Track record of consistently closing new business through self-directed sales activity

  • Experience selling to mid-market and enterprise customers with complex needs

  • Strong commercial judgment and ability to manage your own territory as a business

  • Excellent discovery, communication, and negotiation skills

  • Comfortable running technical product demos and adapting them to customer use cases

  • Comfortable operating with autonomy, structure, and accountability

  • Curious, resilient, and motivated by building something rather than inheriting it

  • Experience selling into workforce-intensive industries such as healthcare, hospitality or retail is preferred.

Success looks like

descriptionHtml:
Hi 👋 we’re Genio. We create beautifully simple learning tools that boost knowledge, skills, and confidence.

  • We’re a SaaS scale up - there’s 90+ of us around the UK with our HQ in Leeds.
  • Our software is award-winning and used by 100,000s of students at over 1,000 universities & colleges worldwide.
  • We’re driven achieve our mission to support 1 million students to become better learners by 2030.

🚀 About the role

Career track: IC4

Unit: Shared Services

Genio has given everyone access to Claude, but most of what makes AI work across a company doesn’t exist here yet: connections to our business systems, a shared skills library, people in each team who can help their colleagues, and the checks that keep it safe. This role designs and builds that system, then gets every team using it.

It’s a hands-on building role. We buy and configure leading platforms rather than build our own agent infrastructure, and you’ll write code and build custom integrations wherever configuration isn’t enough. Success is measured by how well other teams build and run their own workflows.

You will be responsible for:

  • Design. You design how our AI platforms, connectors, skills and agents fit together. You track what’s changing in AI tools, recommend platform and model choices to the Head of BizOps, and judge new tools on measured performance, reliability, security and cost.
  • Build and run. You build and maintain the integrations and agents that connect our AI platforms to business systems such as our CRM and our documentation, communication and finance tools. You’re responsible for the health of the whole system: spotting failures and out-of-date skills, and tracking use and cost by team so they can be recharged and reported. Champions answer first-line questions and IT handles access, while you handle escalations and fix root causes so problems don’t come back.
  • Knowledge. You build and look after the skills library and the shared knowledge our AI tools draw on: where it lives, how it’s organised, and how it’s kept current and correctly permissioned. You spot good workflows in one team, refine them and make them available to everyone, and decide which become company standards. The teams that own content keep it up to date.
  • Adoption. You train people at every level of technical skill and build a network of champions, nominated by their function heads, so every team has someone nearby to ask. You work alongside teams as they redesign processes, bringing the options for what can be automated, and share practice with engineering in both directions. You also report, team by team, where use is growing, where it’s slow and which uses are producing value.
  • Guardrails. You keep the inventory of AI tools and what each can access, run a fast track for low-risk trials using criteria from our AI policy, and coordinate security, data protection and legal reviews for everything else. Every trial starts with agreed success criteria and ends with a decision to adopt, scale or stop. You configure and check guardrails, such as human review before AI output reaches customers or students, and limits on what agents can do on Genio’s behalf.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

About the role

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

We're looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to lead the data architecture behind our most business-critical financial work: billing, regulatory reporting (EMI), SOX compliance, financial forecasting and executive reporting. You'll design the data solutions that finance, payments and audit teams depend on, set the standards for how analytics work ships, and mentor others on the team.

This is a shape-the-team role. You'll have real influence over how we work, what we build and the pace we move at.

We expect you to use AI fluently where it adds leverage in modeling, code review and debugging, and to apply clear judgment on where it doesn't.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture and development of high-impact data models in dbt.

  • Architect data solutions across business-critical financial workflows, including billing, regulatory reporting (EMI), SOX compliance, financial forecasting and executive reporting.

  • Mentor analytics engineers and review code to uphold standards across the team.

  • Find and fix performance bottlenecks across the data stack.

  • Translate business problems into clean, efficient data solutions in close partnership with stakeholders.

  • Set team-wide standards for documentation, CI/CD, observability and testing.

  • Set the team's norms for where AI belongs in our workflow, from model development to code review, and where human oversight stays non-negotiable.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in analytics engineering or a similar role, with a track record of designing data models that hold up to cross-functional use.

  • Deep, hands-on expertise with dbt, SQL and Python on a modern data platform (Databricks or equivalent).

  • You catch AI's errors before anything ships, including hallucinations, overconfident answers and plausible-but-wrong code, and you have a clear sense of where human oversight stays non-negotiable.

title: Senior Applied Scientist, Efficient LLM Inference & Model Optimization
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Nebius Token Factory is looking for scientists who can turn frontier LLM and VLM inference bottlenecks into research questions, conduct rigorous experiments, and translate their findings into production capabilities. You will own focused research and optimization projects, write strong code, and produce prototypes, publications, and technical artifacts that engineers can build on.

Your research will span quantization, distillation, speculative decoding, KV-cache optimization, and model/runtime co-optimization, alongside inference engines and distributed inference architectures. You will investigate how these approaches interact, evaluate their trade-offs across model quality, latency, throughput, memory footprint, and cost per token, and work with engineering teams to bring promising results into production.

Your responsibilities

  • Lead research projects in efficient LLM and VLM inference, from hypotheses and experiments through ablations, prototypes, and production handoff.
  • Develop and evaluate methods spanning quantization, quantization-aware training (QAT), distillation, speculative decoding, KV-cache reuse, KV-cache compression, long-context inference, MoE routing, and model/runtime co-optimization.
  • Build prototypes using PyTorch, Triton, CUDA-adjacent tooling, or inference-serving frameworks, and collaborate with MLEs and platform engineers to turn them into production components.
  • Research LLM request routing and scheduling strategies, including cache-aware load balancing and prefill–decode disaggregation (PDD). Evaluate how queueing, KV-cache transfer, worker placement, and prefill/decode capacity allocation affect latency, throughput, and serving cost.
  • Investigate multi-node inference for dense and mixture-of-experts models, including wide expert parallelism (WideEP). Study expert placement, load imbalance, and computation/communication trade-offs, and use the findings to guide model and system architecture choices.
  • Develop rigorous evaluations covering quality, latency, throughput, numerical stability, memory footprint, tail latency, and cost per token. Compare serving architectures under consistent workload conditions and GPU budgets.
  • Work with MLE, GPU kernel, backend infrastructure, product, and customer teams to select research priorities with measurable production impact.
  • Share results through internal reports, technical blogs, papers, and open-source artifacts, and mentor engineers and scientists on experimental design, scientific rigor, and model/system trade-offs.

Must-haves

  • A PhD in computer science, machine learning, ML systems, computer systems, computer architecture, electrical engineering, applied mathematics, or a closely related discipline.
  • A strong publication record or equivalent research artifacts in ML, ML systems, efficient inference, model compression, quantization, distillation, serving systems, or related areas.
  • Strong Python and PyTorch implementation skills, with the ability to turn ideas into experiments and working prototypes.
  • Deep knowledge of LLMs, VLMs, transformer inference, decoding algorithms, model compression, quantization, and production-serving trade-offs.
  • Strong experimental design skills covering ablations, baselines, metrics, statistical reasoning, and failure analysis.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.

Nice-to-haves

  • First-author publications at venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, MLSys, ACL, EMNLP, ASPLOS, OSDI, SOSP, ISCA, or HPCA.
  • Experience deploying ML models or inference optimizations in production.
  • Experience with vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, NVIDIA Dynamo, FlashAttention, FlashInfer, Triton, CUDA, or PyTorch internals.
  • Experience applying post-training, SFT, DPO, RLHF, RLAIF, preference optimization, or synthetic data generation to inference quality or efficiency.
  • Open-source research artifacts, widely used benchmarks, technical blogs, or invited talks demonstrating contributions to efficient AI systems.
  • Research or implementation experience in one or more areas of distributed inference system architecture, such as LLM request routing, PDD, multi-node serving, or MoE expert parallelism, including WideEP.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: Senior Commercial Deal Desk Analyst
descriptionHtml:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

We’re looking for a Senior Commercial Deal Desk Analyst to help build and scale 1Password’s Commercial Deal Desk capability within Revenue Operations. You’ll partner with Sales, Finance, Legal, and cross-functional teams on complex commercial decisions, while turning what you learn into clear processes, guidance, and tools that help teams move faster with confidence. This role will help strengthen 1Password’s enterprise commercial capabilities as deal complexity and volume grow.

How we’re using AI today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

This is a remote opportunity within the UK.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.

What we're looking for:

  • 4+ years of experience in Deal Desk, Revenue Operations, Commercial Finance, or a related function within a Business-to-Business (B2B) Software as a Service (SaaS) environment.

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and Salesforce Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ)/Revenue Cloud, including resolving complex quoting and cross-object issues.

  • Strong understanding of commercial deal structures, including annual recurring revenue (ARR), multi-year agreements, amendments, renewals, co-terms, ramps, stub billing, bundled products, and discounting.

  • Demonstrated ability to build or improve processes, documentation, approval workflows, and commercial policies in an evolving environment.

  • Sound commercial judgment and the ability to balance customer and seller needs with pricing discipline, revenue integrity, and business risk.

  • Strong cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to influence effectively without formal authority and explain complex commercial concepts clearly.

  • Experience using artificial intelligence (AI), automation, or workflow tools to reduce manual work and improve the quote-to-cash process is preferred.

What you can expect:

  • Partner with Enterprise Account Executives (AEs), Sales Managers, Finance, Legal, and Revenue Operations on complex, non-standard, and high-impact deals.

  • Advise on deal structure, pricing, terms, discounting, approvals, amendments, renewals, co-terms, ramps, bundled products, and other commercial considerations.

  • Review and execute deal submissions in Salesforce CPQ/Revenue Cloud, ensuring quotes and contracts are accurate, complete, and ready for approval and invoicing.

  • Build the foundations of the Commercial Deal Desk, including intake processes, approval routing, discount governance, exception handling, service-level agreements (SLAs), and documentation.

  • Create playbooks, training materials, office hours, and practical guidance that help sales teams navigate commercial processes and quoting tools.

  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows through automation, AI tooling, and CPQ configuration, while partnering with technical teams to implement scalable solutions.

  • Use deal data and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to identify bottlenecks, improve deal quality, and recommend changes that support efficient, sustainable growth.

UK-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between £60,000 GBP and £84,000 GBP, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, pension, and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.


Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

 

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.


Our approach to work
We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.


What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community
🤝 Paid volunteer days
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at ----- and we’ll work to meet your needs.

Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.

title: Senior Communications Manager
descriptionHtml:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team Mission

The Global Communications team builds GetYourGuide's reputation as the leading source of expertise on the experiences category. We deliver value to travelers, partners, and policymakers  through communications that are sharp, credible, and designed to travel.

We operate as a newsroom: fast-moving, editorially driven, and built for distribution at scale. We are investing in the systems, channels, and distribution muscle that ensure every story we develop reaches the right audience, in the right format, at the right time.

As Senior Communications Manager, you will own the operational backbone of GetYourGuide's newsroom. You’ll build the infrastructure it runs on –the story pipeline, media CRM, distribution channels, and owned properties — and you ensure that our original storytelling moves through the system and lands at the right time and on the right channels.

title: Senior Compliance Director – UK
descriptionHtml:
About BJAK

BJAK is Southeast Asia’s largest digital insurance platform, expanding financial access through automation, data, and digital scale. As we grow across markets, we are committed to building a platform that is safe, compliant, and trusted.

We are hiring a Senior Compliance Director – UK to lead regulatory strategy, risk governance, and compliance operations for our UK market entry and expansion alongside the CEO. This role is expected to hold the SMF16 (Compliance Oversight) Senior Management Function once approved, and will act as our primary point of contact with the FCA.

This is a build role: you'll be creating frameworks, policies, and controls from scratch rather than inheriting an existing function.

 

Why This Role Matters

The Senior Compliance Director – UK will:

  • Design and enforce compliance frameworks that enable safe scaling of digital financial services.

  • Ensure BJAK operates in accordance with UK regulatory standards, especially FCA requirements.

  • Protect consumers through transparent, fair, and ethical practices.

  • Establish BJAK as a trusted partner with regulators, partners, and industry stakeholders.

  • Build compliance capability and culture across the company.

 

What You Will Do

Regulatory Leadership & Strategy

  • Develop and maintain compliance frameworks aligned with UK regulatory requirements.

  • Lead regulatory readiness for market entry, licensing, and ongoing supervision.

  • Serve as the primary contact with the FCA and relevant UK bodies.

  • Interpret regulatory changes and guide business strategy accordingly.

 

Risk Governance & Compliance Operations

  • Build policies and controls covering AML, KYC, data privacy, consumer duty, distribution, and claims-related compliance.

  • Conduct risk assessments and implement remediation plans for identified gaps.

  • Establish monitoring, testing, and reporting processes for ongoing compliance.

  • Ensure internal audits, compliance reviews, and control testing are operationalised.

 

Consumer Protection & Business Integrity

  • Embed fairness, transparency, and responsible selling throughout the organisation.

  • Oversee product compliance, marketing reviews, pricing governance, and distribution oversight.

  • Implement complaint handling frameworks aligned with regulatory standards.

 

Cross-Functional Support & Training

  • Partner with product, operations, legal, marketing, and commercial teams to ensure compliant execution.

  • Provide guidance on regulatory implications of new products, partnerships, or distribution models.

  • Deliver training to ensure teams understand and execute compliance responsibilities.

 

You Will Thrive in This Role If You

  • See compliance as a strategic enabler, not a blocker.

  • Operate with high integrity, sound judgment, and strong attention to detail.

  • Communicate clearly and influence leaders using data and logic.

  • Enjoy building frameworks and scaling systems from early-stage to mature environments.

  • Thrive in fast-paced, evolving settings where regulation meets innovation.

 

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of compliance, risk, or regulatory experience within financial services, insurance, insurtech, or fintech.

  • Deep understanding of UK regulatory frameworks, including FCA rules and consumer duty requirements.

  • Experience in compliance for digital platforms, distribution, or insurance products (preferred).

  • Proven ability to design policies, conduct risk assessments, and manage complex compliance programs.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including dealing with regulators.

 

Bonus (Nice to Have)

  • Experience in start-up or high-growth environments.

  • Previous SMF experience.

  • Background in insurtech, digital distribution, or online marketplaces.

  • Knowledge of GDPR, AML, sanctions, or cross-border compliance.

 

Location Requirement

  • This role is based in the UK. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our London office at least 3 days per week.

 

Why Join Us

  • Shape compliance for a fast-growing international fintech-insurtech platform.

  • Build frameworks that enable safe, inclusive financial access at scale.

  • Work closely with leadership and regulators to drive responsible innovation.

  • Competitive compensation with long-term growth and international career opportunities.


Compensations Range

  • We offer a highly competitive package, ranging from £100,000 to £150,000, reflecting both experience and suitability for this pivotal role.

title: Senior Consultant (m/w/d) Data Governance
descriptionHtml:
Seit über 25 Jahren verwandeln wir bei der Windhoff Group Daten in echte Geschäftschancen – von klassischer Business Intelligence bis zur KI-getriebenen Automatisierung. Dabei denken wir ganzheitlich: Wir begleiten unsere Kunden End-to-End, von der Strategie über die technische Umsetzung bis zum produktiven Betrieb. Ob BI-Reporting, Data Warehousing, Predictive Analytics oder KI-Lösungen – unser Anspruch ist es, aus Daten messbaren Mehrwert zu machen.

Als Teil unseres Teams wirst du gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Kolleg:innen an anspruchsvollen Projekten arbeiten und dich in der gesamten Data & AI-Landschaft in die Richtung weiterentwickeln, die zu dir passt.

Neben unserer fachlichen Expertise sind wir ein Arbeitgeber, der Vielfalt fördert und sicherstellt, dass alle Mitarbeitenden fair behandelt werden. Teile uns mit, wenn wir auf etwas besonders Rücksicht nehmen sollen - wie zum Beispiel auf bestimmte Arbeitszeiten oder andere Rahmenbedingungen, deine Situation im Privatleben oder besondere Bedürfnisse bei der Arbeit.

Dein nächster Schritt ist die Rolle Lead Consultant.

unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung oder sexueller Identität.

Benefits
