title: Senior Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Adclear

At Adclear, we're building the trust layer for how the world's most regulated companies bring products to market. Every bank, lender and investment platform runs into the same invisible pain: compliance review that slows down every campaign, every launch, every idea. We're turning the function that has always said 'no' into infrastructure that says 'yes, and here's how'.

This is a fundamental shift in how regulated industries and compliance teams operate, and we're only at the beginning. The product you'll design is what people actually touch when they experience that shift.

Founded in 2024, we've already earned the trust of leading innovators as well as established enterprises including Monzo, Lloyds, PensionBee, Kraken, Coinbase and many others. Our early traction let us raise 2.6m in funding, and we're now scaling fast. We're building the product engine that turns a genuinely novel category into something people love to use, and this is where you come in.

The Role

This is a full-stack product role with real scope: you won't be handed a corner of a system, you'll own complete product slices end-to-end, from spec through to something live that customers depend on every day. Here's a taste of what that looks like in practice:

  • A Chrome extension that runs compliance checks inline in Google Docs, where marketers actually write copy. Built with Monzo as the design partner. Public on the Chrome Web Store.

  • A natural-language copilot for compliance work. Users ask in plain English, the platform proposes typed actions, a human approves, the action runs. Not chat over a database.

  • The interface where reviewers watch the model reason through a decision, step in when they disagree, and feed structured corrections back into the rules.

  • An integration surface that reaches into wherever customers create marketing: Canva, Figma, Google Docs, Contentful, Workfront, Monday.com, Frame.io for video.

  • A dashboard that takes a long, unsorted list of compliance tasks and turns it into a single prioritised queue.

You think in user outcomes and shipped work, not tickets closed. Your code handles edge cases, your APIs have clean contracts, and the work you ship stays shipped. Our users are compliance and marketing teams at leading fintechs. They use Adclear every day, and they'll tell you fast when something's wrong, which is exactly the kind of feedback loop that makes this job good.

What you'll do

  • Own product delivery. Take features from spec to production, frontend-first but covering backend and integration where needed.

  • Build the product surfaces compliance reviewers live in: workflows, review UIs, the moments where model output meets human judgement.

  • Work with AI in the critical path. Ship features where the model is genuinely part of the product, not a bolted-on feature.

  • Ship a change to production on your first day and a feature in your first week. We deploy continuously, so you'll feel the pace immediately.

  • Have real input on what we build, how we build it, and which problems are worth solving next. Nobody here is precious about a roadmap someone else wrote.

What we're looking for

  • Independent delivery. You can own and ship end-to-end product slices with minimal supervision. Your track record shows features that shipped, stuck, and solved real user problems.

  • Product trade-off judgement. You balance speed, quality and user impact under ambiguity. You push back when something is underspecified, and make pragmatic calls when it needs to ship anyway.

  • Product taste. You notice when something feels wrong and aren't afraid to raise it. You care about the smaller details while still knowing when to ship at pace.

  • Cross-functional pragmatism. You work effectively with founders, designers and AI engineers, and you unblock yourself rather than waiting on someone else.

  • AI literacy. You're fluent with modern coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, agents). You treat them as collaborators, know when to trust them and when to override them, and have real opinions about where they help and where they get in the way.

Strong technical depth in:

  • Strong TypeScript and React. Comfortable end-to-end.

  • Building products where AI is in the critical path.

  • Modern web tooling. Node, Postgres.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Cloudflare Workers, Hono, or Drizzle.

  • Experience in regulated industries: fintech, healthtech, legaltech.

The Stack

React and TypeScript on the frontend. A Hono API on Cloudflare Workers. Drizzle and Postgres on the data layer.

How we work

  • Location in London (4 days a week in our Farringdon office)

  • Founders are closely involved in the day-to-day.

  • You talk to customers, you input your expertise on the strategy and execute it with our vision in mind

  • You own what you ship, including after it's shipped.

  • This isn't the right role if you want tightly scoped tickets, a fixed lane, or a strict 40-hour week. The pace is fast and the scope moves.

Compensation

  • Competitive salary

  • Meaningful equity

  • Private healthcare and dental

  • Hardware budget

  • Monthly gym contribution

title: Senior Product Manager - Reconciliation
descriptionHtml:
About us:

BVNK is the stablecoin-powered financial stack for enterprises. We're now part of Mastercard, and together we're building a network for every form of money – one that delivers more reach, more capability and more choice.

We enable businesses to build financial products, unlock new markets, and move money in seconds across 130+ countries, with 40+ licenses for fiat and digital assets globally. Processing billions annually, we empower enterprises worldwide to send, receive, convert, and settle stablecoins and fiat seamlessly through a single integration.

Our mission is to accelerate global money movement, and we're assembling a world-class team to make it happen.

Trusted by industry leaders like Corpay, Worldpay, Deel, and Flywire, we deliver the infrastructure that makes new forms of money usable within the financial systems customers already rely on today.

By combining Mastercard's global payment reach and trusted networks with BVNK's stablecoin infrastructure, we're building the trusted operating layer for the evolution of money movement, helping customers participate in emerging digital networks without having to rebuild their businesses around every new innovation.

We're a diverse team spread across EMEA, North America, and APAC, with a shared belief that stablecoins are the new infrastructure layer for financial services, and that BVNK is at the forefront of this shift.

We're incredibly honored to have been recognized by:

  • CNBC World's Top Fintech Companies (2026)
  • FXC Intelligence Top 100 Cross-border Payment Companies (2026)
  • Newsweek's The Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces (three years running, most recently 2025)
  • LinkedIn as one of the Top 20 Startups in the UK (2025)

About this role in the team:

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead Reconciliation and Financial Reporting at BVNK.

Your mission is to make sure every movement of money across the BVNK platform, in fiat and in stablecoins, is accounted for, matched and reported correctly. You'll own our internal financial reporting engine and reconciliation platform, and make sure every product we build, including the products we're building with Mastercard, goes live with the right reconciliation and reporting in place.

This is an operations and data-heavy product. You'll work closely with the Reconciliation Operations and Operations Delivery teams to understand where breaks and manual work come from, and turn that into a prioritised backlog. You'll also partner with finance, treasury and compliance, who rely on accurate reconciliation for safeguarding, month-end close and regulatory reporting.

You'll work with engineers across the payments, wallets and ledger teams on the data structures and events that reconciliation depends on, and with small, autonomous engineering squads across BVNK. We see AI as a key lever in how we build, and we expect you to use it in your day-to-day work.

Key Areas of Responsibilities:

  • Own the reconciliation and reporting strategy and roadmap, from how transaction data is captured at source to the reports that finance, operations and regulators rely on.
  • Own BVNK's internal financial reporting engine, including balance, transaction, fee and safeguarding reporting, and make sure it is accurate, timely and auditable.
  • Make sure every new product, currency, payment rail, banking partner and blockchain network is backed by the correct reconciliation and reporting before it launches. Build reconciliation requirements into launch readiness, and work with other PMs so they are planned from the start rather than added afterwards.
  • Work closely with the Reconciliation Operations and Operations Delivery teams to find the root causes of breaks, exceptions and manual workarounds, and build the backlog accordingly.
  • Work with engineers on the payments, wallets and events data structures, so that every transaction carries the identifiers, statuses and metadata needed to match it automatically across internal ledgers, bank and PSP statements, and on-chain activity.
  • Improve the matching engine and exception tooling, including matching rules, break ageing and investigation workflows, and audit trails.
  • Own how external data comes into the platform, such as bank statements (for example camt.053 and MT940), PSP and liquidity provider reports, and blockchain data, along with the data quality controls around it.
  • Partner with finance, treasury, compliance and audit on safeguarding reconciliation, month-end close, and regulatory and audit reporting.
  • Take part in resolving reconciliation and regulatory incidents, including safeguarding incidents. When issues arise, respond quickly, work with Operations, Engineering, Finance and Compliance to find the cause and fix it, and follow up with product changes that stop it happening again.
  • Write clear PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria, and see work through to release.
  • Define and track the measures that matter, such as auto-match rate, number and age of open breaks, time to resolve, reporting timeliness and manual effort. Use data to decide what to build next.

What we need from you:

  • Several years of product management experience in payments, banking or fintech, ideally owning reconciliation, ledger, finance or reporting products.
  • Solid technical knowledge. You're comfortable working with engineers on data models, ledgers, event-driven systems, APIs and data pipelines, and you can reason about technical trade-offs without needing to write the code. You're happy to query data yourself using SQL.
  • A good understanding of reconciliation and financial reporting: double-entry accounting, transaction lifecycles, settlement, matching logic and why breaks happen.
  • Experience in operations, or working closely with operations teams. You understand how exceptions and manual processes are handled day to day, and you build products that reduce them. When something goes wrong, you respond quickly and stay calm under pressure.
  • Experience in the payments and/or banking industry, for example with payment schemes such as SEPA, ACH, Faster Payments or SWIFT, bank statement formats, or settlement with banks and PSPs.
  • Excellent communication skills. You write clearly, present confidently to senior leaders and explain complex topics simply to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • The ability to build and articulate plans, and to align and communicate on them with other PMs and stakeholders. You manage dependencies across teams, handle competing priorities and can say no with a clear rationale.
  • Comfort with ambiguity. You create structure where requirements are still evolving and keep complex work moving.
  • An AI-native mindset. You're an early adopter of AI tools and agentic workflows, and you use them to research, analyse, write specifications and design solutions, not just to summarise.

Bonus if you have:

  • Experience with stablecoins, blockchain networks or crypto operations, including on-chain reconciliation of wallets.
  • Experience building or replacing a reconciliation platform, either in-house or with a vendor.
  • Experience with safeguarding or regulatory reporting for e-money or payment institutions.
  • Experience with products that run across several regulated entities or jurisdictions.

What you can expect from us:

  • Fair and competitive salary at every stage of your growth
  • Flexible working hours, with hybrid working at its heart
  • A culture built on passionate, growth-minded people
  • A flexible approach to holiday
  • Opportunities to travel to our offices around the world
  • An open and creative environment where you can help us define the future of BVNK, its culture, and its opportunity sets

At BVNK, we are focused on building a diverse and inclusive team. While you may not meet all of our requirements, we’d encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of our expectations. You may be a great fit for this role or another role in our team.

title: Senior Product Manager, Technical (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About the Company

Affinidi is a technology company dedicated to changing data ownership for good. We empower businesses and individuals with control and ownership of their data, with a comprehensive approach to managing their holistic identity – accounting for all aspects of their digital footprint while ensuring privacy and security.

Affinidi’s technology enables users to benefit from decentralised digital identity solutions. We believe that everyone has the right to own and control their data, and we are committed to creating a trusted digital credentials ecosystem that empowers businesses and individuals to securely exchange data and services across borders and industries.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager (Technical) who wants to help define how trust is built into the next generation of AI systems. At Affinidi, we’re building the Trust Fabric product suite to give AI agents verifiable identity, policy guardrails, and real-time observability, so organisations can move from promising proofs of concept to secure, governed production deployments with confidence. 

This is a role for builders. You’ll work side by side with engineering to turn ambitious ideas into real, high-impact products, fast, iteratively, and with strong product judgment. You’ll take on complex, ambiguous challenges that don’t come with a playbook, bring structure to what matters, and help the team move with clarity, speed, and conviction. You’ll also collaborate with deeply engaged teams and senior leaders in an environment that expects high standards, values ownership, and gives you the chance to shape meaningful products from the ground up. 

If you like combining technical depth, product thinking, and execution, you’ll fit right in. 

What you’ll be doing 

  • Shape and deliver solutions: Partner closely with engineers to define and refine solutions early, helping move ideas from concept to production in practical, incremental steps while staying close enough to implementation to understand trade-offs and guide decisions. 
  • Drive focused, outcome-oriented delivery:Balance user needs, market context, and execution speed while focusing on getting working solutions into users’ hands for validation, then iterate based on feedback and measurable outcomes. 
  • Work through ambiguity: Take ownership of areas where requirements are not fully defined, structure problems into clear, actionable paths forward, and maintain momentum even as direction continues to evolve. 
  • Own product direction:Contribute to product strategy and roadmap definition, align short-term priorities with longer-term platform thinking, and make thoughtful trade-offs that support both delivery and scalability. 
  • Collaborate across stakeholders: Work across engineering, design, and go-to-market teams, engage effectively with senior and executive stakeholders, and bring alignment and clarity in environments with diverse perspectives. 
  • Be developer-obsessed: Understand developer workflows and key pain points, and help improve integration, usability, and the overall product experience. 

 What we’re looking for 

  • Core experience: You bring 5+ years of experience in Technical Product Management, a strong technical background that lets you engage deeply with engineering topics, hands-on experience working with APIs, systems, and integrations, and a proven track record of delivering products in close collaboration with engineering teams. 
  • Technical depth: You are comfortable understanding how systems are designed and operate in practice, able to engage in technical discussions, challenge assumptions, and evaluate trade-offs, and willing to go into detail when needed by reviewing flows, investigating issues, or clarifying implementation approaches. 
  • Mindset: You take ownership from problem to outcome, are comfortable working with ambiguity and evolving priorities, combine structured thinking with a bias toward action, and can move between big-picture strategy and practical execution. 
  • Collaboration & communication: You communicate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences, are comfortable working with experienced, highly engaged stakeholders, and know how to build alignment and drive decisions forward. 
  • Nice to have: It’s a plus if you have had exposure to identity, distributed systems, or similar domains, and experience in fast-paced, product-led environments. 

What you’ll get 

  • A team that values ownership, quality, and speed 
  • Close collaboration between product and engineering 
  • Hybrid working model in Berlin + flexible hours 
  • Unlimited vacation 
  • Competitive compensation 
  • A strong environment to learn, build, and have impact 

Equal Opportunity 

We believe in hiring different and diverse talent and providing a safe space where everyone can share their views without fear, where differences are celebrated, and where no one is left out. Inclusive cultures are the foundation for collaboration and innovation within our team. 

Privacy Notice

By applying for this position, you confirm that you have read and understood Affinidi’s Candidate Privacy Policy, and consent to the collection, use, and disclosure of your personal data for recruitment purposes, as described in the policy.

title: Senior Prototype Machinist
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

[Deutsche Version weiter unten]

Your Mission

At The Exploration Company, we develop, manufacture, and operate Nyx — a modular, reusable orbital spacecraft designed to be refuelled in orbit and transport cargo, with crewed missions potentially planned for the longer term.

We’re looking for a hands-on, technically mature professional with an engineering degree or extensive CNC experience to take full ownership of the machining process for space-grade components. You’ll be responsible for CAM programming, machine setup and optimisation, and continuous improvement. You’ll also contribute directly to future investments in machining equipment and tooling.

You’ll work on a variety of high-precision parts, including rocket engine components, post-processed metal 3D-printed parts, and critical propulsion subcomponents. You’ll work across a fleet of modern, multi-brand, 5-axis machining centres and CNC lathes.

This role offers a high-impact technical position, with opportunities for career growth and increased responsibility.

Fluency in English is expected, as our work environment is international.

Your Responsibilities

  • Define and optimise machining strategies, including sequencing, tooling, fixtures, and in-process controls.

  • Program complex components in HyperMill or equivalent CAM software for 5-axis milling and CNC turning.

  • Validate parts using multi-brand CNC equipment, ensuring that they meet tolerance and surface-finish requirements.

  • Manufacture rocket engine components, precision assemblies, propulsion subcomponents, and Inconel structures, including setting workpiece origins and preparing cutting tools.

  • Perform first-line maintenance to keep machines in good working order.

  • Analyse and improve toolpaths, reduce cycle times, and stabilise machining quality.

  • Work with design, quality, and production teams to provide feedback, propose design improvements, and troubleshoot issues.

  • Lead equipment investment efforts, including specification development, supplier coordination, and commissioning.

Profile

  • An engineering degree or 5+ years of experience as a highly skilled technician in CNC/CAM machining of complex parts.

  • Expertise in HyperMill or equivalent CAM software and tight-tolerance machining.

  • Solid knowledge of 5-axis milling and/or precision turning.

  • Experience working with space or aerospace materials, such as Inconel, titanium, and other high-performance alloys.

  • An autonomous, hands-on approach, with the ability to structure and lead technical topics.

  • An interest in developing machining capabilities through process and equipment leadership.

Deutsche Version

Deine Mission

Bei The Exploration Company entwickeln, fertigen und betreiben wir Nyx – ein modulares, wiederverwendbares Orbitalfahrzeug, das im All betankt werden und Fracht transportieren kann. Langfristig sind auch bemannte Missionen vorgesehen.

Wir suchen eine praxisorientierte, technisch versierte Persönlichkeit mit einem Ingenieurabschluss oder umfangreicher CNC-Erfahrung, die den gesamten Bearbeitungsprozess für weltraumtaugliche Komponenten eigenverantwortlich übernimmt. Du bist für die CAM-Programmierung, das Einrichten und Optimieren der Maschinen sowie die kontinuierliche Prozessverbesserung verantwortlich. Darüber hinaus wirkst du direkt an zukünftigen Investitionen in Bearbeitungstechnik und Werkzeuge mit.

Du arbeitest an unterschiedlichsten hochpräzisen Bauteilen – darunter Komponenten für Raketentriebwerke, nachbearbeitete Metall-3D-Druckteile und kritische Subkomponenten von Antriebssystemen. Dabei nutzt du einen modernen Maschinenpark mit 5-Achs-Bearbeitungszentren und CNC-Drehmaschinen verschiedener Hersteller.

Diese Position bietet dir eine technisch anspruchsvolle Aufgabe mit hoher Wirkung sowie die Möglichkeit, künftig zusätzliche Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich weiterzuentwickeln.

Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse werden vorausgesetzt, da unser Arbeitsumfeld international geprägt ist.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Bearbeitungsstrategien definieren und optimieren, einschließlich Bearbeitungsreihenfolge, Werkzeugauswahl, Vorrichtungen und prozessbegleitender Qualitätskontrolle

  • Komplexe Bauteile in HyperMill (oder ähnlicher Software) programmieren, einschließlich 5-Achs-Fräsen und CNC-Drehen

  • Bauteile auf CNC-Maschinen verschiedener Hersteller validieren und dabei Maßhaltigkeit sowie Oberflächenqualität sicherstellen

  • Raketentriebwerkskomponenten, präzise Subkomponenten von Antriebssystemen und Inconel-Strukturen fertigen, einschließlich der Einrichtung von Werkstücknullpunkten und der Vorbereitung der Schneidwerkzeuge

  • Erstwartungs- und Instandhaltungsarbeiten durchführen, um die Maschinen in einwandfreiem Zustand zu halten

  • Werkzeugwege analysieren und verbessern, Bearbeitungszeiten reduzieren und eine stabile Bearbeitungsqualität sicherstellen

  • Mit den Teams aus Konstruktion, Qualitätssicherung und Produktion zusammenarbeiten, um Feedback zu geben, Konstruktionsvorschläge einzubringen und technische Probleme zu lösen

  • Investitionsprojekte für Maschinen und Anlagen vorantreiben – von der Spezifikation über die Koordination mit Lieferanten bis hin zur Inbetriebnahme

Dein Profil

  • Abgeschlossenes Ingenieurstudium oder mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung als hochqualifizierterTechniker im Bereich CNC/CAM für komplexe Bauteile

  • Fundierte Erfahrung mit HyperMill oder vergleichbaren CAM-Systemen sowie in der Bearbeitung mit engen Toleranzen

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse im 5-Achs-Fräsen und/oder Präzisionsdrehen

  • Erfahrung mit Werkstoffen aus der Raumfahrt- bzw. Luft- und Raumfahrtindustrie, insbesondere Inconel, Titan und Hochleistungslegierungen

  • Selbstständige und praxisorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie die Fähigkeit, technische Themen zu strukturieren und voranzutreiben

  • Interesse daran, den Ausbau unserer Fertigungskompetenzen durch die Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen und Anlagen aktiv mitzugestalten

Warum The Exploration Company?

  • Eine ganzheitliche Aufgabe – von der Vorbereitung bis zur Auslieferung – mit hoher Eigenverantwortung

  • Direkte Mitwirkung an der Fertigung von Raumfahrtkomponenten der nächsten Generation

  • Die Möglichkeit, eine moderne Fertigungswerkstatt mit aufzubauen und zukünftige Industrieinvestitionen zu verantworten

  • Klare Entwicklungsperspektiven in Richtung technische Leitung oder Management innerhalb eines schnell wachsenden Unternehmens

  • Ein multikulturelles, internationales Team, das sich leidenschaftlich für die Erforschung des Weltraums begeistert

The Exploration Company ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert und sich der Vielfalt verpflichtet.

  • Wir diskriminieren niemanden aufgrund von ethnischer Herkunft, Religion, Hautfarbe, nationaler Herkunft, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Familienstand oder Behinderung.

  • Unterstützung beim Umzug, einschließlich Visa-Unterstützung bei Bedarf, ist verfügbar.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  


All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. This specialized unit focuses on research projects that specifically survey B2B target groups, professional decision-makers, and niche business audiences (rather than only standard B2C consumer panels). You will work closely with leading global strategy and management consultancies as well as major international corporates, supporting high-stakes projects where research needs to be delivered quickly, precisely, and with a clear focus on the business question.

What you’ll be doing

  • Process & Quality Enhancement: Contribute to standardizing B2B screening protocols, sampling frameworks, and best practices to coach other researcher and safeguard delivery speed and research quality across the team.

You will thrive in this role if

  • You have 5+ years of experience in quantitative market research with a distinct focus on surveying B2B target groups and professional decision-makers (agency or consulting background required; pure academic or non-client backgrounds will not fit this role).

What’s in it for you?

title: Senior Sales Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform. 

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency. 

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

Position Summary

The Senior Sales Engineer lives and works in the intersection between sales and engineering. The ideal candidate must be able to articulate technology and product positioning at the executive, business and technical levels. Sales Engineers are the primary technical support for the sales force and are responsible for actively driving and managing the technology evaluation stage of the sales process. They are there to ensure success with all Harness customers and strategize with their sales counterparts to steer customers to a commercial relationship.

About The Role

  • World class presentation skills in delivering presentations/demos of our platform
  • Able to work with customers directly to debug common errors
  • Ability to tie business problems to technical solutions
  • Capable of understanding and articulating technology value propositions
  • Drive complex technical engagements with customers to prove the value of Harness solutions 

About You

  • You will be responsible for delivering a great product demonstration which tells a story of how our software provides value to our customer
  • You will be responsible for representing the product to customers and at field events such as conferences, seminars, etc.
  • You will remain knowledgeable and up-to-date on changes and developments on our technologies
  • You either actively develop software, have a prior background as a developer, or worked with developers in a DevOps role  
  • Strong cloud knowledge, you worked with infrastructure automation such as Terraform
  • You are able to respond to functional and technical elements of RFIs/RFPs
  • You are able to convey customer requirements to Engineering teams
  • You are able to travel throughout a sales territory with minimal restrictions and occasionally on short notice

Location

  • This role will be located in commuting distance to Paris 

Harness in the news:

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin.

At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness-privacy.relyance.ai/

If you believe that you have been the target of an interview/offer scam by someone posing as a representative of Harness, please do not provide any personal or financial information and contact us immediately at https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams), or you can contact your local law enforcement agency.

title: Senior Security Engineer - Enterprise Security
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

The Senior Security Engineer – Enterprise Security shares ownership of the day-to-day operation of the Samsara security environment. You will keep our network access, device trust, and visibility systems running, tuned, and resilient at enterprise scale in partnership with a global team. Utilizing modern principles, you’ll maintain and evolve a modern zero trust program, spend time both on policy design and real-time triage for escalations.

You take security seriously and believe the best solutions are low-friction and built in partnership with others. You are comfortable owning and maintaining production systems for long term success - troubleshooting systemic issues, tuning policies based on real incidents, and continuously improving what is already built. You bring an automation mindset to repetitive work, whether using Python, SOAR platforms, or AI-assisted tools. You enjoy supporting teammates and helping other engineers build their security knowledge.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United Kingdom. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

About this team:

Enterprise Security is a global team spanning the US, EMEA, and India. We work in close partnership with our coworkers as collaborators rather than gatekeepers. Leadership is hands-on and technical, and our culture encourages everyone to contribute across the full stack.

Executive leadership actively champions security as a competitive advantage that builds customer trust and helps win enterprise partnerships. You will see a direct line between the zero trust systems you operate and the security that protects our physical operations partners worldwide. Our on-call rotation for the highest severity incidents is spread evenly across the team for one week out of every ten.

In this role, you will: 

  • Co-own the day-to-day operation, triage, and tuning of the Samsara endpoint security environment by responding to escalations, investigating anomalies, and resolving issues
  • Continuously improve existing endpoint visibility tools and workflows in partnership with our Security Operations team, and based on real usage patterns and incident learnings
  • Write clear, concise documentation and runbooks for enterprise security workflows
  • Collaborate with partners across Engineering, IT, and Security to ensure proper implementation of security tools and policies
  • Assist the Security Operations team during security investigations, acting as a technical subject matter expert within your domain
  • Partner with engineering teams to triage and support remediation of vulnerabilities and misconfigurations
  • Mentor engineers on the Security team to grow their domain knowledge, tool-specific skills, and communication abilities
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team)

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in an Enterprise Security role with demonstrated impact
  • Hands-on experience operating and maintaining endpoint security and visibility tools at enterprise scale (e.g. Crowdstrike, osquery, or similar)
  • Exposure to at least one additional enterprise security tool stack beyond endpoint security, such as Secure Access Service Edge (SASE), zero trust systems,  email security, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), or Identity and Access Management (IAM)
  • An automation mindset with experience scripting and debugging code with Python (with or without AIassistance) and using SOAR platforms
  • Strong familiarity with common security challenges and the ability to independently evaluate their severity and business impact
  • Track record of delivering impactful work across multiple quarters and collaborating effectively across teams

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Significant breadth across the endpoint security ecosystem, including designing layered controls with EDR tools, passive telemetry, integration with threat intelligence feeds, and operation in cloud and containerized environments.
  • History of building out security programs using modern SaaS security platforms such as Crowdstrike, Mimecast Incydr, and Splunk
  • Experience with infrastructure as code deployments using Terraform
  • Experience with AI-driven automations

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Senior Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At Signal AI, we use cutting-edge AI technology to offer clarity on decisions that shape businesses and society. We value restless curiosity, creative thinking, and diverse perspectives as we strive to become AI-native. We believe that AI is a collaborator, not just a tool, and we invite passionate individuals to join us on our journey as we continue to learn, experiment, and grow together.

About the role

Engineers at Signal AI are expected to bring a strong product mindset to their work. They’re comfortable with complex problems and proactively look for ambiguous ones rather than wait for others to resolve them, and work wherever the product needs them across the full stack. Engineers work closely with other disciplines, including applied research and design, as part of teams that own revenue-critical products from ideation through to production.

Owning a product end to end means much of an engineer’s time goes on understanding the problem: talking to colleagues in research, design and product, testing assumptions, and deciding what is worth building.

Our engineering teams are organised around the needs of the business. We value collaboration and teamwork, and we believe the best solutions to complex problems come from working together. You will work primarily within a small cross-functional team, contributing to its architecture and to engineering standards. You will provide clear, focused technical plans for current and future solutions, and you will keep the long-term technical vision in view.

AI-assisted development is part of everyday work across the organisation. We expect engineers to use tools like Claude Code to move quickly across the entire software development lifecycle, so more of their time is spent on the product questions that matter.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Building intuitive user interfaces and data visualisations that unlock valuable insights for our customers.

  • Building services that can cope with large volumes of data.

  • Implementing and maintaining the AWS infrastructure that supports the services owned by the team.

  • Build, maintain and evolve large-scale distributed systems, ensuring they remain resilient.

  • Building observability into everything you ship (logging, metrics, alerting).

  • Owning BAU in your primary domain and building enough operational familiarity with the other domains to support incidents, understand cross-domain interactions, and describe architectural boundaries.

  • Collaborating with Product and Design to define and scope the products we build.

  • Communicating with other teams and stakeholders when needed.

  • Working in a collaborative environment. Pairing for most of your time, giving and receiving reviews, and helping to uphold the team’s shared quality standard.

Working with AI

This is not specifically an AI Engineer role, but every senior engineer in this team is expected to be AI-literate, in two directions: using AI to build better, and building AI into the product responsibly.

  • Keep your practice current. Use current models, coding agents and agent tooling in your daily work, and re-test earlier assumptions as capabilities change; what was unreliable six months ago may be routine today.

  • Open mind, evidence-led. Give a new tool, pattern or model a fair chance and evaluate it against our own codebases and workflows before ruling it out. Push back when something is presented as a silver bullet and adopting it would bring more risk, or more change, than the team can absorb. Make both calls on evidence, not on instinct or hype.

  • Quality bar parity. Agent-generated code and content are held to the same standard as human work. Review it, test it and secure it the same way.

  • Build to learn. A working prototype in front of a Product owner or a customer beats a slide. Be as willing to report a disappointing result as an exciting one, and kill weak ideas early.

  • Design the human checkpoints and watch the cost. For agentic features, define what the system may decide alone, what needs approval and what escalates, and keep token and run costs visible alongside the value delivered.

  • Share what you learn. Contribute to how the team adopts AI across the whole lifecycle (planning, review, testing and release, not only coding) and share your findings with the team and the wider P&T group, so practice spreads beyond one person.

The Signal AI Way

We want you to apply for this position. We want people to enjoy a good experience at Signal AI and we appreciate your professional needs might be different to what we can offer.

  • Thriving in Dynamic Environments: If you thrive on stability and predictability, you might find our dynamic environment challenging. Our team frequently adapts to changing priorities, which can be incredibly exciting and rewarding for those who enjoy a fast-paced, ever-evolving workplace.

  • Versatile Skill Set: We value versatility and the ability to work on both back-end and front-end development, and across two product domains. If you are passionate about expanding your skills across different areas, you'll find this role enriching and fulfilling.

  • Collaborative Communication: Our culture emphasises building strong communication paths with various teams and stakeholders, including the Editorial team that depends on our tooling every day. If you enjoy collaborative problem-solving and sharing insights, you'll fit right in.

  • Team-Oriented Programming: We encourage pair programming and team collaboration over solo work. If you find joy in teamwork and learning from peers, you'll thrive here.

  • Flexible Coding Approaches: While we respect the discipline of TDD, we also appreciate flexible and innovative approaches to coding, and we prioritise observability over exhaustive test coverage. If you're open to experimenting with different methodologies, this role offers a great opportunity to broaden your horizons.

  • Leveraging AI: We're not just building AI products; we use AI to build better. We expect our engineers to actively explore and adopt AI tools that make them more productive, and to keep their critical thinking switched on while doing it.

  • Owning Our Systems: When something goes wrong in production, we don't point fingers. We fix it, learn from it, and improve our observability to catch it earlier next time.

If these aspects align with your professional values and aspirations, we believe you'll find a rewarding career with us at Signal AI.

About Signal

At Signal we want to help organisations identify risks and opportunities and see movements in the market before anyone else. We want to help leaders make bold decisions, safe that the data is on their side. We want to connect all those external data points together, uncover the unknown unknowns, and be at the very heart of the knowledge economy.

We’ve already built a world-class artificial intelligence platform for real-time information aggregation and analysis at a massive scale. We proved our value with monitoring and measurement products in the PR & Comms space, and are now joining the dots beyond.

We are friendly and informal people who are passionate about our brand as we all have a stake in our success. We have an inclusive environment, welcoming the skills and experience from many diverse backgrounds, and together we have created who we are and what we sell. We are proud of our achievements and continue to strive for the unknown.

Not sure you meet every requirement? Studies show that women and other underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they check every box. At Signal AI, diverse perspectives strengthen our teams, drive innovation, and lead to better performance. So even if your background doesn’t align perfectly with each qualification, we encourage you to apply if you’re passionate about this role.

We're dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where every Signaller feels welcomed, valued, and heard—a place where you can truly thrive as yourself.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Agents
descriptionHtml:
About Boltz

Boltz is a public benefit company building the next generation of AI-powered molecular modeling tools to make biology programmable and accelerate drug discovery, while keeping frontier capabilities broadly accessible.

Boltz began as an MIT spin-out. Our founders built Boltz-1 at MIT, and it became the first fully open-source model to match AlphaFold 3's accuracy in predicting the 3D structure of biomolecular complexes.

We focus on two things:

  • Open foundation models. Boltz-1, Boltz-2, and BoltzGen are open models trusted by 100,000+ scientists across biotech and academia, and used in programs at every Top 20 pharma as well as leading agrichemical and industrial research organizations.

  • Boltz Lab. Our commercial platform runs our latest models and design agents as reliable, production-grade tools built around real chemistry and biology workflows. Teams start from a target and a hypothesis, then generate, evaluate, and rank candidate molecules, while we provide the compute, infrastructure, and collaboration layer so their scientists can move faster.

The two feed each other: open-source adoption earns scientific credibility and community insight, and Boltz Lab turns that into real impact on our partners' discovery programs.

You can read more about our mission, research and product vision in our manifesto.

About the role

As a Software Engineer on Agents, you will own the design agents inside Boltz Lab: the agentic workflows that take a scientist from a target and a hypothesis to a ranked set of candidate molecules. Our goal is that scientists can set up, run, review and export protein design and small-molecule design work on their own, and agents are how much of that happens.

You will work closely with our product engineers and Product Designer, our research teams and Research Engineering, who build agent workflows on the research side, and our scientists who use the product every day.

This role is ideal for an engineer who has shipped agent-powered products to real users, knows how they fail, and cares about making them reliable and trustworthy.

What you'll do

  • Build and ship agentic design workflows in Boltz Lab, for protein design and small-molecule lead optimization.

  • Design the agent runtime around them: tool calling over our models and pipelines, long-running jobs, state, retries and cost control.

  • Make agent behavior visible and trustworthy to scientists: what the agent did, why, and how confident it is.

  • Take research agent workflows to production quickly, as part of getting new models, filters and pipelines from research into the product in under a day.

  • Build evaluations and monitoring for agents in production, and feed what you learn back to Research and Product.

About you

Minimum Requirements

  • Senior or Staff-level software engineering experience, with strong Python and/or TypeScript.

  • Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM agent products or agentic workflows to real users.

  • Solid backend and distributed-systems fundamentals: APIs, queues, long-running jobs, failure handling and observability.

  • A track record of owning features end to end, from design through launch and iteration.

  • Close collaboration with designers, researchers and scientists, and clear communication of trade-offs.

Preferred Requirements

title: Senior Software Engineer, Cloud Platform
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

Role Summary

The Parallax Cloud team builds the communication fabric that lets vehicles, mobile apps, and cloud services exchange live state and commands securely and reliably.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build and operate services and APIs that hide messaging, routing, and authorization complexity from product teams. This is hands-on platform work: you will solve distributed-systems problems, trace failures across the stack, and carry changes from design through production.

 

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate cloud services and gRPC/Protobuf APIs that let product teams read vehicle state, subscribe to changes, and send commands.

  • Operate and tune NATS, our high-performance messaging system, including configuration, upgrades, troubleshooting, performance validation, and capacity planning.

  • Own services end to end, from implementation through deployment and production operation, using Kubernetes, GitOps/Argo CD, and infrastructure as code.

  • Diagnose production behavior using metrics, traces, logs, dashboards, and alerts.

  • Design, operate, and tune service networking, load balancers, and L4/L7 traffic routing.

  • Develop and run end-to-end, integration, and load tests to catch functional and performance regressions before production.

 

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Strong proficiency in at least one general-purpose programming language and willingness to work primarily in Go, with occasional work in Java and TypeScript client SDKs.

  • Practical experience building and operating production services, including observability and troubleshooting.

  • Solid foundations in API design, networking, concurrency, and distributed systems with working knowledge of Kubernetes.

Preferred Qualifications

Parallax Cloud engineers collaborate closely with both product and cloud platform teams, creating a unique opportunity to shape how connected features are designed and how the underlying platform evolves. title: Senior Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Scope automates the data collection that's slowing down the physical world.

Standards are vital for the safety of our infrastructure. Spending hours manually documenting them is not.

Dave is an inspector. Today he’s climbing through one of Europe’s biggest chemical plants, looking for the corrosion that could shut the whole site down, with a notebook and pen in hand. Tomorrow, he’ll spend even longer on the part of the job he hates: turning those scribbles into a report.

We’re building the AI-native data collection layer for the 2 billion field workers like Dave. Scope radically simplifies how inspectors collect data in the field, make decisions, and produce reports. Along the way, we’re building the largest dataset on the condition of the built world and the decisions experts make about it.

It’s a $2T market and we’re just getting started. We're growing rapidly, and already work with 7 of the top 10 companies in the space. Our customers inspect facilities and products for companies including AstraZeneca and SpaceX.

We take pride in our talent density, and have assembled a best-in-class team: acquired and future founders, people from institutions like Imperial, Carnegie Mellon and Oxford, and from firms like Palantir, Goldman Sachs and Flexport .

Since launching from Entrepreneurs First in 2024, we've raised an oversubscribed $20m round led by Index Ventures, the firm behind Figma, Revolut and Wiz, with over 100 unicorns backed to date.

 

About the role

  • Real product ownership. You’ll go on site with inspectors, decide what matters, design it, ship it, and see whether it worked.

  • The hard, interesting problems in AI. Field data is messy: voice notes, photos, video, half-finished sentences recorded in a chemical plant with no signal. Turning that into a report an expert will sign is a context-engineering problem nobody has solved well yet.

  • A small team that ships fast. We ship to production every day and put changes in front of inspectors within days, not quarters. Ideas go from a site visit to a live feature in a single sprint. If something doesn’t land, we learn why and iterate quickly. There are no layers of sign-off between you and the user.

 

What you’ll do

  • Redesign the mobile app for how inspectors actually work: gloves on, no signal, one hand holding on

  • Build the systems that takes voice notes, photos, videos and proactively finishes reports without being annoying

  • Engineer how we feed context to AI models: how to store, fetch and select standards, reports, media, user intention

  • Evolve our workflow builder: something between Retool, Webflow and n8n for inspections

  • Design the architecture behind the product: how unstructured data flows through the system, how AI is integrated, how offline and online behaviour stay seamless, and how we keep the product simple as it becomes more powerful.

 

Who you are

  • You’re deeply technical. You’re a little bit sad that AI tooling creates more distance between you and the code, and you still like knowing how things work underneath.

  • You’re a manager of one. We believe great teams are made up of highly agentic people who care more about shipping results than collecting badges.

  • You’ve got the scar tissue. You have 5+ years of experience and know which technical decisions matter, and which ones don’t.

  • You’ve shipped real applications. Ideally mobile, ideally with Expo or React Native. You care about the details that break in the real world: offline, flaky networks, error states.

  • You’re curious about AI as an engineering problem. You’re interested in getting messy real-world inputs into a model and getting something reliable back out, not just in calling an API.

 

Interview process

  • An initial call with our talent team.

  • A collaborative technical exercise with an engineer, usually in Typescript or Python.

  • An Interview with a cofounder - Jonny (CEO) or Jakob (CTO).

  • Onsite Product Interview - Meeting more people on the team and getting a feel of what it would be like to work here.

  • Offer!

 

Compensation and benefits

We’re in the office five days a week, so we’ve made it a great place to be.

  • £120k–£150k base + significant equity, so you have a real stake in what you’re building

  • 33 days’ holiday (including bank holidays, which you can take at your discretion.)

  • Bupa private medical: £0 excess, pre-existing conditions covered, digital GP, plus Bupa dental

  • Fresh meal prep delivered every week, a stocked fridge, and team lunch out every Friday

  • Working late? Dinner’s on us, and so is your Uber home

  • Full visa sponsorship

  • New MacBook and whatever tools you need

  • Flexible parental leave, including adoption leave

  • Regular team events and off-sites

title: Senior Software Engineer - Security
descriptionHtml:
What You'll Do

As a Senior Software Engineer - Security, you will design, build, and operate the security capabilities that protect Radiant's cloud platform and infrastructure.

You'll work across identity, access control, secrets, network security, platform hardening, auditability, and compliance controls. You'll partner closely with product, infrastructure, SRE, networking, security, and compliance teams, and with customers on their most demanding security requirements.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on making security embedded, scalable, automated, and easy to consume across the platform. You'll own significant security services from design through production, working alongside our Principal Engineers on their architecture.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and own security services and platform capabilities, and contribute to their architecture and technical designs.

  • Build core security services across IAM, RBAC, workload identity, secrets, encryption and key management, audit logging, network controls, and policy enforcement.

  • Turn product, customer, and regulatory requirements into well-designed APIs and implementations, working with the Security Product Manager and Principal Engineers.

  • Automate policy enforcement, configuration hardening, detection, remediation, and software supply chain security.

  • Implement strong tenant isolation and least-privilege access across the control plane and network and data plane.

  • Support enterprise customer security reviews, audits, and incident response.

  • Contribute to security engineering standards through code review, and support less experienced engineers.

 

Your Profile

  • Strong hands-on engineering skills in one or more systems languages such as Go or similar.

  • Solid experience building and operating distributed systems, with depth in cloud and network security, IAM, or security infrastructure.

  • Experience owning significant components end to end, from design through production and operation.

  • Strong technical knowledge across several of:

  • Identity & access: IAM, RBAC/ABAC, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, SSO, federation, mTLS, workload and service identity

  • Security controls: applied cryptography, encryption at rest and in transit, secrets management, KMS/HSM, key rotation, policy engines

  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes internals, containers and runtime isolation, cloud networking, compute, storage

  • Security operations: audit logging pipelines, detection engineering, vulnerability management, incident response

  • Automation: policy-as-code, infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD security, software supply chain (signing, SBOMs, provenance)

  • Experience with technologies such as Vault, OPA/Gatekeeper, SPIFFE/SPIRE, Kubernetes admission control and security tooling, Sigstore, SIEM platforms, cloud KMS, or similar.

  • Good understanding of multi-tenancy, least privilege, zero-trust architecture, threat modelling, and shared-responsibility models.

  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001, and how they translate into technical controls.

  • Able to balance security, performance, reliability, operational complexity, and developer experience.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, including design documents and explaining trade-offs to your team and stakeholders.

 

What You Bring

  • Security mindset: Think like an attacker and design systems that fail safely, without making them painful to use.

  • Engineering excellence: Write well-tested, maintainable code and give thoughtful code reviews.

  • Sound judgement: Make careful design decisions on systems that are hard to change once built.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with Principal Engineers, product, SRE, and other teams, and help the engineers around you grow.

  • Systems thinking: Understand how controls interact across the full cloud platform, from network and infrastructure up to APIs and user experience.

  • Ownership: Drive security capabilities from design through production, operation, and continuous improvement.

 

Qualities we look for:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

  • Inspire the change: There's no blueprint for the future. You'll embrace challenges and change

  • You're real and you're true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you'll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you're talking to, you treat everyone the same.

 

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.

  • Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

  • Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

  • Participation in the company shares program

  • Enhanced parental pay & leave

Our process: Talent screen → Hiring Manager → Technical interview (two Senior Engineers) → Final.

 

Company Overview:

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we're building this organisation from the ground up. We're looking for people who'd rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of the team you've previously managed.

title: Senior Sourcing Specialist – Germany Operations & Manufacturing
descriptionHtml:
Astera Labs (NASDAQ: ALAB) provides rack-scale AI infrastructure through purpose-built connectivity solutions. By collaborating with hyperscalers and ecosystem partners, Astera Labs enables organizations to unlock the full potential of modern AI. Astera Labs’ Intelligent Connectivity Platform integrates CXL®, Ethernet, NVLink, PCIe®, and UALink™ semiconductor-based technologies with the company’s COSMOS software suite to unify diverse components into cohesive, flexible systems that deliver end-to-end scale-up, and scale-out connectivity. The company’s custom connectivity solutions business complements its standards-based portfolio, enabling customers to deploy tailored architectures to meet their unique infrastructure requirements. Discover more at www.asteralabs.com.

About Astera Labs 

Astera Labs (NASDAQ: ALAB) is a pioneering fabless semiconductor company headquartered in Silicon Valley, driving the evolution of AI and cloud infrastructure through purpose-built connectivity solutions. As a leader in rack-scale architecture, Astera Labs is enabling the shift to AI Infrastructure 2.0, where compute is optimized at the rack level to support next-generation workloads. 

Our portfolio spans high-performance silicon, software, and system-level solutions that address critical bottlenecks in data movement across compute, memory, and networking domains. We are committed to open standards, continuous innovation, and building a collaborative environment to solve complex challenges at scale. 

Role Overview 

Astera Labs is seeking a hands-on Senior Sourcing Specialist – Germany Operations & Manufacturing to support sourcing and procurement activities for our operations in Aachen, Germany. This role is responsible for supplier management, purchasing operations, commercial negotiations, and procurement support for manufacturing operations, engineering infrastructure, capital equipment, facilities, laboratories, and corporate services. The role will also provide support for materials management and logistics activities as needed to help ensure efficient operation of the Aachen site. 

The ideal candidate will serve as a key sourcing partner for the Aachen site, working closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Operations, Facilities, Finance, and Global Procurement teams to ensure the timely and cost-effective acquisition of equipment, materials, and services required to support manufacturing operations and site growth. 

The ideal candidate will bring experience supporting optical communications technologies, advanced manufacturing, engineering, laboratory, or other highly technical operating environments. Experience sourcing capital equipment, technical equipment, specialized services, or manufacturing-related products and services is highly desirable. 

This position requires strong sourcing and procurement fundamentals, supplier relationship management skills, attention to detail, and cross-functional collaboration. The successful candidate will help execute sourcing initiatives, support supplier relationships, negotiate pricing and commercial terms, and contribute to procurement process improvements that support Astera Labs' continued growth. 

A Day in the Life 

In this role, you'll work closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Facilities, Quality, Finance, and Operations teams to support a growing production and engineering environment. You will help ensure manufacturing and operational readiness by sourcing critical equipment, managing supplier relationships, obtaining quotations, supporting commercial discussions, and coordinating the procurement of materials and services needed to support day-to-day operations. 

Your responsibilities will range from sourcing production capital equipment and manufacturing consumables to supporting facility expansion projects, supplier performance initiatives, and logistics coordination. While the primary focus of this role is sourcing and procurement, you will also assist with materials planning, inventory tracking, and supplier delivery management to help support operational continuity as the Aachen operation continues to scale. 

This is a highly collaborative role requiring strong organization, responsiveness, customer service, and the ability to manage multiple sourcing activities across a diverse group of stakeholders. 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Support sourcing and procurement activities for Astera Labs' Aachen manufacturing and operations site. 
  • Source and purchase production capital equipment, manufacturing consumables, laboratory equipment, facilities equipment, MRO supplies, IT equipment, and corporate services. 
  • Execute RFQs, supplier evaluations, bid analyses, and commercial negotiations in partnership with internal stakeholders. 
  • Support supplier selection, contract administration, and purchasing activities across assigned spend categories. 
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with suppliers, contractors, service providers, logistics providers, and equipment vendors. 
  • Partner with Manufacturing and Engineering teams to procure production equipment, test systems, tooling, spare parts, manufacturing consumables, laboratory equipment, technical equipment, and engineering support services. 
  • Source specialized manufacturing equipment, laboratory equipment, automation systems, precision instrumentation, and technical services supporting production and engineering activities. 
  • Support Facilities teams with site expansions, facility upgrades, equipment installations, contractor sourcing, and workplace infrastructure projects. 
  • Assist with materials planning, inventory monitoring, and supplier delivery coordination to help ensure material availability and continuity of operations. 
  • Support logistics coordination, including inbound shipments, freight management, import/export activities, shipment tracking, and supplier delivery performance. 
  • Manage purchase requisitions, purchase orders, delivery tracking, and invoice resolution activities. 
  • Coordinate supplier onboarding, compliance documentation, and supplier performance reviews. 
  • Collaborate with Manufacturing, Finance, Operations, and Global Procurement teams to ensure purchasing activities align with production schedules, budgets, forecasts, and company policies. 
  • Identify opportunities for cost savings, supplier improvements, process efficiencies, and operational enhancements. 
  • Maintain procurement records and ensure compliance with company policies and applicable regulatory requirements. 

Basic Qualifications 

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Operations, Engineering, Logistics, or a related field. 
  • 5–8+ years of experience in sourcing, procurement, purchasing operations, supply chain, manufacturing support, or related functions. 
  • Experience sourcing capital equipment, manufacturing consumables, production materials, MRO supplies, laboratory equipment, or technical products and services. 
  • Experience negotiating pricing with suppliers and supporting commercial agreements. 
  • Experience supporting manufacturing, production, engineering, optical communications, laboratory, or industrial operations. 
  • Familiarity with ERP and procurement systems such as SAP, Oracle, Coupa, or similar platforms. 
  • Working knowledge of materials planning, inventory management, and logistics processes. 
  • Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities across stakeholders. 
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. 
  • Fluency in both English and German (written and spoken) is required. 
  • Experience working with suppliers and service providers throughout Germany and Europe. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience supporting optical communications technologies, electronics, advanced manufacturing, laboratory, or engineering organizations. 
  • Experience supporting manufacturing operations, research laboratories, product development environments, or other technical operating environments. 
  • Experience sourcing specialized manufacturing equipment, production tooling, laboratory equipment, automation systems, cleanroom equipment, or precision manufacturing technologies. 
  • Familiarity with technical equipment, precision instrumentation, manufacturing systems, testing equipment, or related industrial technologies. 
  • Knowledge of European supplier markets, logistics networks, and sourcing practices. 
  • Experience supporting capital equipment installations, production line expansion projects, facility upgrades, or manufacturing infrastructure initiatives. 
  • Familiarity with import/export regulations, freight management, and international logistics. 
  • Experience working within a global, high-growth technology company. 
  • CPSM, CSCP, CPIM, or similar professional certifications are a plus. 

Why Join Us? 

  • Be part of a high-growth company advancing the future of AI infrastructure. 
  • Help support manufacturing operations, production readiness, and operational excellence in Germany. 
  • Partner closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Facilities, and Global Operations teams on impactful business initiatives. 
  • Build supplier partnerships that directly support Astera Labs' operational success and growth. 
  • Gain exposure to sourcing, procurement, logistics, and manufacturing support activities within a highly technical environment. 
  • Contribute to the continued expansion of a growing manufacturing and engineering organization. 
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits. 

We know that creativity and innovation happen more often when teams include diverse ideas, backgrounds, and experiences, and we actively encourage everyone with relevant experience to apply, including people of color, LGBTQ+ and non-binary people, veterans, parents, and individuals with disabilities.
