We're looking for a technical, customer-focused Technical Account Manager to own the post-sale relationship with our customers and make sure they get the best from their Geordie deployment, fast.

You'll be the technical face of Geordie for a portfolio of enterprise accounts — guiding onboarding and integration, becoming the go-to expert customers trust for anything technical, and working closely with our sales, product and engineering teams to keep our customers successful and growing. You will turn technical relationships into lasting partnerships.

This is a hands-on, technical role. You'll get deep into our platform, our customers' environments, and everything in between — and you'll help shape how Geordie delivers success for our customers as our first UK-based TAM hire.

We also expect you to work the way we build — intelligently and efficiently. That means embracing AI agents in your day-to-day workflows. We use tools like Claude Cowork to move faster and do more. If you're not passionate about that, this probably isn't the right place for you.

What You'll Do

  • Own the Technical Relationship — Be the primary technical point of contact for a portfolio of enterprise accounts, building trust from customer kick-off through renewal and expansion.

  • Project Management — Own the project plan for onboarding and major implementations end-to-end: timelines, milestones, resourcing, and risk tracking across customer, engineering, and product stakeholders. Run the cadence of standups/status calls, keep everyone accountable to dates, and escalate slippage before it becomes a surprise.

  • Onboarding & Implementation — Guide customers through deployment, integrations, and configuration, so they see value from day one.

  • Product Mastery — Become a deep expert on the Geordie platform. Troubleshoot issues, answer technical questions, and give customers confidence in how we work.

  • Adoption & Health — Track account health and usage, spot risks early, and drive the actions that keep customers engaged and expanding.

  • Escalation Management — Be the calm, capable owner of technical escalations — coordinating with engineering and product teams to resolve issues and close the loop with customers.

  • Renewals & Expansion — Partner with our sales team to identify expansion opportunities and ensure strong technical health underpins every renewal opportunity.

  • Customer Advocacy — Bring field insights back to our teams — feature requests, friction points, and what's actually happening in customer environments — so we keep building the right things and ensure the customer remains at the centre of everything we do.

  • Documentation & Enablement — Build the runbooks, guides, and best-practice materials that make onboarding repeatable and support scalable.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration — Work closely with sales, engineering and product teams to deliver a seamless customer experience.

  • Build the Function — As our first UK TAM, help shape the processes and playbooks that define how Geordie supports customers as we scale, in step with the wider TAM function.

What We're Looking For

  • You're technical, and you like it. You're comfortable in the details — agents, APIs, integrations, security, governance — and you enjoy figuring out how things really work.

  • You own outcomes. You don't wait — you track account health and get ahead of risk before it becomes a churn conversation.

  • You're a builder. Early-stage means you create structure where there isn't any and find a way to provide value to customers.

  • You're AI-fluent, not just AI-aware. You use tools like Claude Cowork and other agentic AI to run your own workflow — drafting runbooks, triaging tickets, prepping QBRs, chasing account health signals — so you spend your time on judgement calls and relationships, not repetitive admin. You look for the next task to hand off to an agent before you look for the next hire.

  • You earn trust at every level. You can debug an integration issue with an engineer in the morning and brief a CISO on progress in the afternoon, without losing credibility in either room.

  • You listen before you troubleshoot. You ask sharp questions to understand what's actually going on before you propose a fix, then deliver.

  • You communicate clearly and often. Customers always know where things stand.

  • You're focused on success. Not just at renewal time — all the time. You care whether customers succeed, and it shows in how you show up.

  • You embrace new ways of working. You actively use AI tools — especially agents — to work smarter, move faster, and do more. You thrive in ambiguity.

Requirements

  • 2–5 years' experience in a Technical Account Manager, Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, or Customer Success Engineer role at a SaaS or cybersecurity company.

  • Passion and interest in agents, how organisations are utilising them, their security and risk, and their governance.

  • Solid technical fluency — comfortable with agent architectures, agent security, agent tooling, APIs, SaaS/cloud integrations, and cloud environments.

  • Proven track record of owning post-sale relationships with enterprise customers, including onboarding, adoption, and renewal.

  • Experience diagnosing and resolving technical issues, including coordinating with engineering teams on fixes.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work confidently with both technical practitioners and executive stakeholders.

  • Strong discovery and problem-solving skills — able to get to the root of a customer issue quickly.

  • Comfortable delivering polished, tailored product walkthroughs and training sessions independently.

  • Highly organised, with rigorous attention to detail across documentation, account health tracking, and follow-through.

  • Collaborative team player who thrives in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment.

  • Based in the United Kingdom, with the right to work in the UK, and the flexibility to travel to customer sites as needed.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience supporting security, AI/ML, or agentic tooling customers.

  • Active experience creating, deploying and managing agents.

  • Prior experience at a high-growth Series A–B SaaS company.

  • Light scripting or coding ability (e.g. Python) and comfort working with API tools such as Postman.

  • Relevant cloud or security certifications (AWS, Azure, or equivalent).

Why This Role

AI agents are changing how enterprises operate — and the question of how to govern them safely is becoming mission-critical. Geordie is the platform companies are turning to for that answer. As one of our first Technical Account Managers, you won't just be running a playbook — you'll be writing it. You'll have real influence over how we onboard, support, and grow our customers, and a direct line to Product on what to build next. If you want to go deep on a hard technical problem and build something that matters, this is it.

Our Values

Solve What Matters

We listen intently and stay focused on what truly matters to our customers. If it doesn't help them navigate real-world agentic adoption and risk, it's probably not worth building.

Build, Learn, Iterate

We favour momentum over perfection — testing, learning, and evolving through action. It's how we move fast and get better, together.

Kind, Not Comfortable

We're honest, respectful, and unafraid to challenge each other. We believe doing great work should feel good, too. Kindness makes that possible.

sA Platform for Your Best Work

We want this to be the most meaningful chapter of your career. Geordie is the place where you grow, lead and lift others, while building something that truly matters.

title: Technical Instructional Designer (AI Programmes)
descriptionHtml:
Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption.

We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce.

Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.

In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn.

But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.

The opportunity

AI can draft a lesson in seconds. It can't tell you whether that lesson will actually land with a nervous career-switcher three weeks into a Data or AI apprenticeship — or whether the concept it just explained is subtly, but fundamentally, flawed.

That's where you come in.

You'll be the human judgement layer sitting on top of our AI-assisted content pipeline — part subject-matter expert, part instructional designer. You'll decide what AI got right, fix what it didn't, and build the parts no AI can: the high-touch, high-stakes, deeply human moments in a learner's journey that make the difference between content that's technically correct and content that actually changes someone's career.

You'll have experience building content in generative and agentic AI, Data Analytics, and Data Science — not just someone who's read about it, but someone who can explain it, question it, and know when the AI-generated explanation of a neural network is actually going to help a learner or quietly confuse them.

What you'll actually do

  • Design outcomes, not just content. Apply end-to-end backward design to build Data and AI programmes where success is measured by what learners can do on the job — not just what they can pass a test on. You'll own the hardest part: turning a job-aligned outcome into a curriculum that actually gets learners there.

  • Chase real-world impact, relentlessly. When a piece of learning isn't landing — when a Data Analyst cohort isn't showing the outcomes it should — you won't wait to be told. You'll spot it, own it, and scope the revisions that bring it up to the standard it needs to hit.

  • Build what AI can't. Design the custom, high-touch programmes and creative assets — branching narratives, bespoke multimedia, high-stakes onboarding moments — that need real human empathy, creativity, and nuance. If AI could've built it, it's not your job; if only a person could, it is.

  • Put AI to work, deliberately. Use AI tools and prompt engineering to accelerate your own content development and uncover learning design approaches nobody's tried yet. This isn't about using AI because it's there — it's about knowing exactly where it earns its place.

  • Advise up, not just build. Work directly with Programme Designers and senior stakeholders on the quality and pedagogical effectiveness of AI and human output. Your feedback doesn't stay in the room — it shapes how our AI rules and frameworks evolve.

  • Prototype for the long game. Lead new learning formats and modalities that don't exist yet — and know how to balance shipping fast against building something sustainable enough to reuse.

What you'll bring

  • Real command of end-to-end ADDIE and backward design — you've built measurable, job-aligned outcomes and the assessments that prove learners hit them, not just theoretical frameworks on a CV.

  • A habit of treating "good enough" as a starting point, not a finish line — you notice when learning isn't driving real outcomes, and you take the initiative to fix it.

  • Genuine fluency with AI-powered tools and prompt engineering, used to accelerate content development and find genuinely new applications in Data/AI learning design.

  • The ability to take a genuinely complex AI, Data Science, or Analytics concept and design a learning experience around it that actually works — for someone with zero technical background.

  • The confidence and track record to influence peers and senior stakeholders toward a specific, measurable curriculum improvement — not just raise a concern and move on.

  • Resilience when things don't go to plan — you can point to a time a project hit a real obstacle (a blocker, a shifting SME, a launch that missed the mark) and describe exactly what you did about it, and what you learned.

What gets you in the door

You'll need at least one of these:

  • Hands-on experience producing technical content for Data Science or generative/agentic AI.

  • 2+ years designing instructional content in a commercial environment or for commercial clients.

  • Plus one of:

    • A Data Science degree (or close cousin of one)

    • Completion of a technical apprenticeship in Data or AI

    • 2+ years working as a practitioner in Data or AI

If you're a strong technical practitioner who's never formally studied instructional design, or a seasoned learning designer who's spent the last year deep in AI tools — either path can get you here. We're looking for the judgment, not a checklist.

What we'll actually explore together

We're upfront about what our process looks for, because we'd rather you come prepared to talk about the real thing than guess what we want to hear. Across the conversations, we'll dig into:

  • Advanced curriculum & applied design — how you turn an end-to-end backward-design process into measurable, job-aligned outcomes, and how you build creative assets that genuinely need a human touch.

  • Impact & excellence — what you do when a piece of learning isn't hitting its real-world mark, and how you weigh speed against building something built to last.

  • AI integration & innovation — where and how you've put AI tools and prompt engineering to work, and what that's actually unlocked.

  • Influence & stakeholder management — how you've moved a curriculum forward through a genuine disagreement or feedback conversation, not just delivered a good pitch.

  • Coachability & resilience — how you've handled a launch that didn't land, or a project blocker outside your control, and what you changed as a result.

 

Benefits

  • Time off - 27 days holiday, plus 5 additional days off: 1 life event day, 2 volunteer days, 2 company-wide wellbeing days (M-Powered Weekend) and 8 bank holidays per year

  • Health & Wellness- private medical Insurance with Bupa, a medical cashback scheme, life insurance, gym membership & wellness resources through Wellhub and access to Spill - all in one mental health support

  • Hybrid work offering - for most roles we collaborate in the office three days per week with the exception of Coaches and Instructors who collaborate in the office once a month

  • Work-from-anywhere scheme - you'll have the opportunity to work from anywhere, up to 10 days per year

  • Space to connect: Beyond the desk, we make time for weekly catch-ups, seasonal celebrations, and have a kitchen that’s always stocked!


Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We’re an equal opportunities employer. And proud of it. Every applicant and employee is afforded the same opportunities regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. This will never change. Read our Equality, Diversity & Inclusion policy here.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

Multiverse is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of our learners. We expect all employees to share this commitment and adhere to our Safeguarding Policy, our Prevent Policy and all other Multiverse company policies. Successful applicants will be required to undertake at least a Basic check via the Disclosure Barring Service (DBS).

For roles that will involve a Regulated Activity, successful applicants must also undergo an Enhanced DBS check, including a Children’s Barred List check and a Prohibition Order check. Roles involving Regulated Activity may interact with vulnerable groups, therefore are exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 meaning applicants are required to declare any convictions, cautions, reprimands, and final warnings.

Providing false information is an offence and could result in the application being rejected or summary dismissal if the applicant has been selected, and possible referral to the police and the DBS.

  • Be a functional expert in Quantexa’s platform and products, developing a strong understanding of their capabilities and real-world applications.

  • Develop a strong understanding of Public Sector practices, regulatory environments and customer challenges, and how Quantexa’s platform can address gaps, risks and business needs.

  • Facilitate discovery sessions with customers and partners to uncover core business challenges, technical requirements and desired outcomes.

  • Collaborate with customers, partners and internal teams to design and iterate tailored solutions, ensuring the right approach is defined to address the customer’s needs.

  • Understand key deployment options and enterprise-level decisions, and guide customers and internal teams towards the right solution for the problem.

  • Be an integral part of the account team for selected Public Sector customers, helping to define and execute the account strategy to deliver sustained business value through the use of the Quantexa platform.

  • Work closely with Product, Delivery and Strategic Partners to ensure alignment with customer goals, adherence to Blueprints, effective project scoping and successful value realisation through project and proving stages.

  • Support the successful adoption and operationalisation of the Quantexa platform, ensuring customers are able to embed it effectively within their organisation.

  • Own key executive relationships and ensure appropriate governance, engagement and communication are in place throughout the customer lifecycle.

  • Support successful customer renewals and build the foundations for continued growth and expansion with Quantexa.

What you’ll bring.

  • Customer Focus: Your dedication to understanding customer needs is paramount. You consistently focus on the core challenges at hand, balancing the broader picture with the detail required to deliver meaningful outcomes. You communicate confidently with senior business and technology stakeholders and are comfortable sharing your perspective. You are skilled at helping customers define a strategic roadmap that enables them to realise the value of their Quantexa solutions.

  • Technology Expertise: You will have a strong understanding of data or specialise in one of our key solution domains within the Public Sector, such as data management, financial crime, fraud detection or customer intelligence. You will have experience supporting or delivering platform implementations, understand the challenges customers face, and bring credibility through proven technical and commercial outcomes.

  • Relationship Management: You have experience working directly with clients and a proven ability to build and nurture trusted professional relationships. Customers should see you as a dependable primary point of contact and trusted advisor. You will have strong interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of engaging effectively with stakeholders and simplifying complex concepts for a range of audiences.

  • Consultative Approach: You have an analytical and structured approach to problem-solving, considering challenges from multiple perspectives. You are collaborative by nature and comfortable working alongside customers and internal teams to identify and implement effective solutions. Experience in a consulting environment would be valuable, with a strong focus on understanding customer needs and delivering measurable value.

  • Teamwork & Collaboration: You are a strong team player who works effectively across Quantexa and with external partners and customers. Building strong relationships and collaborating across teams is fundamental to how we work, and you recognise that we are stronger when we work together.

Minimum Experience and Qualifications

  • Experience in a commercially focused technical role, such as Solution Engineering, Pre-Sales, Technical Sales or Value Consulting.

  • Experience implementing, operating or working with data and technology platforms within the Public Sector.

  • Proven experience defining and executing against a long-term vision, strategy and roadmap.

  • Strong product and technology expertise, with the credibility to engage with customers on complex Public Sector challenges and use cases.

  • Proven ability to build and maintain strong relationships with senior and executive-level stakeholders.

  • Willingness and ability to travel to customer sites as required.

  • Must be eligible to obtain and maintain SC clearance as a minimum.

Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realise your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognised and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary & Company bonus

  • 25 days annual leave (with the option of buying up to 5 days, and rolling over up to 10), plus national holidays + your birthday off!

  • Pension scheme with a company contribution of 6% (when you contribute 3%)

  • Private Healthcare, including dental & optic cover

  • Life Insurance and Income Protection

  • Regularly bench-marked salary rates

  • Enhanced Maternity, Paternity, Adoption, or Shared Parental Leave

  • Well-being days

  • Volunteer Day off

  • Work from Home Equipment

  • Commuter, Tech and cycle to work schemes

  • Free Subscription to a meditation, relaxation and sleep app

  • Continuous Training and Development

  • Spend up to 2 months working outside of your country of employment over a rolling 12-month period with our ‘Work from Anywhere’ policy

  • Team Social Budget & Company-wide Socials

     

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know - we’re happy to assist.

No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.

title: The Jump: Fast-Track Programme
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The Jump:

The Jump is Omnea's 12-month programme for ambitious engineers who want to make the jump to senior, faster than they could elsewhere. You'll join one of our product teams as a Product Engineer and take on progressively bigger, harder work, with the support to grow into it.

Plenty of companies promise fast progression. We back it with structure:

  • Real scope. Ship from week one, own a feature end to end in your first quarter, and lead a project with one or two other engineers by months 6–9.

  • A buddy for the year. An experienced engineer from another team, not your manager, who meets you every month for the full 12 months and talks you through how they make decisions.

  • Six practical sessions in your first six months. Live, in-person sessions across two Jump Day afternoons, covering impact, autonomy, product and design, customers, commercial and influence. Each is built around a real Omnea project and applied straight to your own work. No bootcamp.

  • Honest feedback. A monthly self-review talked through with your buddy, and a quarterly progression review with your team lead, so you always know where you stand.

  • Promotion when you're ready. As soon as you're consistently operating at the next level, judged against the same bar as everyone else. Not held for an annual review.


What Success Looks Like:

We expect you to be operating at the next level within about 12 months. We'll give you the scope, the buddy and the feedback, so you can drive your progression as fast and as far as you can. We'll track your progress together through structured checkpoints across the year, so you always know where you stand.

Our bar is high. Our levels mean more here than at most companies, and promotion is judged on how you operate, not on finishing a programme.


What We're Looking For:

We're looking for product-minded engineers with real drive to join our engineering team. We're a tight-knit group of ambitious builders who hold the bar high. It took over 10,000 interviews to hire our first 50 Omneans. Over the next year, our engineering team will double in size, our enterprise customer base will grow from ~220 to 400+, and revenue will triple. In this role, you'll build high-quality product features and systems using the latest in AI, both as a developer tool and embedded directly into our product, owning meaningful problem spaces end-to-end and having a direct impact on customers as we scale.


What Can You Expect On Our Engineering Team?

  • Join a Skilled Team. Become part of one of Europe's fastest-growing software companies, working alongside experienced full-stack product engineers from top technology businesses and startups.

  • Direct Product Impact. Help shape key product decisions, including roadmap prioritisation, project scoping, technical direction, user experience, and implementation strategy.

  • Work with Modern Technology. Our stack is TypeScript across the stack (frontend and backend), React, Postgres, and AWS serverless infrastructure (Lambda, DynamoDB, and EventBridge), managed through Pulumi and deployed via GitHub Actions. We use Datadog for observability, Meticulous for automated visual regression testing, and Incident.io for incident management.

  • AI-Native Development. AI is core to how we build. Engineers use Claude Code and agentic workflows every day to write, review, and ship code faster, and our product is itself built on AI agents that automate complex procurement workflows.

  • End-to-End Ownership. Own projects from initial idea through design, implementation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration. You'll work across the stack and be trusted to make decisions that drive meaningful outcomes.

  • Continuous Delivery. We deploy small, incremental changes to production multiple times per day, enabling rapid iteration and fast customer feedback loops.

  • Tackle Scalability Challenges. As we grow, you'll help scale our systems, architecture, and engineering practices while maintaining performance, reliability, and developer velocity.

  • Collaboration and Autonomy. We operate as a high-trust team where individuals are expected to take ownership while collaborating closely to solve difficult problems.

  • Customers at the Center. We regularly engage directly with customers to understand their problems, gather feedback, and ensure we're building products that create genuine value.


About You:

  • You're a strong engineer on a fast trajectory. Around 3–5 years of professional software engineering in a well-respected engineering environment, shipping features end to end, full-stack in TypeScript (AWS serverless is a plus). If your trajectory is exceptional, we'll look past the years.

  • You're proactive. You spot problems and fix them, or get them to the right person, without being asked. You keep people updated rather than waiting to be chased.

  • You're ready for more scope. You've owned well-defined work and want the next step: vague briefs, bigger projects and more people to work with.

  • You're coachable. You ask for feedback, act on it and learn fast from mistakes.

  • You're driven and ambitious. You want to progress quickly, own your growth and push for harder problems. If there's a chance to take on something bigger, you take it.

  • You've got grit. You work hard and keep going when things get difficult.

  • You're curious about the product and the customer. You want to know why something is being built, not just how.

  • You lift others. You help teammates, share what you know and make the team better.


Nice-to-Haves:

  • You've performed exceptionally at something else, be it academics, sport, or work. You've gone above and beyond the norm.

  • You've grown fast before. Your scope or responsibilities grew quickly in a previous role.

  • You love engineering. It's more than a job. You've contributed to open source or worked on side projects just because you enjoy it. You're confident tackling ambiguous problems and shipping quality code.


Interview Process:

Before applying, we strongly encourage you to spend a few minutes in our R&D Candidate Hub. It covers our engineering culture, ways of working, interview process, tech environment, and what it's like to build at Omnea.

>> R&D Candidate Hub: R&D Candidate Hub

The process varies slightly by level but generally includes:

  1. Initial screening call with the Talent team (30 mins - remote)

  2. AI Product Eng Challenge - language agnostic (1 hour - remote)

  3. Onsite interviews: Engineering culture interview, System design and Engineering leadership interviews (3 hours - in-person)

For The Jump, we look for trajectory as much as experience: how fast you've learned and how quickly your scope has grown.

We're proud to support visa sponsorship for candidates who need it.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

Legal note: if you are viewing this posting outside of the Omnea careers' page, this may be an auto-generated advertisement and may lack the full range of advertised information - please click through to the posting at https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/omnea to view additional advertised information on this posting.
Additionally, where roles have hard-specified requirements (e.g. [x] days in office, unable to provide visas, etc), if in your application you provide deterministic check-box confirmation that you do not meet the hard-specified requirements, deterministic (not AI or subjective) automatic rejection criteria are in place.

About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline UX Content Design Team 👋

The UX Content Design team is a small but high-impact group of Content Designers and Localisation experts working across Trainline’s most important initiatives. We sit within the Product organisation as part of a wider cross-functional UX team, partnering closely with UX Designers, Engineers, Product Managers, and insight specialists to cut through the complexity of travel for millions of users across more than 40 countries.

We work from discovery so we can shape the best content decisions early, and you’ll be right at the heart of that. In this role, you’ll have genuine end-to-end ownership of meaningful projects, with the backing of an experienced content design team around you. You’ll report to the UX Content Lead, who will support your priorities, skill development, and career growth, while bringing your own areas of influence to a team tackling some genuinely interesting challenges.

In this role as the Content Designer, you will...🚄

  • Co-design clear, intuitive end-to-end user journeys and contribute to content strategy across key Trainline initiatives

  • Bring clarity to propositions by working with our tone of voice, adapting how it dials up or down to support users across different contexts and needs

  • Take AI prototypes through testing and refinement with real rail users, helping to shape how emerging technology serves our travellers

  • Develop and execute content strategies that drive conversion, using insights, testing, and performance data to strengthen your decisions

  • Create scalable content governance standards for internal and customer-facing agents, contributing to how our content strategy is interpreted and applied at scale

  • Advise on inclusive and accessible content best practices with the wider Product team

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, Research, and Engineering across workshops and sprints

  • Think deeply about localisation, ensuring the content you create works meaningfully for travellers across the more than 40 countries we serve

We’d love to hear from you if you have...🔍

  • A solid background in content design for digital products, with examples of work you’re proud of - whether from professional experience or personal projects you’ve dedicated time to (please include one or two links in your CV or application)

  • Experience testing and optimising content, using data and user insight to inform and strengthen your decisions

  • Confidence working with a tone of voice and adapting it to suit different user needs and contexts throughout a journey

  • Comfort experimenting with AI in your content practice - you don’t need to be an expert, but an openness to exploring AI systems and governance is important to us

  • A collaborative mindset with the ability to communicate your rationale clearly and effectively to teammates and stakeholders

  • A foundational understanding of UX best practices and design principles

  • Ideally, some experience in the travel, transport, or ecommerce industry, though equivalent commercial experience is equally welcome

  • It would be a bonus if you have experience writing content rules for AI systems, though this is a growing area and we’re happy to support your development here

More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do:

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. title: UX Designer, AI App
descriptionHtml:
About Act

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 

Role

You will own the UX of Act's core app experience. This means designing the end-to-end flows users go through every day - how they start tasks, how they follow along as the AI works, how they stay in control, and how they recover when something goes wrong.

This is a UX role for a HCI product. You need to understand both user needs and AI system behavior well enough to design product flows that feel clear, reliable, and controllable.

 

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own UX for Act's core app surfaces across iOS, Android, and web.

  • Design complete user flows for AI-assisted tasks - from intent capture through to task completion, including handoff, progress tracking, and error recovery.

  • Design how the app surfaces what the AI is doing, what decisions it has made, and what the user needs to confirm or adjust.

  • Map and design the full range of AI states a user encounters - loading, thinking, acting, waiting, completing, stalling, failing, and recovering.

  • Work with product, engineering, and ML teams to define user requirements and translate them into concrete design solutions.

  • Conduct usability research to understand where users lose trust, feel uncertain, or disengage.

  • Produce wireframes, user flows, and high-fidelity designs that engineering can build from directly.

  • Contribute to the design system and shared UX patterns for AI app surfaces.

  • Design for both simple everyday interactions and complex multi-step AI workflows within the same product.

 

What You Will Need

  • Experience as a UX designer on consumer mobile or web apps, with a strong portfolio.

  • Solid skills in user flow design, wireframing, and high-fidelity prototyping in Figma.

  • Ability to design for systems that are asynchronous, non-deterministic, and context-dependent.

  • Clear thinking about user trust, control, feedback, and transparency in AI-driven product experiences.

  • Experience conducting user research and turning findings into design decisions.

  • Comfortable working in fast-moving teams with evolving product scope.

  • Ability to balance simple consumer UX with complex AI system behavior.

  • Good judgment on usability, edge cases, failure handling, and recovery flows.

 

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

 

Interview process

For design roles, we expect candidates to submit a portfolio as part of the application process.

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2 rounds of interviews and a design assessment.

Applications are evaluated by our team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

title: VP Retention
descriptionHtml:
🚀 Why Midnite?

Midnite is a next-generation sports betting and gaming platform built for a new wave of players.

We combine sharp product thinking, bold brand, and fast execution to create experiences that feel modern, intuitive, and built for how people actually play today.

Over 400,000 players have already made the move, and we’re only just getting started.

We’re a high-performance team operating at pace. High ownership. Constant iteration. No hiding behind processes. We move quickly, test relentlessly, and turn ambitious ideas into real impact. If you’re driven, creative, and thrive in fast-moving environments where you can shape meaningful outcomes - keep reading.

Not your grandad’s bookie.

👀 The Role

Title: VP Retention

Team: Growth

Location: UK, remote

We're looking for a VP Retention to lead our global CRM/Retention business unit within Growth, building sustained customer engagement across sportsbook, casino and future markets.

You'll lead an established organisation across Core CRM, Lifecycle and Live Ops, connecting strategy, people, data and execution. This is an opportunity to build on existing expertise, validate what works and shape what comes next. Change should have a clear purpose.

Your focus will be customer and commercial impact, not campaign volume. You'll help customers progress through early life journeys, deepen relevant engagement, improve longer term retention and make reactivation more effective through thoughtful, personalised activity across email, push, SMS and in app.

Working closely with Product, BI and other Growth leaders, you'll bring strong casino insight, a clear view of loyalty and the ability to turn cross functional priorities into delivery. As data, MarTech and measurement capabilities evolve, you'll help demonstrate incremental value, improve reward efficiency and deliver responsible engagement at scale.

You will:

  • Set and evolve global retention strategy across activation, early life progression, engagement, lapse prevention and reactivation, with sustained longer term retention at its heart.

  • Lead and develop Core CRM, Lifecycle and Live Ops; assess the operating model, preserve expertise and shape evidence led changes.

  • Bring casino insight and partner with Product on loyalty and customer propositions that give players reasons to return.

  • Prioritise relevant, personalised lifecycle journeys and higher impact interactions, not contact volume for its own sake.

  • Own performance against outcomes including deposit progression, cash active days, cross sell, lifetime value, reactivation efficiency and cohort retention.

  • Partner with BI to validate baselines, develop useful reporting and assess incrementality through robust experimentation and holdouts.

  • Challenge and prioritise data, segmentation and MarTech capabilities with Product/Engineering, managing key CRM vendor relationships.

  • Build alignment across Product, BI, Growth and market stakeholders, influencing upwards and sideways as well as leading your team.

  • Establish strong standards for contact strategy, QA, consent and customer protection; turn evidence into priorities, investment recommendations and learning.

The next Midniter:

  • Has led CRM, retention or lifecycle activity within iGaming with demonstrable customer and commercial outcomes.

  • Brings deep casino understanding and credible sportsbook knowledge, adapting approaches across products and markets.

  • Ideally has helped design, launch or evolve a loyalty programme with Product.

  • Builds trust, constructively challenges and aligns senior cross functional stakeholders, as well as leading direct reports.

  • Has developed teams and can improve an established organisation while respecting existing expertise.

  • Connects lifecycle strategy with personalised, multi channel execution, favouring meaningful impact over campaign volume.

  • Understands cohort retention, experimentation, holdouts and incrementality, including attribution limitations and incomplete data.

  • Brings commercial judgement around LTV, contribution, promotional cost and reward efficiency.

  • Understands how customer data, segmentation, decisioning and CRM platforms should work together; can challenge dependencies and vendor value with specialist teams.

  • Balances strategic ambition with operational rigour, pace and responsible engagement in regulated markets.

💰 Winnings

  • Private health insurance with zero excess, including optical cover and optional dental.

  • Income protection to protect your earnings and give you peace of mind.

  • Tenure holiday policy. After three years you receive an extra two days leave, increasing to 30 days annually after five years.

  • Flexible working and a fully supported home office setup so you can do your best work from home.

  • Nursery salary sacrifice scheme helping parents save thousands each year on nursery fees.

  • Salary sacrifice schemes for tech and holidays so you can spread the cost of the things you want.

  • Retail discounts and subscription perks across a wide range of brands.

  • Quarterly team socials to connect, celebrate and have fun together.

  • Anwendungsfälle gemeinsam entwickeln: Du findest mit den Teams heraus, wo KI sinnvoll unterstützen kann, erprobst passende Ansätze und begleitest die ersten Schritte im Alltag.

  • Wissen zugänglich machen: Du bereitest hilfreiche Beispiele, Anleitungen und Best Practices so auf, dass andere sie direkt nutzen können.

  • Dranbleiben: Du fragst nach, ob Lösungen tatsächlich helfen, und erkennst, wo weitere Unterstützung nötig ist.

Dazu gehört auch der gelegentliche Austausch vor Ort in den Unternehmen unserer Gruppe. Die Stelle ist also mit Reisen verbunden (DE/Europa).

Nutzerbedürfnisse & Produktanforderungen – rund 30 %

  • Bedarf verstehen: Du sammelst Feedback aus Workshops, Support-Anfragen und Gesprächen mit unseren AI Champions.

  • Anforderungen für OpenWebUI formulieren: Du beschreibst nachvollziehbar, welches Problem gelöst werden soll, für wen es relevant ist und was eine hilfreiche Lösung leisten muss.

  • Muster erkennen: Du unterscheidest zwischen einzelnen Rückfragen, Schulungsbedarf und wiederkehrenden Produktanforderungen.

  • Verbesserungen begleiten: Du stimmst Anforderungen mit dem technischen Team ab, testest neue Funktionen aus Nutzersicht und erklärst sie den Mitarbeitenden.

Du musst dafür keine vollständigen Softwarelösungen allein entwickeln. Wichtig ist, dass du technische Zusammenhänge verstehst und zwischen Anwendern und Entwicklung vermitteln kannst.

Ein Plus, kein Muss: Erste Erfahrungen mit OpenWebUI, Workshops, Anwendersupport, Anforderungsmanagement oder Automatisierung.

Deine ersten Monate

Woran du merkst, dass du einen guten Job machst

  • Mitarbeitende kommen bei ihren konkreten Aufgaben weiter – durch deine Unterstützung oder weil du sie an die richtige Stelle vermittelt hast.

title: Werkstudent:in / Praktikant:in Customer Success & Operations (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über uns

Über 5 Millionen Menschen in Deutschland sind pflegebedürftig, und jedes Jahr werden es mehr. Ihnen stehen Leistungen zu, die oft nie ankommen, weil Formulare, Zuständigkeiten und Behördensprache dazwischenstehen.

Jeden Fall einzeln zu prüfen und bis zur Entscheidung zu begleiten, war bisher zu aufwendig. Mit KI geht das zum ersten Mal für viele Familien gleichzeitig. Genau das macht Decari: Wir prüfen, welche Leistungen infrage kommen, etwa ein höherer Pflegegrad, Hilfe zur Pflege oder Eingliederungshilfe, und begleiten die Anträge bis zur Entscheidung. Pflegedienste in mehreren Bundesländern arbeiten bereits mit uns. Unser Ziel: Jede Familie in Deutschland bekommt die Pflegeleistungen, die ihr zusteht.

Wir sind ein kleines, AI-natives Team mit Erfahrung aus der Versicherungs- und Pflegebranche. Wir waren frühe Mitarbeiter in Startups, die von Sequoia, Accel, Index Ventures und Y Combinator finanziert wurden und zusammen über 100 Mio. Euro eingesammelt haben. Neue Ideen testen wir erst einfach und von Hand, was funktioniert, automatisieren wir, und unsere Abläufe ändern wir jede Woche, manchmal täglich. Wir übernehmen Ownership und haben wenig Ego.

Deine Rolle

In dieser Rolle baust du Decari mit uns auf. Du arbeitest direkt mit Julien (Operations) und den Gründern und bist operativ und taktisch mittendrin: Du sprichst jeden Tag mit Familien und Pflegediensten, siehst, wo es hakt, und gestaltest den Prozess aktiv mit. Das geht als Pflichtpraktikum oder als Werkstudent:in (bis 20 Stunden pro Woche, tagsüber). Du suchst ein anderes Modell? Sprich uns an.

Berlin, hybrid: im Praktikum mindestens 4 Tage pro Woche im Office, als Werkstudent:in mindestens 2. Start ab sofort, für mindestens 6 Monate, bezahlt, danach ist eine Festanstellung möglich.

Was du machst

  • Du bist der erste Kontakt der Familien zu Decari und verbringst den größten Teil deines Tages am Telefon. Im Gespräch findest du heraus, ob und wie wir helfen können.

  • Du bringst Fälle ins Ziel. Aus einem guten Gespräch machst du einen vollständigen Fall und bleibst dran, bis alles da ist, was wir für den Antrag brauchen.

  • Du betreust unsere Pflegedienste mit. Für sie bist du die erste Ansprechperson zu ihren Familien.

  • Du verbesserst den Funnel. Du kennst die Zahlen von der Anfrage bis zum Antrag, bringst Ideen ein und testest sie direkt.

  • Du baust mit uns Automatisierungen. Was wir oft genug von Hand gemacht haben, übernimmt danach die KI.

Du passt gut zu uns, wenn

  • Du gern telefonierst, auch 50 Mal am Tag, und dich eine Mailbox oder ein Nein nicht aus dem Takt bringt

  • Du gut zuhörst, empathisch bist und schnell und fehlerfrei schreibst

  • Du anpackst und dir für unglamouröse Arbeit nicht zu schade bist

  • Du Ownership übernimmst: Dinge jetzt erledigst, die einfachste Lösung suchst und selbst einen Weg findest, wenn du feststeckst

  • Du KI im Alltag nutzt und neue Tools schnell lernst

  • Du sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift besitzt (C1), weil du täglich mit Familien telefonierst und diese berätst. Eine weitere Sprache wie Polnisch, Türkisch, Russisch oder Arabisch ist ein Plus

  • Du studierst und suchst ein Pflichtpraktikum oder einen Werkstudentenjob, zum Beispiel in BWL, Gesundheitsmanagement, Sozialer Arbeit oder Jura.

  • Du schon Kundenkontakt hattest, etwa im Nebenjob, in einem Praktikum oder in einem eigenen Projekt

Eher nichts für dich, wenn

  • Du nicht gern telefonierst

  • Du noch nie mit KI- oder Automatisierungstools gearbeitet hast oder dir technisches Grundverständnis fehlt

  • Du nur „strategisch“ arbeiten willst

  • Du dich unwohl fühlst, wenn du mehrere Aufgaben gleichzeitig jonglierst

  • Du nicht gern direkt mit Kunden arbeitest oder ein dynamisches Umfeld nicht magst

  • Du nur einen klassischen 9-to-5-Job suchst

Bewerbungsprozess

  1. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf

  2. Kurzes Telefonat (15 Minuten)

  3. Bezahlter Probetag in Berlin

  4. Angebot

descriptionHtml:

Mit der Mischok Academy bilden wir seit 2021 als zugelassener Bildungsträger IT-Fachkräfte aus und weiter.

Umgang mit Coding Agents im Umfeld von geschäftskritischer Enterprise Software. Java und das Spring Boot Framework sowie Entwicklung von Frontends mit React oder Flutter.

title: Workplace Experience - Facility Manager in Paris
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Facility Manager — Hard FM

People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work, such as:

 

🎯 What drives us — We're obsessed with helping our members live healthier

  • Mission is the Boss: long-term thinking, seeking our mission success above all else.

  • Member & customer-led: obsessively focused on solving members & customers problems and creating the most delightful experiences.

     

🏆 How we build excellence — We hire the best people and give them platform to succeed

  • Champions of excellence: extremely high standards and talent density.

  • Distributed ownership: accountable enlightened despots, everyone owns their decisions and results.

  • Radically transparent: all information is accessible and written-first, so everyone can make the best decisions asynchronously.

     

🤝 How we grow together — We help each other improve through honest feedback and bold thinking

  • Optimistic alchemy: optimists who collaborate with genuine care and support teammates.

  • Empathetic challengers: direct, caring feedback combined with praises to help each other grow professionally.

  • Bold & creative contrarians: think differently to achieve greatness, try new approaches.

⚡ How we move fast — We fight complexity and focus on what matters most

  • Disciplined in execution: taking decisive actions with focus that compounds success over time.

  • Fight for simplicity: only high impact processes, smart frugality.

     

💡 The Missions

Alan has grown to more than 1,000 Alaners, with 600+ hires expected in 2026 alone.

The Workplace team is the engine behind the experience Alaners have every day, and that experience starts with a building that simply works: safe, comfortable, compliant, with air that is good to breathe and doors that open when they should.

As the company scales, our technical footprint grows with it.

Today, technical maintenance at our Paris HQ (Valmy) relies on a part-time factotum and on team members who handle it on top of some other scopes.

We are opening a dedicated, full-time Facility Manager position to give more love to our offices and to anticipate needs. The first focus is the run at Valmy (our HQ), with a strong prevention mindset.

As Alan keeps growing, more real-estate projects are likely (new floors, a possible office move, sites abroad...): we expect you to grow into the technical lead on them.

The role is part of the Workplace team and covers a single contract: Workplace Experience. The position is based in Paris and requires an onsite presence at least 4 days per week.

👀 The profile we're looking for (level range targeted on our level grid: B1-C1)

Specific missions

  • Make prevention the heart of the role. Identify the main risk areas (HVAC, water leaks, fire safety, access control). Build and run the preventive maintenance calendar, plan the mandatory periodic checks and keep the safety register up to date.

  • Do regular office rounds with the Valmy services team to spot wear and risks (leaks, lighting, HVAC, doors, badge readers, fire safety) before Alaners report them. Turn each finding into an action with an owner and a date.

  • Run day-to-day maintenance. Sort and diagnose Alaners' requests and fix small issues directly yourself (e.g. changing a light bulb). Send the rest to the right contractor, and follow each intervention until the work is done and checked on site.

  • Be the single technical point of contact for our vendors and our landlord. This covers contracts and SLAs (agreed service levels and intervention times), invoice checks, tenders, and escalation of building-level issues under the lease.

  • Own the legal and financial side of FM, with Legal and Finance: regulatory compliance (ERP / labor code safety rules, mandatory checks, audit findings), lease obligations, and the maintenance budget (opex / capex) with monthly cost follow-up and optimization.

  • Keep our offices safe, healthy and comfortable for all Alaners, in line with our Healthy Business positioning (air quality, thermal comfort, fire safety, accessibility...).

  • Track, improve and document. Create and run a simple dashboard (open requests, intervention times, recurring issues, budget), keep the equipment inventory and maintenance log, automate repetitive follow-ups with AI and tools, and write procedures that can be reused for new floors and sites.

  • Own Alan's obligations under the Décret tertiaire (energy-reduction law for office buildings over 1,000 m²) at Valmy and future offices, with the landlords.

  • Cover the technical needs and follow-up required at the Prévenir medical center hosted at Valmy

  • Over time, lead the technical side of our real-estate projects (floor take-overs, office moves, new sites): technical checks of buildings, follow-up of works with architects and project managers, move planning.

  • Work daily with cross-functional teams: Legal (compliance, lease), Finance (budget, invoicing, cost optimization), IT (network, access control, room equipment) and Security (office safety policies, crisis reaction).

  • Join the on-call rotation (daily Office Management tasks).

Key outcomes by 1 year

  • All hard FM contracts are mapped, documented and tracked (scope, SLAs, renewal and exit dates, costs, mandatory checks): no missed regulatory check or expired contract

  • A preventive maintenance plan is live at Valmy, and the share of corrective / emergency interventions has measurably decreased

  • At least 3 prevention areas identified, each with a specific action plan and clear KPIs

  • Regulatory compliance is up to date: safety register complete, periodic checks done on time, audit findings closed

  • New fire safety equipment provider selected and onboarded

  • Air quality measured on all floors, issues diagnosed and a corrective action plan delivered

  • Led at least two vendor reviews or tenders, produced clear findings and took the corresponding decisions autonomously

  • An FM dashboard tracks service quality, vendor performance and budget consumption; at least 3 manual or recurring tasks automated

  • A replicable FM playbook and a building technical checklist exist, ready to be used for a new floor, an office move or a new site

You may be a great fit if you are:

  • A Facility Manager / Technical Manager with 3–6 years of experience on multi-technical (tertiary / office) buildings, in-house at a scale-up or large company

  • Coming from an FM service provider or a property manager (site manager, contract manager) and wanting to move in-house and own the client side

  • A multi-technical maintenance profile (HVAC, electrical, fire safety) who has grown into vendor management, budget ownership and compliance

  • A Workplace manager with an FM scope, or a works / fit-out project manager with solid maintenance and run experience

What we're looking for

  • Solid technical understanding of building systems: HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire safety systems (alarm, extinguishers, emergency lighting), doors and access control

  • Knowledge of the French regulatory framework for offices (ERP / labor code safety rules, mandatory periodic checks, safety register, safety commission)

  • Proven vendor and contract management: SLAs, penalties, price indexation, tenders, invoice control

  • Ability to manage the landlord relationship and understand lease obligations (who pays and does what)

  • Electrical habilitation (mandatory, as the role fixes small electrical issues directly)

  • Exceptional communication in French (fluent) and professional English

  • Attention to detail, strong problem-solving, and the ability to juggle priorities, including urgent incidents, with a calm and constructive attitude when things go wrong (leak, outage, alarm)

  • A prevention mindset, autonomy and strong accountability: you spot what can be improved before being asked

  • A member-first mindset: you think about the Alaner experience, not the process

  • Appetite for digital tools, AI and basic automation to reduce repetitive work (ticketing, maintenance tracking, dashboards), and the ability to document in a way the whole team and AI agents can leverage

Nice to have

  • A technical diploma or certification (e.g. BTS / DUT in building maintenance or energy, SSIAP)

  • Experience with indoor air quality or energy efficiency projects (sensors, ventilation, Décret tertiaire)

  • Experience with a CMMS / GMAO tool, or building one with no-code tools

  • Experience leveraging AI to build scalable processes or automate recurring tasks

  • Experience in a high-growth tech company or scale-up

  • Having followed or led a fit-out, an office move or a new-site opening

 

🙌 Perks & Benefits


At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk -it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential.Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance. Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% of the contribution covered by Alan for you and your family.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents.

 

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

title: Your new Job: IT-Consultant Input Management - Digitalisation (w/d/m)
descriptionHtml:
Are you looking for challenges that set no limits to your creativity?

Do you love thinking outside the box and searching for new solutions?

Are you thrilled to successfully realize exceedingly exciting projects in internationally operating companies?

Do you want to work on one of the most important future topics and actively shape the digital future of significant companies with your efforts?

And do you want to be paid exceptionally well for it?

Then you are exactly right with us because we are looking for creative types like you!

We offer you a highly varied and exciting position as an IT Consultant in Input Management – Digitization with an above-average salary, regular company events at home and abroad, ongoing training and further education, and extremely challenging projects in internationally leading companies. One thing is certain: with us, you'll learn something new every day and develop yourself – professionally and personally!

Aufgaben

In a team, you advise demanding clients and develop a customized digitalization strategy with them to automate input channels such as paper, mail, or web and process them as efficiently as possible. This lays the foundation for using valuable customer data for business success.

During implementation, you develop efficient processes and apply AI/ML technologies to process the inputs as automatically as possible.

title: Zertifizierungsingenieur (m/w/d) Schienenfahrzeugtechnik in Mannheim (1326)
descriptionHtml:
Ihre Karriere im innovativen Projektmanagement.

Entfalten Sie Ihr Potenzial als Zertifizierungsingenieur (m/w/d) für Schienenfahrzeugtechnik: In Mannheim werden Sie zur zentralen Kraft im Bereich Projektmanagement. Sie erwartet eine spannende Tätigkeit, die technisches Know-how mit regulatorischer Präzision verbindet. Ihre Expertise in der Planung und Umsetzung von Zertifizierungs- und Zulassungsprozessen wird entscheidend dazu beitragen, innovative Mobilitätslösungen erfolgreich auf die Schiene zu bringen.

Aufgaben

  • Regelwerke und Standards anwenden: Sie entwickeln Zertifizierungs- und Zulassungspläne und sorgen dafür, dass alle rechtlichen Anforderungen erfüllt werden.
  • Projektmanagement: Sie koordinieren die Aktivitäten im Bereich Zulassung und Zertifizierung in enger Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Teams.
  • Ausschreibungsunterlagen erstellen: Sie verantworten das Ausschreibungsverfahren, von der Angebotseinholung bis zu Vertragsverhandlungen mit Gutachtern.
  • Nachweiserstellung: Sie organisieren und kontrollieren alle Nachweise und steuern die Prüfprozesse mit den externen Partnern.
  • Dokumentation: Sie stellen die Zulassungsdossiers zusammen und verwalten alle relevanten Unterlagen für behördliche Genehmigungen.

Qualifikation

  • Technischer Hintergrund: Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Ingenieurwesen (z. B. in der Schienenfahrzeugtechnik, Elektrotechnik oder Maschinenbau) oder eine gleichwertige Qualifikation.
  • Erfahrungen und Fachkenntnisse: Idealerweise Praxis im Zulassungsprozess, fundiertes Wissen über Signaltechnik und Bahnvorschriften wie TSI oder EBA.
  • Sprachkompetenz: Sie besitzen sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, um sicher in internationalen Projekten zu agieren.
  • Persönliche Stärken: Selbstständiges und strukturiertes Arbeiten, eine ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit sowie eine lösungs- und teamorientierte Mitarbeit im Projektumfeld runden Ihr Profil ab.

Benefits

  • Attraktive Konditionen: Freuen Sie sich auf eine unbefristete Vollzeitstelle bei BRÜGGEN ENGINEERING, mit einer Vergütung, die Ihre Expertise in der Hardware-Entwicklung würdigt.
  • Innovationsführerschaft: Werden Sie Teil eines führenden Unternehmens in der Schienenfahrzeugtechnik und gestalten Sie mit Ihrer Expertise die Zukunft der nachhaltigen Mobilität durch erfolgreiche Zertifizierungs- und Zulassungsprozesse.
  • Dynamisches Team: Werden Sie Teil eines Teams, das Wert auf persönliches Wachstum und eine Kultur der Unterstützung und Förderung legt.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit
Angabe Ihres frühesten Starttermins und Ihrer Gehaltsvorstellung.

Ihr Ansprechpartner für Ihre Bewerbung ist:
Herr Dipl.-Ing. (FH) Christian Bitz
